description.zh: 虔诚的圣术修行者，能引导圣光保护盟友并驱逐不死生物。
description.en: A faithful practitioner of the holy arts who channels their light to protect allies and banish the undead.

description.zh: 无情的双持战士，以速度和毒素击倒敌人。
description.en: A relentless dual wielder who uses speed and poisons to take down enemies.

description.zh: 狂怒的重装猛士，挥舞重型武器劈开敌阵，在毫无保留的战斗中如鱼得水。
description.en: A raging juggernaut who cleaves through enemies using heavy weaponry and thrives in no-holds-barred combat.

description.zh: 举世无双的法师，能够操纵时间的脉络，为盟友提供精准的辅助与控制。
description.en: A peerless mage who manipulates the fabric of time, providing allies with precise utility and control.

description.zh: 驾驭巨龙之力的近战猛士，将力量汇聚于长枪，以烈焰击倒敌人。
description.en: A draconic bruiser who channels the power of a dragon, focusing that energy through spears to fell foes with fire.

description.zh: 平和的自然术士，以治愈之力援助盟友，同时用大地魔法击退敌人。
description.en: A peaceful naturalist who provides healing succor for allies while repelling foes with earth magic.

description.zh: 精通远程作战的专家，凭借多种枪械与出色的机动性，无论远近都能消灭敌人。
description.en: A ranged specialist who uses a variety of firearms and their mobility to destroy foes both near and far.

description.zh: 异想天开的表演者，以欢快的歌声强化盟友，并用音乐与纸牌戏法迷惑敌人。
description.en: A whimsical performer who empowers allies with lively songs while confounding enemies with music and card tricks.

description.zh: 攻守兼备的近战斗士，以长枪和盾牌保护盟友并击倒敌人。
description.en: A balanced melee fighter who uses spear and shield to protect allies while felling foes.

description.zh: 元素魔法的研习者，能够从远处施放毁灭性法术。
description.en: A student of elemental magic who is capable of casting destructive spells from a distance.

description.zh: 修习灵性之道的近战斗士，以物理连招攻击敌人，同时治疗盟友。
description.en: A spiritual striker who assails enemies with physical combos while healing allies.

description.zh: 黑暗施法者，统御成群的亡者，并扭曲生灵的生命力。
description.en: A dark spellcaster who commands masses of the dead while twisting the life force of living beings.

description.zh: 坚定的神圣守护者，运用圣力惩击敌人并保护盟友。
description.en: A stalwart holy protector who brandishes holy power to both smite foes and protect allies.

description.zh: 虔诚的圣者，为盟友带来防护与治疗，并以神圣力量惩戒黑暗生物。
description.en: A devoted saint who brings protection and healing to allies and punishes dark creatures with sacred power.

description.zh: 追踪大师，以致命的暴击射击逐个击破敌人，并在战斗中布置陷阱、指挥野兽伙伴。
description.en: A master tracker who picks off enemies with critical shots while commanding traps and beast companions in battle.

description.zh: 嗜血的战士，以牺牲自身生命换取力量，施展黑暗而高风险的攻击。
description.en: A bloodthirsty warrior who sacrifices their own life for power while delivering dark, high-risk attacks.

description.zh: 身手敏捷的斗士，以毒药与利刃从暗影中发动袭击。
description.en: A nimble fighter who strikes from the shadows with poison and blade.

description.zh: 迅捷的神射手，擅长以弓术从远处打击敌人。
description.en: A swift marksman who excels at striking enemies from afar with archery.

description.zh: 难以捉摸的诡术者，利用分身与元素秘术误导并压制敌人。
description.en: An elusive trickster who uses clones and elemental arts to misdirect and overwhelm enemies.

description.zh: 神秘的召唤术士，与召唤出的伙伴并肩作战，能够适应各种局势。
description.en: A mystical conjurer who fights alongside summoned companions, adapting to fit every scenario.

description.zh: 受诅咒的施法者，以邪咒折磨敌人并汲取其生命。
description.en: A cursed spellcaster who afflicts enemies with hexes and drains their life.

description.zh: 强悍的斗士，挥舞重斧，对多个敌人造成高额伤害。
description.en: A powerful combatant who wields heavy axes to deal high damage against multiple foes.

description.zh: 研习失传技艺的学者，将不同流派的魔法缝合在一起。
description.en: A scholar of forgotten techniques who stitches together magic from many paths.

description.zh: 奥术大师，将火焰、寒冰、雷电与大地之力汇聚成毁灭性法术。
description.en: An arcane master who channels fire, ice, lightning, and earth into devastating spells.

description.zh: 祈求信仰，短暂保护自己与盟友。赞美圣光！
description.en: Briefly protect yourself and allies by invoking your faith. Praise the light!

description.zh: 跃至空中向下射击，在优雅闪避落地前击中下方敌人。
description.en: Leap through the air and fire downward, striking enemies below before landing with evasive grace.

description.zh: 凝聚专注与反应力，短时间提高 AGI 和 DEX。
description.en: Sharpen your focus and reflexes, increasing AGI and DEX for a short time.

description.zh: 召唤物散发天使恩典，提高附近盟友受到的治疗效果。
description.en: The summon radiates angelic grace, increasing healing received by nearby allies.

description.zh: 将魔力推至安全极限之外，以更高 MP 消耗为代价，提高魔法攻击与施法速度。
description.en: Push your magic beyond safe limits, increasing Magic Attack and Cast Speed at the cost of higher MP use.

description.zh: 召唤物散发防护装甲，提高附近盟友的所有抗性，并以防护保护自身。
description.en: The summon radiates protective armor, increasing nearby allies' All Resistance while shielding itself with Protection.

description.zh: 向大范围降下箭雨，反复命中敌人并迫使他们四散。
description.en: Rain arrows over a wide area, striking enemies repeatedly and forcing them to scatter.

description.zh: 对目标发动一次普通攻击。
description.en: Perform an auto attack against the target.

description.zh: 以宽阔弧线连续挥击两次，斩击前方敌人。
description.en: Swing twice in wide arcs, cutting through enemies in front of you.

description.zh: 沿残暴弧线掷出斧头，命中目标后猛然弹回手中。
description.en: Hurl your axe in a brutal arc, striking the target before it snaps back into your grasp.

description.zh: 释放旋转斩击，伤害附近敌人并将他们拉向自己。
description.en: Unleash a spinning slash that damages nearby enemies and pulls them toward you.

description.zh: 以神圣防护包裹一名盟友，形成基于其最大生命值的屏障。
description.en: Wrap an ally in divine protection, forming a barrier based on their maximum health.

description.zh: 以碾压般的一击猛砸目标，并有概率使其眩晕。
description.en: Smash the target with a crushing blow, with a chance to stun them.

description.zh: 进入不顾一切的战斗状态，大幅提高战斗能力，同时彻底舍弃克制。
description.en: Enter a reckless battle state, greatly increasing combat power while abandoning restraint.

description.zh: 在身边释放疾风骤雨般的连续斩击，迅速击倒附近敌人。
description.en: Unleash a flurry of strikes around you, cutting down nearby enemies in rapid motion.

description.zh: 让攻击附带锯齿般的伤口，使其有概率施加流血。
description.en: Empower your attacks with jagged strikes, giving them a chance to apply Bleeding.

description.zh: 以神圣防护祝福附近盟友，短时间提高所有属性。
description.en: Bless nearby allies with divine protection, raising all attributes for a short time.

description.zh: 传送至目标地点，脱离危险并精准调整位置。
description.en: Teleport to a target location, slipping out of danger and repositioning with precision.

description.zh: 消耗已储存的怒气，立即恢复生命值，并在短时间内持续恢复。
description.en: Spend stored Rage to recover health instantly and keep regenerating for a short time.

description.zh: 放任无休止的暴力，以控制力换取速度、压制力与续航。
description.en: Give in to relentless violence, trading control for speed, pressure, and sustain.

description.zh: 召唤物散发嗜血气息，赋予附近盟友 HP汲取，并使自身获得多重攻击。
description.en: The summon radiates bloodlust, granting nearby allies HP siphon while giving itself Multistrike.

description.zh: 掷出锋利骨矛，同时贯穿血肉与灵魂。
description.en: Hurl a sharpened lance of bone that pierces through flesh and spirit alike.

description.zh: 使锯齿状骨刺破土而出，刺穿上方敌人。
description.en: Rupture the ground with jagged bone spikes, impaling enemies caught above them.

description.zh: 对目标使出威力荒谬的一记 Bonk。有些教训只能靠钝器。
description.en: Deliver an absurdly powerful bonk to the target. Some lessons require blunt force.

description.zh: 释放会在敌人之间跳跃的闪电，电击其连锁经过的每一个目标。
description.en: Unleash lightning that jumps between enemies, shocking each target it chains through.

description.zh: 融入流动暗影，在攻击、施法或受到伤害前保持隐形。
description.en: Blend into shifting shadows, hiding from sight until you attack, cast, or take a hit.

description.zh: 引爆目标周围的不稳定火焰，造成火魔法伤害并施加灼烧。
description.en: Detonate unstable flames around the target, dealing Fire magic damage and applying Burning.

description.zh: 加深你与召唤盟友之间的联系，提高召唤物伤害与治疗能力。
description.en: Deepen your bond with summoned allies, improving summon damage and healing power.

description.zh: 以圣光沐浴地面，灼烧停留在祝圣区域内的敌人。
description.en: Bathe the ground in holy light, burning enemies who remain within the consecrated area.

description.zh: 降下一道净化周围区域的光柱，灼烧不配者并治疗正义之人。
description.en: Drop a pillar of light that purifies the surrounding area, burning the unworthy and healing the righteous.

description.zh: 散发坚定不移的决意，提高附近盟友的近战、远程与魔法伤害。
description.en: Radiate unwavering resolve, increasing nearby allies' Melee, Ranged, and Magic damage.

description.zh: 将夺来的骨骼与生命束缚成阴森屏障，通过召唤物保护自己。
description.en: Bind stolen bone and life into a grim barrier, shielding yourself through your summon.

description.zh: 引爆一个 Skeleton 召唤物，释放死灵冲击，使附近敌人与召唤物在死亡时爆炸。
description.en: Detonate a Skeleton summon in a burst of necrotic force, causing nearby enemies and summons to explode on death.

description.zh: 以尸骸魔法标记一名敌人，使其在死亡降临时爆发腐败力量。
description.en: Mark an enemy with corpse magic, causing them to erupt with decay when death claims them.

description.zh: 以尸骸魔法标记一个召唤物，使其被摧毁时爆炸。
description.en: Mark a summon with corpse magic, causing it to explode when destroyed.

description.zh: 架起防御并进行反击。格挡攻击，并以一记令人眩晕的重击还击！
description.en: Raise your guard and counter. Blocks attacks and hits back with a stunning blow!

description.zh: 释放报复性斩击，使受到反击力量波及的敌人眩晕。
description.en: Release a retaliatory strike, stunning enemies caught in the force of your counter.

description.zh: 在打出暴击后，以凶残的追加攻击撕裂目标。
description.en: Rip into the target with a savage follow-up strike after landing a critical hit.

description.zh: 将冲锋化作鼓舞人心的推进，为附近盟友赋予威能与防护。
description.en: Turn your charge into a rallying surge, granting nearby allies Might and Protection.

description.zh: 以神圣净化清除盟友身上的污秽，使其免受毒、致盲与沉默。
description.en: Purify an ally with holy clarity, protecting them from Poison, Blind, and Silence.

description.zh: 净化附近盟友，移除毒、致盲与沉默，并短暂赋予对应免疫。
description.en: Purify nearby allies, removing Poison, Blind, and Silence while granting brief immunity.

description.zh: 化作狂暴旋风向前旋转，将敌人拉入中心并以连续攻击撕裂他们。
description.en: Spin forward in a violent cyclone, pulling enemies inward and shredding them with repeated strikes.

description.zh: 降下神圣审判，伤害敌人，并使其更易受到物理与魔法惩罚。
description.en: Call down holy judgment, damaging enemies and leaving them exposed to both physical and Magic punishment.

description.zh: 将神圣仪式扭曲成暗影魔法，先把敌人拉向中心，再以腐化力量撕裂他们。
description.en: Twist sacred rites into shadow magic, pulling enemies inward before tearing through them with corrupted force.

description.zh: 以凶猛爪击撕裂目标，造成流血并积累怒气。
description.en: Rip into the target with savage slashes, causing Bleeding while fueling your Rage.

description.zh: 将自己与一名盟友绑定，在两个相连的灵魂之间共享治疗与 HP汲取。
description.en: Bind yourself to an ally, sharing healing and HP siphon between both bonded souls.

description.zh: 召唤物散发死灵力量，强化附近盟友的不死伤害，并削弱敌人。
description.en: The summon radiates necrotic power, empowering nearby allies' Undead damage while weakening enemies.

description.zh: 死灵光环会削弱附近敌人对不死力量的抗性。
description.en: A necrotic aura weakens nearby enemies against undead power.

description.zh: 释放一圈不死能量，伤害敌人的同时恢复召唤盟友。
description.en: Unleash a coil of undead energy, harming enemies while restoring summoned allies.

description.zh: 以不死能量攻击敌人，造成伤害并留下衰败。
description.en: Strike enemies with undead energy, damaging them and leaving Decay behind.

description.zh: 以不死能量修复召唤盟友，通过黑暗力量恢复其战斗能力。
description.en: Mend a summoned ally with undead energy, restoring its strength through dark power.

description.zh: 释放死灵冲击，腐化附近敌人并留下持续衰败的区域。
description.en: Release a burst of necrotic force, rotting nearby enemies and leaving a decaying field behind.

description.zh: 残留的死灵区域会持续伤害敌人，并传播衰败与 Desecration。
description.en: A lingering necrotic field damages enemies over time, spreading Decay and Desecration.

description.zh: 旋转挥舞镰刀发动猛攻，切割附近敌人，并让每次攻击传播衰败。
description.en: Spin into a scythe assault, carving nearby enemies while spreading Decay through each strike.

description.zh: 切换一道枯萎光环，使附近敌人受到衰败并削弱其治疗效果。
description.en: Toggle a withering aura that decays nearby enemies and weakens their healing.

description.zh: 散发不屈信仰，减少附近盟友受到的伤害。
description.en: Radiate unyielding faith, reducing incoming damage for nearby allies.

description.zh: 迅速架起防护，提高格挡下一次攻击的概率。
description.en: Brace yourself with quick protection, raising your chance to block the next attack.

description.zh: 清除目标身上的所有增益与有害状态，使其回归中立状态。
description.en: Strip the target clean of buffs and harmful statuses, returning them to a neutral state.

description.zh: 引导神圣威能，向不配的敌人降下辉耀之剑！
description.en: Channel your divine might and rain down radiant swords on your unworthy foes!

description.zh: 散发神圣力量，强化附近盟友，同时增强自身治疗与神圣防护。
description.en: Radiate divine power, strengthening nearby allies while empowering your own healing and holy protection.

description.zh: 对地的精通让你进入此 化身状态，提高地伤害并增强自身抗打击能力。
description.en: Mastery over Earth lets you assume this avatar state, increasing Earth damage while making you more resistant to attacks.

description.zh: 以沉重的地魔法攻击单个敌人，并使自身与地调谐。
description.en: Strike a single foe with crushing Earth magic and attune yourself to Earth.

description.zh: 以猛烈震动撼动战场，使卷入动荡的敌人眩晕。
description.en: Shake the battlefield with violent tremors, stunning enemies caught in the upheaval.

description.zh: 使锯齿状岩石破土而出，攻击敌人并使其更易受到火伤害。
description.en: Rupture the ground with jagged stone, striking enemies and leaving them exposed to Fire.

description.zh: 升起一面坚固石墙，阻挡空间并改变周围战场格局。
description.en: Raise a wall of solid stone, blocking space and shaping the battlefield around you.

description.zh: 为盟友施加会不断进化的屏障，吸收伤害后爆发神圣力量。
description.en: Place an evolving barrier on an ally, absorbing damage before erupting with sacred power.

description.zh: 以圣光祝福盟友的护甲，将其护甲元素改为神圣。
description.en: Bless an ally's armor with holy light, changing their armor element to Holy.

description.zh: 使攻击获得地元素。
description.en: Imbue your attacks with the Earth element.

description.zh: 使攻击获得火元素。
description.en: Imbue your attacks with the Fire element.

description.zh: 使攻击获得神圣元素。
description.en: Imbue your attacks with the Holy element.

description.zh: 使攻击获得毒元素。
description.en: Imbue your attacks with the Poison element.

description.zh: 使攻击获得暗影元素。
description.en: Imbue your attacks with the Shadow element.

description.zh: 使攻击获得不死元素。
description.en: Imbue your attacks with the Undead element.

description.zh: 使攻击获得水元素。
description.en: Imbue your attacks with the Water element.

description.zh: 使攻击获得风元素。
description.en: Imbue your attacks with the Wind element.

description.zh: 以圣光祝福盟友的武器，使其转化为神圣元素。
description.en: Bless an ally's weapon with holy light, converting them to the Holy element.

description.zh: 强化自身以承受来袭攻击，提高防御并防止被击退动作打断。
description.en: Steel yourself against incoming hits, increasing defenses and preventing flinching.

description.zh: 以奥术防护包裹自己，将部分所受伤害转移至 MP。
description.en: Wrap yourself in arcane protection, redirecting part of incoming damage to MP.

description.zh: 施展残暴的终结一击，造成高额伤害并积累怒气。
description.en: Deliver a brutal finishing blow, dealing heavy damage and feeding your Rage.

description.zh: 在一片区域降下神圣辉光，先将敌人拉向中心，再以圣力轰击。
description.en: Call down sacred radiance over an area, pulling enemies inward before blasting them with holy power.

description.zh: 掷出爆炸装置，在烈焰中引爆，将敌人击退并灼烧。
description.en: Hurl an explosive charge that detonates in flames, knocking back and burning enemies.

description.zh: 散发神圣狂热，提高附近盟友的速度，并让自身攻击更加连绵不绝。
description.en: Radiate holy zeal, quickening nearby allies while making your own strikes more relentless.

description.zh: 向单个目标迅速倾泻一连串子弹，为后续射击积累动势。
description.en: Rapidly unload a burst of shots into one target, building momentum for follow-up fire.

description.zh: 散射扇形幽灵刀刃，在危险中跃动，同时为下一项技巧做好准备。
description.en: Scatter a fan of spectral blades, leaping through danger while setting up your next technique.

description.zh: 召唤物散发原始凶性，提高附近盟友的攻击与魔法攻击。
description.en: The summon radiates raw ferocity, increasing nearby allies' Attack and Magic Attack.

description.zh: 降下扭曲治疗的诅咒区域，使敌人的治疗反噬自身，并令其更易受到魔法伤害。
description.en: Call down a cursed field that twists healing against enemies and leaves them exposed to Magic damage.

description.zh: 制造一片不谐区域，伤害敌人并降低其移动、攻击与施法速度。
description.en: Create a dissonant field that damages enemies and slows their movement, attacks, and casting.

description.zh: 制造一口安宁的共鸣之井，治疗停留在柔和低鸣中的盟友。
description.en: Create a soothing well of resonance, healing allies who remain within its gentle hum.

description.zh: 制造一片寂静区域，将敌人拉向中心，并可能封印其施法能力。
description.en: Create a silent field that pulls enemies inward and may seal their ability to cast.

description.zh: 发射一颗命中后爆炸的火球，灼烧敌人并留下 Firewall。
description.en: Launch a fiery orb that explodes on impact, burning enemies and leaving a Firewall behind.

description.zh: 对火的精通让你进入此 化身状态，提高火伤害与受到的治疗，并点燃胆敢攻击你的敌人。
description.en: Mastery over Fire lets you assume this avatar state, increasing Fire damage and Healing Received while igniting those who dare attack you.

description.zh: 向单个敌人发射凝聚的火弹，并使自身与火调谐。
description.en: Launch a concentrated bolt of Fire at one enemy and attune yourself to Fire.

description.zh: 在地面留下燃烧区域，灼烧停留在火焰中的敌人。
description.en: Leave burning ground behind, scorching enemies who remain in the flames.

description.zh: 从地面召唤一道火柱，灼烧敌人并使其更易受到地属性伤害。
description.en: Summon a pillar of flame from the ground, burning enemies and exposing them to Earth.

description.zh: 召唤一只炽烈灵体坠入战场，留下火焰，并使你的攻击缠绕火。
description.en: Call forth a blazing spirit that crashes down in flames and leaves your attacks wreathed in Fire.

description.zh: 制造一堵持续燃烧的火墙，灼烧敌人并将其击退。
description.en: Create a lingering wall of flame that burns enemies and pushes them back.

description.zh: 释放一颗缓慢移动的不稳定火焰球，命中时爆发成大范围爆炸。
description.en: Send out a slow orb of unstable flame that erupts into a wide explosion on impact.

description.zh: 引爆储存的火焰，形成大范围爆发，并灼烧范围内敌人。
description.en: Detonate stored flame in a wide burst, burning enemies caught in the blast.

description.zh: 向后滑步脱离危险，并为下一步动作准备一枚闪光手雷。
description.en: Backslide out of danger and prepare a flash grenade for your next move.

description.zh: 投掷致盲手雷，使爆炸范围内的敌人眩晕并迷失方向。
description.en: Throw a blinding grenade that stuns and disorients enemies caught in the blast.

description.zh: 进入专注的战斗节奏，将普通攻击转化为魔法压制，并改善自动施法的衔接。
description.en: Enter a focused combat rhythm, turning auto attacks into Magic pressure and improving autocast flow.

description.zh: 发射一记强力射击，将敌人击退并准备连击终结。
description.en: Fire a powerful shot that knocks enemies back and sets up a combo finisher.

description.zh: 投掷一枚冰冻装置，在范围内爆裂，使其中敌人无法移动。
description.en: Throw a freezing charge that bursts in an area, immobilizing enemies caught inside.

description.zh: 让攻击覆盖霜冻，使其有概率施加冻结。
description.en: Coat your attacks in frost, giving them a chance to apply Frozen.

description.zh: 释放一阵冰雹，以寒冰之力击退敌人。是让敌人保持距离的巧妙法术。
description.en: Unleash a barrage of hail, knocking back foes with the might of ice. A slick spell to keep enemies away.

description.zh: 以向内崩塌的力量旋转，将敌人拖向中心，并冻结被困其中的目标。
description.en: Spin with collapsing force, dragging enemies inward before freezing those caught at the center.

description.zh: 让旋流坍缩成冰冻爆发，将附近敌人封锁在寒冰中。
description.en: Collapse the spiral into a freezing burst, locking nearby enemies in ice.

description.zh: 粉碎目标周围的冻结魔力，造成水伤害并施加减速。
description.en: Shatter frozen magic around the target, dealing Water damage and applying Slow.

description.zh: 冻结敌人脚下的地面，反复造成伤害，并有概率施加冻结。
description.en: Freeze the ground beneath enemies, damaging them repeatedly with a chance to leave them Frozen.

description.zh: 以不稳定力量绑定一名盟友，通过共享的战斗激流赋予狂怒与威能。
description.en: Bind an ally with volatile force, granting Fury and Might through a shared battle surge.

description.zh: 在战斗中积累怒气，为下一项残暴技巧提供力量。
description.en: Build Rage through battle, feeding your next brutal technique.

description.zh: 如果你看得到这条信息，你要么本身就是 Game Master，要么正在查看游戏文件！
description.en: If you can see this message, you are either a Game Master yourself, or someone looking in the game files!

description.zh: 以神圣恩典祝福附近盟友，大幅提高其自然 HP 与 MP 恢复。
description.en: Bless nearby allies with divine grace, greatly improving natural HP and MP recovery.

description.zh: 让一道辉耀十字沿地面爆发，以神圣正义净除大范围内的不配者！
description.en: Burst forth a radiant cross along the ground, purging a wide area of the unworthy with your holy righteousness!

description.zh: 召唤物散发墓寒气息，加速附近盟友并使附近敌人受寒。
description.en: The summon radiates graveborn cold, hastening nearby allies while chilling nearby enemies.

description.zh: 寒冷光环降低附近敌人的移动速度与攻击速度。
description.en: A chilling aura slows nearby enemies, sapping their Move Speed and Attack Speed.

description.zh: 以沉重力量猛砸地面，使敌人踉跄，并为下一次 连击 做好准备。
description.en: Slam the ground with heavy force, staggering enemies and setting them up for your next combo.

description.zh: 以守护魔法绑定一名盟友，通过共享羁绊赋予生命力与再生。
description.en: Bind an ally with guardian magic, granting Vitality and Regeneration through a shared bond.

description.zh: 在盟友周围召唤守护灵体，保护其免受远程攻击。
description.en: Conjure a guardian spirit around an ally, shielding them from ranged attacks.

description.zh: 跃向前方并大幅挥动镰刀，使敌人踉跄并为终结攻击创造机会。
description.en: Leap forward with a wide scythe swing, staggering enemies and opening them to a finishing strike.

description.zh: 以迅捷祝福一名盟友，清除减速，并提高移动速度与攻击速度。
description.en: Bless an ally with swiftness, clearing Slow and increasing Move Speed and Attack Speed.

description.zh: 以迅捷祝福附近盟友，清除减速，并提高移动速度与攻击速度。
description.en: Bless nearby allies with swiftness, clearing Slow and increasing Move Speed and Attack Speed.

description.zh: 向盟友引导神圣能量，恢复 HP 并留下温和的再生。
description.en: Channel holy energy into an ally, restoring HP and leaving gentle Regeneration behind.

description.zh: 释放一道神圣能量波，治疗附近盟友并留下再生。
description.en: Release a wave of holy energy, healing nearby allies and leaving Regeneration behind.

description.zh: 准备一把专用重武器，在战斗中途切换到它以释放压倒性的力量
description.en: Ready a dedicated heavy weapon and swap to it mid-battle to unleash overwhelming firepower. Unlocks Gatling Guns and Launchers

description.zh: 化作坚不可摧的堡垒，提高格挡，同时变得难以移动。
description.en: Become an impenetrable fortress, increasing Block while becoming difficult to move.

description.zh: 向盟友灌注强烈圣力，恢复大量 HP。
description.en: Pour intense holy power into an ally, restoring a massive amount of HP.

description.zh: 向单个敌人释放凝聚的神圣光芒，以神圣力量攻击目标。
description.en: Release focused divine light at a single enemy, striking them with Holy force.

description.zh: 愿圣光祝福你的盾牌，提高格挡与所有抗性，以抵御所有敌人！
description.en: May the light bless your shield, increasing Block and All Resistance against all your foes!

description.zh: 以凝聚的神圣力量惩击一片区域，使敌人沉默，并留下充满怒意的圣光。
description.en: Smite an area with concentrated holy power, silencing enemies and leaving wrathful light behind.

description.zh: 降下持续存在的神圣怒火，使敌人眩晕并更易受到魔法伤害。
description.en: Call down lingering Holy wrath, stunning enemies and exposing them to Magic damage.

description.zh: 释放猛烈水流旋涡，将敌人拖向中心，并使其更易受到风伤害。
description.en: Unleash a violent spiral of water, dragging enemies inward and exposing them to Wind.

description.zh: 冰见到你很高兴！向敌人掷出一枚水碎片。
description.en: Ice to meet you! As you hurl a Water shard at your foes.

description.zh: 召唤一只幽灵河豚发射冰冷碎片，减速敌人并为下一道法术做好准备。
description.en: Call forth a spectral pufferfish that fires icy shards, slowing foes and readying your next spell.

description.zh: 这是个很棒的破冰法术：发射一根冰刺，粉碎并冻结敌人。
description.en: This spell is a great ice breaker as you send an ice spike that shatters and freezes your foes.

description.zh: 进入召唤者状态，强化召唤物，使其以自身魔法回响 Soul Strike。
description.en: Enter an invoker state, empowering your summons to echo Soul Strike with their own Magic.

description.zh: 这柄巨大的神圣之剑会劈斩不配者，并使其减速，便于继续攻击。
description.en: This giant Holy sword cleaves through the unworthy, slowing them for further attacks.

description.zh: 跃入战斗并在空中开火，使敌人踉跄并为追加射击创造机会。
description.en: Leap into battle and fire mid-air, staggering enemies and opening them to a follow-up shot.

description.zh: 将自己的生命与一名盟友相连，通过神圣羁绊替其承受伤势。
description.en: Link your life to an ally, taking their wounds upon yourself through a sacred bond.

description.zh: 从敌人身上汲取生命力，或以危险的不死激流强化召唤物。
description.en: Siphon vitality from enemies, or empower a summon with a dangerous undead surge.

description.zh: 以不死力量从敌人身上汲取生命，并通过造成的伤害恢复自己。
description.en: Drain life from enemies with undead power, restoring yourself through the damage dealt.

description.zh: 以不死狂热强化召唤盟友，以危险代价提高其攻击性。
description.en: Empower a summoned ally with undead frenzy, increasing its aggression at a dangerous cost.

description.zh: 召唤物散发噼啪作响的能量，提高附近盟友的攻击速度与闪避。
description.en: The summon radiates crackling energy, increasing nearby allies' Attack Speed and Flee.

description.zh: 如活体闪电般移动，提高速度与闪避战斗本能。
description.en: Move like living lightning, increasing speed and evasive combat instincts.

description.zh: 释放一只雷电凤凰向前疾冲，以闪电之力贯穿沿途敌人。
description.en: Unleash a phoenix of lightning that streaks forward, piercing enemies in its path.

description.zh: 瞬间横越战场，以突如其来的力量打击目标区域。
description.en: Cross the battlefield in an instant, striking the target area with sudden force.

description.zh: 突破安全极限，以牺牲防御与恢复为代价获得压倒性力量。
description.en: Push beyond safe limits, gaining overwhelming power while sacrificing defense and recovery.

description.zh: 固定重型武器的位置，在坚守原地时持续倾泻火力。
description.en: Lock your heavy weapon in place, unleashing sustained fire while holding your ground.

description.zh: 标记目标的弱点，降低其闪避与暴击防御。
description.en: Mark a target's weak points, reducing their Flee and Critical Defense.

description.zh: 召唤一颗燃烧陨石，使敌人眩晕，并在爆炸中留下灼烧效果。
description.en: Call down a burning meteor, stunning enemies and leaving them scorched in the blast.

description.zh: 召唤一场持续的陨石风暴，在目标区域不断降下火伤害。
description.en: Call down a lingering storm of meteors, raining Fire damage across the targeted area.

description.zh: 封印目标的魔法并复制其本质，使你能够将该法术化为己用。
description.en: Seal a target's magic and copy its essence, allowing you to cast the spell as your own.

description.zh: 骑上当前活动中的伙伴，在非战斗状态下提高移动速度。
description.en: Mount your active companion and increase your Move Speed while outside of combat.

description.zh: 召唤你的神圣狮鹫，以骑手与辉耀之刃的姿态踏上战场。
description.en: Call upon your holy gryphon, taking to the battlefield as both rider and radiant blade.

description.zh: 陷入狂野怒火，以纯粹愤怒提高攻击能力。
description.en: Drive yourself into a wild rage, increasing offensive power through pure fury.

description.zh: 以造成流血的攻击撕裂目标，留下持续伤口。
description.en: Rip into the target with a bleeding strike that leaves lasting wounds.

description.zh: 遮蔽目标的视野，降低其准确战斗的能力。
description.en: Cloud the target's sight, reducing their ability to fight with accuracy.

description.zh: 以火魔法灼烧目标，并使其持续受到灼烧。
description.en: Scorch the target with Fire magic and leave them Burning over time.

description.zh: 怪物陷入致命狂怒，大幅提高自动攻击伤害、攻击速度、施法速度与移动速度。
description.en: The monster flies into a deadly rage, greatly increasing Auto Attack damage, Attack Speed, Cast Speed, and Move Speed.

description.zh: 怪物进行绝望抵抗，短时间大幅提高所有抗性并获得 HP汲取。
description.en: The monster makes a desperate stand, gaining strong All Resistance and HP siphon for a short time.

description.zh: 以冰冻魔法攻击目标并施加冻结。
description.en: Strike the target with freezing magic, applying Frozen.

description.zh: 以力量击退目标，并在撞击时短暂使其眩晕。
description.en: Knock the target back with force, briefly stunning them on impact.

description.zh: 敌人的雷电反射神经爆发，大幅提高攻击速度与闪避。
description.en: The enemy surges with lightning reflexes, greatly increasing Attack Speed and Flee.

description.zh: 以汲取力量攻击敌人，并通过攻击偷取 MP。
description.en: Strike an enemy with draining force, stealing MP through the attack.

description.zh: 发射毒性射击，对目标施加毒。
description.en: Fire a toxic shot that applies Poison to the target.

description.zh: 以力量将目标拖向中心，并在撞击时短暂使其眩晕。
description.en: Drag the target inward with force, briefly stunning them on impact.

description.zh: 敌人穿梭于暗影中，出现在目标身后发动突袭。
description.en: The enemy slips through shadow, appearing behind its target for a sudden strike.

description.zh: 敌人磨砺专注，短时间大幅提高暴击概率。
description.en: The enemy sharpens its focus, greatly increasing critical chance for a short time.

description.zh: 封印目标的声音，使其无法施放技能。
description.en: Seal the target's voice, preventing them from casting skills.

description.zh: 敌人升起法术护盾，将敌对魔法反射回来源。
description.en: The enemy raises a spell shield, reflecting hostile Magic back at its source.

description.zh: 敌人硬化尖刺外壳，将物理伤害反射给攻击者。
description.en: The enemy hardens with thorns, reflecting physical damage back at attackers.

description.zh: 敌人强化防御，短时间大幅提高格挡概率。
description.en: The enemy reinforces its guard, greatly increasing block chance for a short time.

description.zh: 以令人眩晕的攻击命中目标，短暂停止其行动。
description.en: Strike the target with a stunning attack, briefly stopping their actions.

description.zh: 敌人在攻击上涂覆毒液，每次命中都会施加毒。
description.en: The enemy coats its attacks in venom, applying Poison with each strike.

description.zh: 以带有流血的力量攻击大范围，使敌人持续受伤。
description.en: Strike a wide area with bleeding force, leaving enemies wounded over time.

description.zh: 以致盲力量轰击大范围，降低敌人的准确战斗能力。
description.en: Blast a wide area with blinding force, reducing enemies' ability to fight accurately.

description.zh: 对大范围内的敌人施加诅咒，使其更易受到暗影伤害。
description.en: Curse enemies in a wide area, leaving them vulnerable to shadowed harm.

description.zh: 对大范围内的敌人施加冻结，以冰冷力量将其定在原地。
description.en: Apply Frozen to enemies in a wide area, locking them in place with icy force.

description.zh: 对大范围内的敌人施加毒，使其持续衰弱。
description.en: Apply Poison to enemies in a wide area, wearing them down over time.

description.zh: 对大范围内的敌人施加沉默，阻止其施放技能。
description.en: Silence enemies in a wide area, preventing them from casting skills.

description.zh: 对大范围内的敌人施加眩晕，短时间停止其行动。
description.en: Stun enemies in a wide area, stopping their actions for a short time.

description.zh: 突然倾泻一阵手枪火力，伤害附近敌人并完成已经准备好的 连击。
description.en: Unleash a sudden burst of pistol fire, damaging nearby enemies and finishing prepared combos.

description.zh: 发射一颗贯穿敌人的步枪弹，以沉重而精准的伤害使其踉跄并击退。
description.en: Fire a piercing rifle round that punches through enemies, staggering and knocking them back.

description.zh: 近距离发射残暴的霰弹枪轰击，使敌人视线受阻并完成霰弹枪连击。
description.en: Fire a brutal close-range shotgun blast, blinding enemies and finishing shotgun combos.

description.zh: 留下毒性区域，对敌人施加毒，并使其更容易受到伤害。
description.en: Leave a toxic field behind, applying Poison to enemies and making them easier to damage.

description.zh: 投掷一枚毒性手雷，爆发出毒素并留下致命地面。
description.en: Hurl a toxic grenade that bursts into Poison, leaving deadly ground behind.

description.zh: 束缚已倒下首领残留的灵魂，将其收为不死冠军。
description.en: Bind the lingering spirit of a fallen boss, claiming it as an undead champion.

description.zh: 以无情镰刀横扫附近敌人，将其拉近并汲取 HP。
description.en: Carve through nearby enemies with a merciless scythe strike, pulling them in and siphoning HP.

description.zh: 召唤物散发嗜血气息，赋予附近盟友 HP汲取。
description.en: The summon radiates bloodlust, granting nearby allies HP siphon.

description.zh: 使倒下的盟友重返生命，恢复其部分 HP 与精神。
description.en: Return a fallen ally to life, restoring a portion of their HP and spirit.

description.zh: 降下天界光芒，使所有倒下的盟友重返生命并恢复力量。
description.en: Call down celestial light, returning all fallen allies to life with renewed strength.

description.zh: 将神圣意志凝聚成清明状态，强化神圣魔法，并提高施法速度与状态持续时间。
description.en: Focus holy will into clarity, empowering Holy magic while improving Cast Speed and Status Duration.

description.zh: 创造一处神圣庇护所，持续治疗盟友并将敌人击退。
description.en: Create a holy sanctuary that heals allies over time and knocks enemies away.

description.zh: 祝圣盟友脚下的地面，减少其受到的地面效果伤害。
description.en: Hallow the ground beneath your allies, reducing damage taken from Ground Effects.

description.zh: 将自己的 HP 奉献给神明，使每次攻击附加神圣伤害。
description.en: Offer your own HP to the divine, adding Holy damage to each of your blows.

description.zh: 升起一棵神圣树木，以圣光治疗盟友并击退不死。
description.en: Raise a sacred tree that heals allies and repels undead with holy radiance.

description.zh: 制造一片小型圣光庇护所，治疗盟友并将敌人推开。
description.en: Create a small sanctuary of holy light, healing allies and pushing enemies away.

description.zh: 以暗影假动作向后滑步，短暂闪避所有攻击并留下一个分身。
description.en: Slip backward in a shadowy feint, briefly evading all attacks and leaving a clone behind.

description.zh: 释放旋转的黑暗新月，以暗影力量切割目标。
description.en: Launch a whirling crescent of darkness that carves through the target with shadow force.

description.zh: 通过暗影分裂自身存在，创造与自己并肩战斗的分身。
description.en: Split your presence through shadow, creating clones to fight alongside you.

description.zh: 穿过暗影出现在目标身后并发动攻击。
description.en: Step through shadow to appear behind the target and strike.

description.zh: 以暗影魔法攻击目标，用黑暗力量将其斩穿。
description.en: Strike the target with Shadow magic, cutting through them with dark force.

description.zh: 在身后留下一道切割暗影，伤害附近敌人并降低其移动速度。
description.en: Leave a cutting shadow in your wake, damaging nearby enemies and slowing their movement.

description.zh: 冲锋！架起盾牌向前突进，粉碎敌人防御并为后续攻击创造机会。
description.en: Charge! Brace that shield and lunge forth, crumbling enemy defenses and opening them for further attacks.

description.zh: 让圣光引导你的盾牌，将其投掷并在多个敌人之间弹跳。
description.en: Let the light guide your shield as you hurl it between many foes.

description.zh: 以霰弹枪架起防御，吸收沉重冲击并防止被击退动作打断。
description.en: Brace behind your shotgun, absorbing heavy impact and preventing flinching.

description.zh: 发出野蛮嚎叫，使附近盟友充满嗜血欲望与战斗饥渴。
description.en: Unleash a savage howl that fills nearby allies with bloodlust and battle hunger.

description.zh: 发出愤怒战吼，为附近盟友赋予狂怒，并强化其暴击。
description.en: Let out a furious battle cry, granting nearby allies Fury and sharpening their critical strikes.

description.zh: 发出强力咆哮，以更高力量强化附近盟友。
description.en: Let out a mighty roar, empowering nearby allies with increased strength.

description.zh: 释放持续更久的 War Cry，为附近盟友提供更长时间的威能。
description.en: Release an extended War Cry, granting Might to nearby allies for a longer duration.

description.zh: 以野蛮怒吼震慑附近敌人，使其眩晕，同时积累怒气。
description.en: Terrify nearby enemies with a savage cry, stunning them while fueling your Rage.

description.zh: 以近距离破片轰击敌人，使爆发范围内的目标减速并流血。
description.en: Blast enemies with close-range shrapnel, slowing and bleeding those caught in the burst.

description.zh: 掷出一枚会停留原地旋转的手里剑，反复切割附近敌人。
description.en: Hurl a spinning shuriken that lingers in place, slicing nearby enemies again and again.

description.zh: 进入精准杀戮姿态，提高暴击概率与暴击伤害。
description.en: Enter a precise killing stance, increasing critical chance and Critical Damage.

description.zh: 在地面铺开一道暗影陷阱，减速敌人并使其更容易受到伤害。
description.en: Spread a shadowy trap across the ground, slowing enemies and leaving them vulnerable.

description.zh: 以神圣力量攻击目标，造成受祝福的伤害，并有概率使其眩晕。
description.en: Strike the target with holy force, dealing blessed damage with a chance to stun.

description.zh: 制造致盲烟幕，使敌人视线受阻，同时隐藏自己。
description.en: Create a blinding smoke screen, blinding enemies while cloaking yourself.

description.zh: 以烟雾笼罩盟友，使其短时间隐藏于视线之外。
description.en: Cover allies in smoke, cloaking them from sight for a short time.

description.zh: 进入稳定的狙击姿态，提高远程伤害与暴击伤害，但大幅降低移动能力。
description.en: Take a steady sniper stance, increasing Ranged damage and Critical Damage while greatly reducing movement.

description.zh: 瞄准并发射毁灭性的步枪弹，造成沉重而精准的伤害。
description.en: Line up a devastating rifle shot, striking with heavy precision damage.

description.zh: 召唤物散发汲取光环，帮助附近盟友在战斗中汲取 HP 与 MP。
description.en: The summon radiates a draining aura, helping nearby allies siphon HP and MP from battle.

description.zh: 以灵魂汲取标记敌人，使其死亡时升起不死召唤物。
description.en: Mark enemies with soul drain, raising undead summons when they fall.

description.zh: 向单个敌人发射凝聚的 Soul魔法。
description.en: Launch a focused burst of Soul magic at a single enemy.

description.zh: 通过严谨的武器训练，Knight 的攻击变得更快、更利落。真正可怕的，是将同一招练习千次的人。
description.en: Through disciplined weapon training, the Knight strikes faster and cleaner. Fear the one who has practiced the same technique a thousand times.

description.zh: 发动宽阔横扫，使敌人踉跄并更容易受到攻击。
description.en: A wide sweeping attack, staggering enemies and making them more susceptible to attacks.

description.zh: 以强力穿刺结束战斗。作为 连击 一部分使用时，伤害提高。
description.en: Finish them with a strong piercing attack. Increased damage when used as part of a combo.

description.zh: 以迅速的连续穿刺起手，贯穿敌人并为下一次 连击 做好准备。
description.en: Open with rapid piercing strikes, cutting through enemies and preparing your next combo.

description.zh: 以神圣结界包裹一名盟友，在敌对法术命中前反射魔法伤害。
description.en: Wrap an ally in a sacred ward that reflects Magic damage before hostile spells can reach them.

description.zh: 清除盟友身上的眩晕、冻结、灼烧与衰败，并短暂赋予对应免疫。
description.en: Clear Stun, Frozen, Burning, and Decay from an ally, granting brief immunity to each.

description.zh: 以沉重力量践踏地面，使冲击范围内的敌人眩晕。
description.en: Slam the ground with heavy force, stunning enemies caught in the impact.

description.zh: 向单个目标快速射出一轮箭矢。
description.en: Fire a rapid volley of arrows into a single target.

description.zh: 召唤一团缝合的腐烂血肉，以蛮力控制战场空间。
description.en: Summon a stitched mass of decaying flesh, built to control space through brute force.

description.zh: 召唤一名辉耀治疗者，为盟友恢复生命，并以圣光攻击敌人。
description.en: Summon a radiant healer who restores allies and strikes enemies with holy light.

description.zh: 命令当前活动中的召唤物集中攻击所选目标。
description.en: Command your active summons to converge on the chosen target and attack.

description.zh: 召唤一名带刺哨兵，承受攻击并毫不退缩地反击。
description.en: Summon a spiny sentinel that absorbs punishment and strikes back without flinching.

description.zh: 召唤一名灵活施法者，在战场中迅速穿梭并以闪电轰击敌人。
description.en: Summon a nimble caster that darts through battle and blasts enemies with lightning.

description.zh: 召唤一名不死恶魔，强化死灵力量并操控黑暗魔法。
description.en: Summon an undead demon who strengthens necromantic power and commands dark magic.

description.zh: 骑乘当前活动中的召唤物，从更有利的战场位置直接控制它。
description.en: Mount your active summon, taking direct control from a stronger battlefield position.

description.zh: 召唤一名已被收服的不死冠军，使其重返战场。
description.en: Call forth a claimed undead champion, returning it to the battlefield.

description.zh: 召回当前活动中的召唤物，取消其行动并使其回到你身边。
description.en: Recall your active summons, cancelling their actions and bringing them back to your side.

description.zh: 升起一名 Skeleton 与你并肩作战，成为不死军队的骨干。
description.en: Raise a Skeleton to fight beside you as the backbone of your undead army.

description.zh: 升起一名 Skeleton Mage，从远处使用不稳定的死灵魔法攻击。
description.en: Raise a Skeleton Mage that attacks from range with unstable necromantic magic.

description.zh: 切换当前召唤配置，迅速适应战斗。
description.en: Swap your active summon setup, adapting quickly to the fight.

description.zh: 召唤一名迅捷而凶猛的斗士，以纯粹力量与速度撕裂敌人。
description.en: Summon a fast, feral brawler that tears into enemies with raw strength and speed.

description.zh: 召唤一名幽灵般的不死施法者，以黑暗魔法骚扰敌人。
description.en: Summon a ghostly undead caster that harasses enemies with dark magic.

description.zh: 发射压制射击，削弱并标记敌人，为后续攻击创造机会。
description.en: Fire suppressive shots that weaken and mark enemies, setting them up for follow-up attacks.

description.zh: 迫使受影响的目标将注意力集中在你身上。提高威胁生成。
description.en: Compels inflicted targets to focus their attention on you. Increases Threat generation.

description.zh: 召唤狂暴烈风，重击敌人、使其致盲，并令其更易受到水属性伤害。
description.en: Summon a furious gale that batters enemies, blinds them, and exposes them to Water damage.

description.zh: 根据当前调谐状态释放大规模元素爆发，以广阔范围压倒敌人。
description.en: Unleash a massive elemental eruption based on your current attunement, overwhelming enemies in a wide area.

description.zh: 以 Elemental Overload 粉碎地面，反复造成地伤害并大幅减速敌人。
description.en: Shatter the ground with Elemental Overload, dealing repeated Earth damage and heavily slowing enemies.

description.zh: 以 Elemental Overload 点燃战场，反复造成火属性伤害并灼烧敌人。
description.en: Ignite the battlefield with Elemental Overload, dealing repeated Fire damage and burning enemies.

description.zh: 以 Elemental Overload冻结战场，反复造成水伤害并将敌人定在原地。
description.en: Freeze the battlefield with Elemental Overload, dealing repeated Water damage and locking enemies in place.

description.zh: 以 Elemental Overload 撕开风暴，反复造成风属性伤害并使敌人眩晕。
description.en: Tear open the storm with Elemental Overload, dealing repeated Wind damage and stunning enemies.

description.zh: 向单个敌人降下一道凝聚闪电，并使自身与风调谐。
description.en: Call down a focused bolt of lightning on one enemy and attune yourself to Wind.

description.zh: 在地面留下噼啪作响的能量，电击敌人并使其更易受到水伤害。
description.en: Leave crackling energy on the ground, shocking enemies and exposing them to Water.

description.zh: 在一片区域召唤雷暴，攻击敌人并使其更易受到水伤害。
description.en: Call down a storm of lightning over an area, striking enemies and exposing them to Water damage.

description.zh: 进入狂野射击状态，在移动时自动攻击附近敌人。
description.en: Enter a wild firing state, automatically shooting nearby enemies while moving.

description.zh: 以神圣视野揭露隐藏敌人，使其短时间无所遁形。
description.en: Reveal hidden enemies with holy sight, exposing them for a short time.

description.zh: 尝试以神圣审判净除不死与暗影敌人，成功时造成巨额伤害。
description.en: Attempt to purge Undead and Shadow enemies with divine judgment, dealing massive damage on success.

description.zh: 以压倒性力量发动攻击，使敌人眩晕并四散，随后退回暗影中。
description.en: Strike with overwhelming force, stunning and scattering enemies before slipping back into shadows.

description.zh: 磨砺战斗节奏，短时间提高攻击速度与暴击概率。
description.en: Sharpen your battle rhythm, increasing Attack Speed and critical chance for a short time.

description.zh: 以暗影力量撕裂区域，标记敌人，使其受到更多伤害。
description.en: Rupture the area with umbral force, marking enemies so they take increased damage.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下散布持续存在的暗影腐化，造成伤害并施加暗影标记。
description.en: Spread lingering umbral decay beneath enemies, damaging them and marking them with shadow.

description.zh: 使暗影能量在大范围内坍缩，标记敌人，使后续攻击造成更多伤害。
description.en: Collapse umbral energy across a wide area, marking enemies so incoming attacks hit harder.

description.zh: 召唤物散发邪恶力量，提高附近盟友的不死与暗影伤害。
description.en: The summon radiates unholy power, increasing nearby allies' Undead and Shadow damage.

description.zh: 消耗怒气强化身体，以纯粹意志减少所受伤害。
description.en: Consume Rage to steel your body, reducing incoming damage through sheer will.

description.zh: 在目标周围爆发毒液，伤害附近敌人并叠加毒状态。
description.en: Burst venom around the target, damaging nearby enemies and stacking Poison.

description.zh: 为攻击涂覆毒液，使每次攻击都有概率施加毒。
description.en: Coat your attacks in venom, giving each strike a chance to apply Poison.

description.zh: 以毒性力量连续攻击两次，并有概率施加毒。
description.en: Strike twice with venomous force, with a chance to apply Poison.

description.zh: 散发温和神圣光环，提高附近盟友的生命力与 HP 恢复。
description.en: Emit a gentle divine aura, increasing Vitality and HP recovery for nearby allies.

description.zh: 发射一颗命中后爆炸的不稳定弹药，伤害目标周围的敌人。
description.en: Fire a volatile shot that explodes on impact, damaging enemies around the target.

description.zh: 引爆不稳定能量，伤害附近敌人并使其更容易受到伤害。
description.en: Detonate volatile energy, damaging nearby enemies and leaving them vulnerable.

description.zh: 对水的精通让你进入此 化身状态，提高水伤害与MP恢复，并冻结胆敢攻击你的敌人。
description.en: Mastery over Water lets you assume this avatar state, increasing Water damage and MP Regen while freezing those who dare attack you.

description.zh: 在已装备的配置之间切换，于战斗中途改变战斗风格。
description.en: Swap between equipped loadouts, adapting your combat style in the middle of battle.

description.zh: 精准掷出武器，使目标减速，同时从远处发动攻击。
description.en: Hurl your weapon with precision, slowing your target while you attack from afar.

description.zh: 以不懈力量原地旋转，持续攻击附近所有敌人。
description.en: Spin in place with relentless force, striking all nearby enemies over time.

description.zh: 带着凶猛动势向前跃进，碾压敌人并积累怒气。
description.en: Leap forward with ferocious momentum, crushing enemies and fueling your Rage.

description.zh: 对风的精通让你进入此 化身状态，提高移动速度，并向胆敢攻击你的敌人释放闪电爆发。
description.en: Mastery over Wind lets you assume this avatar state, increasing Move Speed while discharging a blast of lightning at those who dare attack you.

description.zh: 以炽热信念鼓舞一名盟友，短时间大幅提高其伤害。
description.en: Inspire an ally with fervent conviction, greatly increasing their damage for a time.

description.zh: 泛着柔光的经文将慈悲化作庇护伤者的屏障。
description.en: Softly glowing scripture turns mercy into shelter for the wounded.

description.zh: 镀金书页催促每一次攻击向前，直到信念凝成光辉。
description.en: Gilded pages urge each strike onward until faith hardens into radiance.

description.zh: 明亮的诗句将圣光磨砺成审判，萦绕在虔诚信徒身旁。
description.en: Bright verses sharpen holy light into judgment that lingers around the faithful.

description.zh: 温柔的圣歌写满书页，让每一次治疗祷告都加深恩典。
description.en: Gentle hymns fill the pages, deepening grace with every healing prayer.

description.zh: 交织的诗篇让圣光比寻常祷告更快、更纯净，也能传得更远。
description.en: Threaded verses bend holy light faster, cleaner, and farther than ordinary prayer.

description.zh: 节律严谨的赞美诗让双手保持稳定，使治疗魔法以完美节奏流转。
description.en: Measured psalms keep hands steady and healing magic moving in perfect cadence.

description.zh: 提高自动攻击造成的伤害。
description.en: Increases the damage dealt by your auto attacks.

description.zh: 自动攻击有概率自动施放 Strafing Volley。
description.en: Auto attacks have a chance to automatically fire Strafing Volley.

description.zh: 提升使用斧、剑与镰刀时的攻击力，并提高暴击率。
description.en: Increases attack with axes, swords, and scythes, and raises critical chance.

description.zh: 撕裂的战斗书页教会每一声呐喊将勇气传得更远。
description.en: Torn battle pages teach every shout to carry courage farther.

description.zh: 血红墨迹在书页上狂乱翻腾，渴求下一次暴击。
description.en: Blood-red ink thrashes across the page, hungry for the next critical strike.

description.zh: 狂野笔记让每个倒下的敌人都化作冲势、怒火与可怕的专注。
description.en: Savage notes reward every fallen foe with momentum, fury, and terrible focus.

description.zh: 一本阴郁的手册，教你在虚弱敌人苟延残喘时彻底斩断犹豫。
description.en: A grim manual for ending hesitation when weakened enemies stand too long.

description.zh: 提升使用匕首、剑、双刃武器与拳刃时的攻击力，并提高攻击速度。
description.en: Increases attack with daggers, swords, twinblades, and katars, while improving Attack Speed.

description.zh: 强化首领技能，增加额外投射物与攻击范围，从而形成更强的区域压制。
description.en: Enhances boss skills with extra projectiles and range for stronger area pressure.

description.zh: 提升使用书籍、法杖与钉头锤时的魔法攻击，并强化治疗。
description.en: Increases Magic Attack with books, staffs, and maces, while improving Healing.

description.zh: 提升暴击造成的伤害。
description.en: Increases the damage dealt by critical hits.

description.zh: 允许双手各装备一件武器。
description.en: Allows you to wield a weapon in each hand.

description.zh: 提高对不死与暗影元素敌人造成的伤害，并减少受到它们的伤害。
description.en: Increases damage against Undead and Shadow enemies, while reducing damage taken from them.

description.zh: 提高最大 HP、生命力与受到的治疗。
description.en: Increases maximum HP, Vitality, and Healing Received.

description.zh: 允许在施法期间移动与攻击，但移动速度和攻击速度会降低。
description.en: Allows movement and attacks while casting, with reduced Move Speed and Attack Speed.

description.zh: 大幅提高所有属性、移动速度与伤害减免。获得 Game Master Cloaking 和 Resurrection。
description.en: Greatly increases all stats, Move Speed, and damage reduction. Grants Game Master Cloaking and Resurrection.

description.zh: 提升使用枪械时的攻击力，提高攻击速度，并允许双持手枪。
description.en: Increases attack with firearms, improves Attack Speed, and allows dual wielding pistols.

description.zh: 提高闪避，使物理攻击更难命中你。
description.en: Increases Flee, making physical attacks less likely to hit you.

description.zh: 提高最大 HP。
description.en: Increases maximum HP.

description.zh: 提高被动 HP 恢复速度。
description.en: Increases passive HP recovery.

description.zh: 提高最大 MP。
description.en: Increases maximum MP.

description.zh: 提高被动 MP 恢复速度。
description.en: Increases passive MP recovery.

description.zh: 一本骑士战地手册，教人将向前推进化作严谨的压制。
description.en: A knightly field manual for turning forward motion into disciplined pressure.

description.zh: 宽大的图示教授如何通过每一次沉稳挥扫掌握阵形、牵引与控制。
description.en: Wide diagrams teach formation, pull, and control through every measured sweep.

description.zh: 噼啪作响的笔记训练身体在疑虑追上之前连续出手两次。
description.en: Crackling notes train the body to strike twice before doubt catches up.

description.zh: 一本为骑士装订成册的救援教典，教他们先将危险拉近，再将其击溃。
description.en: A rescue doctrine bound for knights who bring danger closer before breaking it.

description.zh: 镶铁书页以顽固而即时的决意回应每一次格挡。
description.en: Iron-edged pages answer every blocked strike with stubborn, immediate resolve.

description.zh: 前线教典教授如何以嘲讽削弱敌人的意志，再让钢铁抵达。
description.en: Frontline doctrine teaches taunts to weaken resolve before steel arrives.

description.zh: 提升使用钉头锤、书籍与法杖时的攻击力，并提高攻击速度。
description.en: Increases attack with maces, books, and staffs, while improving Attack Speed.

description.zh: 四种调谐共处一页，争论不休，直到最终汇成一曲和声。
description.en: Four attunements share one page, arguing until they become a single harmony.

description.zh: 奥术图示将朴素攻击化作远方迸发的严谨魔法火花。
description.en: Arcane diagrams turn simple attacks into distant sparks of disciplined magic.

description.zh: 折叠的书页标记着一呼一吸之间那不可思议的步法。
description.en: Folded pages mark impossible footwork between one breath and the next.

description.zh: 隐藏的地脉在封面下低鸣，借倒下的敌人补充力量。
description.en: Hidden ley-lines hum beneath the cover, refilling power through fallen foes.

description.zh: 脆弱的蓝色文字在魔法命中目标时碎裂成寒冷爆发。
description.en: Brittle blue script fractures into cold bursts whenever magic finds a mark.

description.zh: 不稳定的红色文字静候冲击，随后骤然绽放为烈焰。
description.en: Unstable red script waits for impact before blooming into sudden flame.

description.zh: 自动攻击有概率额外命中数次。
description.en: Gives auto attacks a chance to strike additional times.

description.zh: 提高施法范围、魔法攻击、最大 MP 与 MP 恢复速度。
description.en: Increases cast range, Magic Attack, maximum MP, and MP recovery.

description.zh: 一本庄重的架盾指南，教盾牌以受控的力量回应压力。
description.en: A solemn stance guide for shields that answer pressure with controlled force.

description.zh: 沉重教义将每一次冲锋化作对并肩前行之人的保护。
description.en: Heavy doctrine turns every charge into protection for those moving beside you.

description.zh: 温暖的屏障圣歌环绕治疗之手，让仁慈更难被击破。
description.en: Warm barrier hymns gather around healing hands, making mercy harder to break.

description.zh: 一则反击信条：被格挡的攻击唤醒的是神圣力量，而非恐惧。
description.en: A retaliatory creed where blocked blows awaken holy power instead of fear.

description.zh: 提高攻击范围与命中。
description.en: Increases attack range and Hit Rate.

description.zh: 苍白书页隐藏着仪式，能将怒火化作抵挡邪恶威胁的庇护。
description.en: Pale pages hide rites that turn wrath into shelter against unholy threats.

description.zh: 一则被鲜血温暖的誓言铭记痛苦，并以更加凌厉的审判回应。
description.en: A blood-warmed vow remembers pain and answers it with sharper judgment.

description.zh: 圣化烙印灼烧于文字之间，为神圣毁灭标记腐化。
description.en: Sanctified brands burn across the text, marking corruption for holy ruin.

description.zh: 月之祷文先以阴影包裹保护，随后释放潜藏的神圣力量。
description.en: Lunar prayers wrap protection in shadow before releasing hidden sacred force.

description.zh: 仁慈教义教导每一份溢出的祝福在灵魂周围凝成坚壳。
description.en: Merciful doctrine teaches every excess blessing to harden around the soul.

description.zh: 一份封印契约，为那些从最终边缘归来的人许诺光明。
description.en: A sealed covenant promises light for those returned from the final edge.

description.zh: 每当腐化被祛除，或治疗开始生效时，洁白书页便会亮起。
description.en: Clean white pages brighten whenever corruption is lifted or healing takes hold.

description.zh: 圣化律令教导神圣之地在绝望的脚步下维持得更加长久。
description.en: Consecrated rules teach sacred ground to endure longer under desperate feet.

description.zh: 提高可累积的狂怒最大层数。
description.en: Increases the maximum number of Rage stacks you can build.

description.zh: 将受到的部分伤害反射给攻击者。
description.en: Reflects a portion of incoming damage back to attackers.

description.zh: 减少受到的所有元素伤害。
description.en: Reduces damage taken from all elements.

description.zh: 一本安静的盗贼手册，其中每一柄旋转刀刃都先教你保持无声。
description.en: A quiet rogue manual where every spinning blade teaches silence first.

description.zh: 墨黑路线在书页上蜿蜒，却恰好在追踪开始之处消失。
description.en: Ink-black routes trail across the pages, vanishing exactly where pursuit begins.

description.zh: 染毒图示向外绽放，教导毒素在每一次破绽出现后继续蔓延。
description.en: Poisoned diagrams blossom outward, teaching venom to spread after every opening.

description.zh: 黑暗步法让每一步不断倍增，直到距离本身也变得不再可靠。
description.en: Dark footwork lessons multiply each step until distance becomes unreliable.

description.zh: 隐藏的页边批注奖赏无形杀手，让每次消失之后都显露出无情破绽。
description.en: Concealed margins reward unseen killers with ruthless openings after every vanish.

description.zh: 机械笔记教你用一发射击让麻烦乖乖等候下一发。
description.en: Mechanical notes teach one shot to leave trouble waiting for the next.

description.zh: 标记清晰的地形草图教陷阱把猎物拖入更糟的选择。
description.en: Marked terrain sketches teach traps to pull prey into worse decisions.

description.zh: 松散灵活的书页让每次闪避都化作节奏、速度与重新涌起的动势。
description.en: Loose, agile pages reward every dodge with rhythm, speed, and renewed motion.

description.zh: 战术笔记让每一发强力射击都在敌人恢复前令其踉跄。
description.en: Tactical notes make each forceful shot stagger enemies before they recover.

description.zh: 锐利图示扩展猎人的标记，直到距离也不再让人觉得安全。
description.en: Sharp diagrams widen the hunter's mark until distance feels less protective.

description.zh: 提升使用镰刀、斧与剑时的攻击力，并附加 HP 汲取。
description.en: Increases attack with scythes, axes, and swords, while adding HP siphon.

description.zh: 提高移动速度、完美闪避与法术闪避。
description.en: Increases Move Speed, Perfect Dodge, and Spell Dodge.

description.zh: 使用盾牌时，提高格挡率与防御能力。
description.en: Improves Block Chance and defenses while using a shield.

description.zh: 黑封书页教暗影毫不拖泥带水地终结虚弱目标。
description.en: A black-bound page teaches shadows to finish weakened targets without ceremony.

description.zh: 三枚元素封印留下一道暗影标记，将命运系于目标。
description.en: Three elemental seals leave one shadowed mark, binding fate to the target.

description.zh: 精准笔划让每次消失与闪现都换来更凌厉的杀戮技法。
description.en: Precise strokes reward every vanish and blink with sharper killing discipline.

description.zh: 幽灵般的书页在隐匿即将消退之际释放完美时机。
description.en: Ghostly pages release perfect timing just as concealment slips away.

description.zh: 提高召唤物的攻击力、魔法攻击与抗性，使其更加强大。
description.en: Strengthens summons by increasing their Attack, Magic Attack, and resistance.

description.zh: 提升使用长矛、剑与钉头锤时的攻击力，并提高最大 HP。
description.en: Increases attack with spears, swords, and maces, while raising maximum HP.

description.zh: 提高弓类攻击力与 DEX。
description.en: Increases bow attack and DEX.

description.zh: 野兽般的笔记教会召唤物在兽群合围前先暴露敌人的弱点。
description.en: Bestial notes teach summons to expose weakness before the pack closes in.

description.zh: 黑暗流动在文字间盘旋，从每一道暴烈法术中拖出诅咒。
description.en: Dark currents swirl through the text, dragging curses from every violent spell.

description.zh: 一道沉重仪式将敌人向内拖拽，随后由深井以不协和之音作出回应。
description.en: A heavy rite pulls enemies inward before the well answers with dissonance.

description.zh: 柔和的风之文字通过召唤魔法传递治疗回响，以及令敌人沉默的压迫。
description.en: Soft wind-script carries healing echoes and silencing pressure through summoned magic.

description.zh: 明亮共鸣在主人与召唤物之间低鸣，将支援化作共享力量。
description.en: Bright resonance hums between master and summon, turning support into shared might.

description.zh: 相连的诗句把灵魂与法术系在一起，让每一次灵魂打击延伸得更远。
description.en: Linked verses bind spirit to spell, stretching each soul strike farther.

description.zh: 让召唤出的盟友继承你更多的属性。
description.en: Allows summoned allies to inherit more of your attributes.

description.zh: 使用双手武器时，提高格挡能力。
description.en: Improves your ability to block while using two-handed weapons.

description.zh: 提升使用法杖、书籍与剑时的魔法攻击，并提高施法速度。
description.en: Increases Magic Attack with staffs, books, and swords, while improving Cast Speed.

description.zh: 锈红色路线追随着陷入眩晕的猎物，引导沉重弧击落向脆弱的伤口。
description.en: Rust-red maps follow stunned prey, guiding heavy arcs toward vulnerable wounds.

description.zh: 钝重的战士教义要求每一次冲锋都震撼下颌、守势与勇气。
description.en: Blunt warrior doctrine teaches every charge to leave jaws, guards, and courage shaken.

description.zh: 一本残酷的手册，教人把敌人拖入饥渴钢铁的攻击范围。
description.en: A brutal manual for dragging foes into the hungry reach of steel.

description.zh: 染满痛苦的书页教会生存本能在生命垂危时大声讨价还价。
description.en: Pain-stained pages teach survival to bargain loudly when health runs low.

description.zh: 一张伤痕累累的路线图，将旋转的暴力化作防护与减速压制。
description.en: A scarred route map turns spinning violence into protection and slowing pressure.

description.zh: 交错丝线将抗性、嘲讽与耐心反击编入同一套守御纹样。
description.en: Interlaced threads teach resistance, taunts, and patient punishment in one guarded pattern.

description.zh: 柔和丝线将防护与治疗编织成守护者沉稳的纹样。
description.en: Gentle threads bind protection and healing into a guardian's steady pattern.

description.zh: 奥术丝线低声鸣响，将护盾法术与受控魔力编织在一起。
description.en: Arcane threads hum with shielding spells and controlled magical force.

description.zh: 狂烈丝线将烟雾、怒火与近身战斗打结成一套鲁莽纹样。
description.en: Fierce threads knot smoke, fury, and close combat into one reckless pattern.

description.zh: 绷紧的丝线引导陷阱与不稳定弩矢，射向远处脆弱的目标。
description.en: Taut threads guide traps and volatile bolts toward distant vulnerable targets.

description.zh: 提高攻击力、魔法攻击与所有属性，并使技能能够溅射至附近敌人。
description.en: Increases Attack, Magic Attack, all attributes, and lets skills splash nearby enemies.

description.zh: 风暴沉重地压在书页上，将连锁闪电凝聚为次数更少、威力更强的神圣雷击。
description.en: Storm-heavy pages condense chain lightning into fewer, harsher divine strikes.

description.zh: 过载笔记让闪电通过突如其来的雷击再次释放自身力量。
description.en: Overcharged notes let lightning spend itself again through sudden thunderbolts.

description.zh: 中央那幅沉静图示教会闪电在离去前先致盲目标。
description.en: A calm diagram in the center teaches lightning to blind before leaving.

description.zh: 写于岩石之上的符文让土墙屹立得足够长久，以减缓追击。
description.en: Stone-written runes keep earthen walls standing long enough to slow pursuit.

description.zh: 严苛的奥术笔记牺牲施法舒适度，换取更锐利、更沉重的法术冲击。
description.en: Strict arcane notes trade casting comfort for sharper, heavier spell impact.

description.zh: 蓝色文字回响着每一次施法，在其后留下仍在低鸣的备用魔力。
description.en: Blue script echoes every cast, leaving spare mana humming in its wake.

description.zh: 当化身之力汇聚在施法者周围时，元素符印会升起对应的屏障。
description.en: Elemental sigils raise matching barriers whenever avatar power gathers around the caster.

description.zh: Tempest 与 Chain Lightning 会累积 Tempest Engine，提高其威力与 MP 消耗。Chain Lightning 还会触发 Thunder Storm。
description.en: Tempest and Chain Lightning build Tempest Engine, increasing their power and MP cost. Chain Lightning also triggers Thunder Storm.

description.zh: 冻结的持续时间延长。Blizzard 与 Ice Shard 可以生成 Frozen Ground。
description.en: Frozen lasts longer. Blizzard and Ice Shard can create Frozen Ground.

description.zh: 灼烧或眩晕会触发 Combustion。Fire Pillar 获得更多作用次数，Meteor 则会变为 Meteor Storm。
description.en: Burning or Stun triggers Combustion. Fire Pillar gains more instances, and Meteor becomes Meteor Storm.

description.zh: 一副红蓝双色眼镜，会让你的视野变得模糊。你根本不知道它能拿来做什么。
description.en: A set of red and blue glasses that makes your vision blurry. You have no idea what they could be used for.

description.zh: 紫色水晶碎片环绕着一柄被寂静触碰的刀刃缓缓漂浮。
description.en: Purple crystal fragments drift around a blade touched by silence.

description.zh: 泛着柔光的经文将慈悲化作庇护伤者的屏障。
description.en: Softly glowing scripture turns mercy into shelter for the wounded.

description.zh: 镀金书页催促每一次攻击向前，直到信念凝成光辉。
description.en: Gilded pages urge each strike onward until faith hardens into radiance.

description.zh: 明亮的诗句将圣光磨砺成审判，萦绕在虔诚信徒身旁。
description.en: Bright verses sharpen holy light into judgment that lingers around the faithful.

description.zh: 温柔的圣歌写满书页，让每一次治疗祷告都加深恩典。
description.en: Gentle hymns fill the pages, deepening grace with every healing prayer.

description.zh: 交织的诗篇让圣光比寻常祷告更快、更纯净，也能传得更远。
description.en: Threaded verses bend holy light faster, cleaner, and farther than ordinary prayer.

description.zh: 节律严谨的赞美诗让双手保持稳定，使治疗魔法以完美节奏流转。
description.en: Measured psalms keep hands steady and healing magic moving in perfect cadence.

description.zh: 绳索、工具和水壶，为那些固执的流浪者准备。
description.en: Rope, tools, and a canteen for stubborn wanderers.

description.zh: 干粮、工具和饱经风尘的补给塞得满满当当。
description.en: Packed tight with rations, tools, and road-worn supplies.

description.zh: 丝滑的橙色缎带，温暖得如同充满希望的朝阳。
description.en: Silky orange ribbon, warm as a hopeful sunrise.

description.zh: 抛光琥珀捕捉光线，泛起柔和的落日余辉。
description.en: Polished amber catches light with a soft sunset glow.

description.zh: 神秘结界在抛光的宝石徽饰下方发光。
description.en: Mystic wards glow beneath a polished jeweled crest.

description.zh: 奥术接缝牵引魔力，如同寒霜从空气中抽走呼吸。
description.en: Arcane seams draw mana like frost pulling breath from air.

description.zh: 星光附魔稳住每一步，让娴熟的施法从容展开。
description.en: Starlit enchantments steady every step through practiced spellwork.

description.zh: 当魔法知晓该流向何处时，谨慎的双手也会动作得更快。
description.en: Careful hands move faster when magic knows where to flow.

description.zh: 符文织物让动作、平衡与施法保持同一节奏。
description.en: Runed fabric keeps motion, balance, and spellwork in rhythm.

description.zh: 光滑的木珠在放箭前稳住持弓之手。
description.en: Smooth wooden beads steady the hand before release.

description.zh: 流线型甲片减少阻力，带着穿戴者穿行于战场。
description.en: Flowing plates carry the wearer through battle with less resistance.

description.zh: 精制护甲磨砺动作，使每一击即使承受压力也能干净命中。
description.en: Refined armor sharpens movement until each strike lands cleanly under pressure.

description.zh: 奥术丝线在甲片间低鸣，引导隐秘知识显现于外。
description.en: Arcane threads hum through the plating, guiding hidden knowledge outward.

description.zh: 细微的护符礼貌地扭转运气。
description.en: Subtle charms bend luck politely.

description.zh: 强化护甲将纯粹力量导入每一次坚定向前的攻击。
description.en: Reinforced armor channels raw might through every committed strike forward.

description.zh: 层叠钢甲经得住艰难、攻城风雨，以及大多数馊主意。
description.en: Layered steel outlasts hardship, siege weather, and most bad ideas.

description.zh: 箭矢多得足以让这份自信显得合情合理。
description.en: Enough arrows to make confidence feel reasonable.

description.zh: 铁壁记得每一支未能穿透它的箭。
description.en: Iron remembers every arrow that failed to pass.

description.zh: 古老的箭矢仍沉睡在它伤痕累累的木板中。
description.en: Old arrows still sleep in its battered wood.

description.zh: 一把受无形之手祝福的弓。箭矢飞得又准又远，以任何盾牌都无法完全抵挡的精度命中目标。
description.en: A bow blessed by unseen hands. Its arrows fly true and far, striking with precision no shield can fully deny.

description.zh: 冰冷的脉络在斧中搏动，所过之处只留下寂静。
description.en: Frozen veins pulse through an axe that leaves only silence behind.

description.zh: “每段传奇，都始于一件既能劈开木头，也能劈开麻烦的工具。” — Suphara
description.en: “Every legend starts with a tool that can split wood and trouble alike.” — Suphara

description.zh: 注意：请勿用它与其他鹿角相撞。这对鹿角是用来引导世界中的自然能量的。
description.en: Caution: Do not use to clash against other antlers. Instead these antlers are used to draw in the natural energies of the world.

description.zh: 水晶般的蓝色锋缘将思绪磨砺为专注的力量。
description.en: Crystalline blue edges sharpen thought into focused power.

description.zh: “刃上有风，背后有水。稳稳架开，再朝潮水断裂之处劈下。” — Suphara
description.en: “Wind on the edge, water at your back. Parry steady, then cut where the tide breaks.” — Suphara

description.zh: 钴蓝纹路以简洁的形态约束着严谨的法术力量。
description.en: Cobalt lines hold disciplined spell power in simple form.

description.zh: 专注从内部点亮每一块蓝色切面。
description.en: Focus brightens each blue facet from within.

description.zh: 用来存放许多东西。它生来就是替你背负重担的。
description.en: Used to store many things. It is designed to carry your burdens.

description.zh: 皮革紧紧缠绕，足以应付尘土、麻烦和仓促逃亡。
description.en: Leather wrapped tight for dust, trouble, and quick escapes.

description.zh: 橙色布幡标示着众人追随之人。
description.en: Orange cloth marks the one others follow.

description.zh: 一只明亮的眼睛从这个受诅咒的小伙伴身上注视着一切。
description.en: One bright eye watches from a cursed little companion.

description.zh: 一根红色羽饰标志着麻烦燃起的第一点火星。
description.en: A red plume marks the first spark of trouble.

description.zh: 熊形软垫以沉静的力量替你背负重担。
description.en: Bear-shaped padding carries burdens with quiet strength.

description.zh: 这只毛绒小熊轻轻抱住你的脑袋；防护不多，魅力十足。
description.en: This plush little cub gently hugs your head; little armor, plenty of charm.

description.zh: 獠牙与白骨将恐惧铸成头盔。
description.en: Fangs and bone turn fear into a helm.

description.zh: 大张的兽口让这顶兜帽看起来饥肠辘辘。
description.en: Gaping jaws make this hood look hungry.

description.zh: 粗犷兽皮紧贴包裹，野性而不受驯服。
description.en: Rugged hide wraps close, wild and untamed.

description.zh: 原始力量在狂野甲片间搏动，迫不及待地迎接冲锋。
description.en: Raw power beats through the wild plates, eager for the charge.

description.zh: 撕裂的战斗书页教会每一声呐喊将勇气传得更远。
description.en: Torn battle pages teach every shout to carry courage farther.

description.zh: 血红墨迹在书页上狂乱翻腾，渴求下一次暴击。
description.en: Blood-red ink thrashes across the page, hungry for the next critical strike.

description.zh: 狂野笔记让每个倒下的敌人都化作冲势、怒火与可怕的专注。
description.en: Savage notes reward every fallen foe with momentum, fury, and terrible focus.

description.zh: 一本阴郁的手册，教你在虚弱敌人苟延残喘时彻底斩断犹豫。
description.en: A grim manual for ending hesitation when weakened enemies stand too long.

description.zh: 这双沾满尘土的靴子大步向前，仿佛撤退还欠它们钱。
description.en: These gritty boots stomp forward like retreat owes them money.

description.zh: 粗犷的护甲不断向前，把谨慎远远落在穿戴者身后。
description.en: Rugged armor pushes forward, leaving caution somewhere behind the wearer.

description.zh: “把死者绑紧点，小子。然后让他们比活着时回应得更快、打得更狠。” — Suphara
description.en: “Bind the dead tight, lad. Then let them answer faster and hit harder than they did in life.” — Suphara

description.zh: 蓝与金高高耸起，适合庄严的仪式。
description.en: Blue and gold rise tall for solemn rites.

description.zh: 乌黑的钢铁在每一场难看的战斗后依然可靠。
description.en: Dark steel stays reliable after every ugly fight.

description.zh: 在光与影融为一体的夜之花园中锻造。据说它的锋刃锐利到足以将人与其影子斩离，而剑柄的温暖则能安抚使用者的伤口。
description.en: Forged in the night garden when light and shadow become one. It is said that its edge is sharp enough to sever one from their shadow, while the hilt's warmth soothes the user's wounds.

description.zh: 剑形旌旗让勇气更容易追随。
description.en: Sword-shaped banners make courage easier to follow.

description.zh: 视线闭合；更深的专注由此开启。
description.en: Sight closes; deeper focus opens.

description.zh: 一枚小巧的尖牙护符，象征狡黠与胆识。
description.en: A small fang charm worn for cunning and nerve.

description.zh: 一枚带刺的心形护符，跳动得过于温热。
description.en: A spiked heart charm that pulses too warmly.

description.zh: 猩红裹带随着每一次挥击紧抓生命不放。
description.en: Crimson wraps cling to life with every strike.

description.zh: “武器就该在黑暗中绽放，姑娘。让敌人猜猜，为什么夜色突然长出了牙。” — Suphara
description.en: “A weapon should bloom in the dark, lass. Let the enemy wonder why the night suddenly has teeth.” — Suphara

description.zh: 橙色花瓣即使历经恶劣天气，依然留存暖意。
description.en: Orange petals keep their warmth through harsh weather.

description.zh: 花瓣形护符明亮得足以振奋疲惫的心灵。
description.en: Petal-shaped charm bright enough to lift tired spirits.

description.zh: 魔力脉络在抛光的蓝色甲壳上微微闪烁。
description.en: Mana channels glimmer across a polished blue shell.

description.zh: “细活自有细活的用处。这个可不讲究那些。” — Suphara
description.en: “Subtle work has its place. This is not that place.” — Suphara

description.zh: 背在身后的轰然巨响。不稳定、够显眼，而且多半是故意的。
description.en: Back-mounted kaboom. Unstable, flashy, probably intentional.

description.zh: 圣骨低鸣着遗忘仪式遗留的魔力。
description.en: Sacred bone hums with magic from forgotten rites.

description.zh: 锯齿般的尖牙为一场成功狩猎的回忆加冕。
description.en: Jagged fangs crown the memory of a successful hunt.

description.zh: 一柄由枯木与白骨制成的脆弱匕首，迫不及待想碎裂成幽灵长矛。
description.en: A brittle dagger of deadwood and bone, eager to splinter into spectral spears.

description.zh: 獠牙与骨髓留下久久无法平息的伤口。
description.en: Fang and marrow leave wounds that refuse to rest.

description.zh: “好好敲上一棍，能纠正不少坏规矩。” — Suphara
description.en: “A proper bonk can fix many manners.” — Suphara

description.zh: 工业级的重量把铠甲和自尊一起砸成废料。
description.en: Industrial weight turns armor and egos into scrap.

description.zh: Skycloth 为专为迅捷施法打造的轻甲收边。
description.en: Skycloth trims light armor made for quick casting.

description.zh: 羽毛般轻柔的凉鞋让每一步都更加轻快。
description.en: Feather-soft sandals quicken each step.

description.zh: 风线织就的短裤让每一步都轻盈自如。
description.en: Wind-threaded shorts keep every stride light.

description.zh: 焦黑绑带牢牢束住一柄专为粗暴活计打造的砍刀。
description.en: Charred bindings hold a cleaver made for brutal work.

description.zh: 王家卫兵所用的钢刃，朴素而可靠。
description.en: Royal guard steel, plain and reliable.

description.zh: 扭曲的青铜随着日光消退而发出微弱低鸣。
description.en: Warped bronze hums faintly as daylight fades.

description.zh: 沉重青铜，朴实坚韧，不浪费半点华饰。
description.en: Heavy bronze, simple grit, no wasted glamour.

description.zh: 沉静的青铜遮住面容，也守住其中的秘密。
description.en: Stoic bronze hides the face and keeps its secrets.

description.zh: 软乎乎、轻飘飘，而且莫名受到年轻冒险者的追捧。
description.en: Squishy, buoyant, and suspiciously popular with young adventurers.

description.zh: 轻便的防护，适合想留出活动空间的战士。
description.en: Light shielding for fighters who prefer room to move.

description.zh: 红布与骄傲的犄角许诺着力量与守护。
description.en: Red cloth and proud horn promise strength and protection.

description.zh: 长耳朵、柔软口袋，还有多得过头的天真无邪。
description.en: Long ears, soft pockets, and far too much innocence.

description.zh: 月兔耳朵让轻快的脚步显得更加迅捷。
description.en: Moon-rabbit ears make quick feet feel quicker.

description.zh: 一缕幽灵精华被囚禁在扭曲的牢笼中。它的光芒忽明忽暗，如同渴望自由的灵魂。
description.en: A spectral essence trapped within a twisted cage. Its glow flickers like a soul yearning for freedom.

description.zh: 纸板做成的勇气英勇地直视前方，尽管它很清楚自己究竟是什么做的。
description.en: Cardboard courage stares forward bravely, despite knowing exactly what it is made of.

description.zh: 抛光金属与骄傲的红色羽冠承载着古老帝国的纪律。
description.en: Polished metal and a proud red plume carry old imperial discipline.

description.zh: 一副用于古老仪式的华丽面具。据说能驱除邪灵。
description.en: An ornate mask used in ancient rituals. Rumored to ward off evil spirits.

description.zh: “别只顾着把武器挥向敌人。挥动它，也是为了保护身后围成一圈的人。” — Suphara
description.en: “Do not just swing for your enemies. Swing to protect the circle of folk standing behind you.” — Suphara

description.zh: “寒意沿着锁链传得最快。施放一次，让它自己去找下一个蠢货。” — Suphara
description.en: “Cold travels best in chains. Cast once, and let it find the next fool.” — Suphara

description.zh: 沉重锁链解决了灵体在战斗结束前擅自离场的问题。
description.en: Heavy chains solve the problem of spirits leaving before the battle ends.

description.zh: “圣刃终究也是钢，小子。你的手臂若没力气，信仰也无济于事。” — Suphara
description.en: “A holy blade is still steel, lad. Faith only matters if your arm does too.” — Suphara

description.zh: “别想着号令混沌。给它开个锋，然后站到它后面去。” — Suphara
description.en: “Do not command chaos. Give it an edge and stand behind it.” — Suphara

description.zh: 由勇敢（或糊涂）的家禽骑士佩戴。意外地耐用。
description.en: Worn by the brave (or confused) poultry knights. Surprisingly durable.

description.zh: 一只害羞的小鸡紧贴着坐在你头上。它的温暖莫名令人安心。
description.en: A bashful chick sits snugly on your head. Its warmth is oddly soothing.

description.zh: 那些牙齿可不是装饰，而这恰恰正是让所有人担心的地方。
description.en: Those teeth are not decorative, which is exactly what worries everyone.

description.zh: 这只沙漏计时糟透了，但魔法坚持说这是故意的。
description.en: The hourglass keeps terrible time, but the magic insists that is intentional.

description.zh: 金色丝线温暖着长袍，让轻柔的手势化作无声慰藉。
description.en: Golden thread warms the robes, turning gentle gestures into quiet comfort.

description.zh: 柔光追随着每一步，仿佛祈祷总是走在前方半步。
description.en: Soft glow follows each step, like prayers walking slightly ahead.

description.zh: 淡色亚麻与复苏符文承载着走向受伤盟友的沉稳步伐。
description.en: Pale linen and renewal runes carry steady steps toward wounded allies.

description.zh: 柔雾缠绕着圆环，飘忽得像是错过了一场会议。
description.en: Soft fog curls around the loop, drifting like it missed a meeting.

description.zh: 镀金书页灼热发光，足以烧灼阴影并稳固信仰。
description.en: Gilded pages glow hot enough to sear shadows and steady faith.

description.zh: 饱经风霜的经文，保存着第一声向苍穹唱出的祷告。
description.en: Weathered scripture that holds the first prayer sung toward the heavens.

description.zh: “以光书写真理，就连古老的黑暗也得眨眼。” — Suphara
description.en: “Write truth in light, and even old darkness has to blink.” — Suphara

description.zh: “我抄下了 Umbra 的诅咒，但没把它们全部的饥渴也抄进去。只有当你准备好让黑暗回应时，才把它打开。” — Suphara
description.en: “I copied Umbra’s curses, not their full hunger. Open it only when you are ready for the dark to answer.” — Suphara

description.zh: “我尽力抄下了 Vitae 的光。它能修补血肉，稳住生者。愿它护送你走向胜利。” — Suphara
description.en: “I copied Vitae’s light as best I could. It mends flesh and steadies the living. May it carry you to victory.” — Suphara

description.zh: 一本朴素的皮革封面书籍，记载着常见祷文。外观虽不起眼，却能将使用者的专注引导为温和的辅助魔法。
description.en: A simple leather-bound book inscribed with common prayers. While plain in form, it channels the user's focus into gentle support magic.

description.zh: “花哨的刀能赢来喝彩。朴素的刀能赢下战斗。磨快它，带近些，让那个蠢货先流血。” — Suphara
description.en: “Fancy blades win praise. Plain ones win fights. Keep it sharp, keep it close, and let the fool bleed first.” — Suphara

description.zh: 灰尘、喷嚏和巷子里难闻的怪味，都遇上了柔软棉布这个对手。
description.en: Dust, sneezes, and awkward alley smells meet their soft cotton rival.

description.zh: 当战斗容不得半分犹豫时，金色羽毛便绽放出最耀眼的光芒。
description.en: Golden feathers flare brightest when combat leaves no room for hesitation.

description.zh: 第一件武器尚未挥动，红宝石般的羽毛便已吸引所有目光。
description.en: Ruby feathers draw every eye before the first weapon moves.

description.zh: 竞技场冠军戴着这顶王冠，因为舒适显然输掉了争论。
description.en: Arena champions wore this crown because comfort clearly lost the argument.

description.zh: “既然审判必须降临，就确保它落得够准。” — Suphara
description.en: “If judgment must fall, make sure it falls with good aim.” — Suphara

description.zh: 这些 Paladins 背弃誓言后，不再担任守护者，而是化身征伐者，将圣术磨砺成对付敌人的利器。
description.en: After breaking their oaths, these Paladins turned from protectors to crusaders and honed their holy arts against their enemies.

description.zh: Mana 石在里面叮当作响，让每一步听起来都贵了几分。
description.en: Mana stones rattle inside, making every step sound slightly more expensive.

description.zh: “有些锤子能碎石。这只小怪物连周围的空间都能砸碎。” — Suphara
description.en: “Some hammers break stone. This wee monster breaks the space around it.” — Suphara

description.zh: 元素色彩流淌于翼状碎片之间，闪烁着沉静的力量。
description.en: Elemental color runs through winglike shards, shimmering with quiet power.

description.zh: 圣纸能让灵体退避，前提是没人把它倒着贴。
description.en: Sacred paper keeps spirits away, provided nobody sticks it upside down.

description.zh: 锁扣正轻轻呼吸，而大多数图书管理员都认为这问题非常严重。
description.en: The lock breathes faintly, which most librarians consider a serious problem.

description.zh: 双刃静静等待着，因为太吵的匕首通常保不住自己的饭碗。
description.en: Twin blades wait quietly, because loud daggers rarely keep their jobs.

description.zh: 鸦黑羽毛伴着低语展开，听起来像个坏消息。
description.en: Raven-black feathers spread with a whisper that sounds like bad news.

description.zh: 焦黑兽皮将闷热紧贴肌肤，催动指间的血液更快流转。
description.en: Blackened hide keeps dull heat close, quickening blood beneath the fingers.

description.zh: 每一颗珠子都封存着日出时立下的誓言，被耐心的双手磨得光滑。
description.en: Each bead holds a sunrise vow, worn smooth by patient hands.

description.zh: “晨光本来很温柔，直到你给它锻上尖刺。” — Suphara
description.en: “Morning light is gentle until you forge spikes into it.” — Suphara

description.zh: 一柄沐浴初光的匕首，将钢铁与法术技艺平衡得如同黎明划分长夜般利落。
description.en: A first-light dagger that balances steel and spellcraft as cleanly as dawn divides night.

description.zh: 这抹笑容同等执着地让敌人、朋友和镜子都感到不安。
description.en: This grin unsettles enemies, friends, and mirrors with equal commitment.

description.zh: 那双发光的眼睛许诺着恶作剧、糟糕决定，以及绝无半点歉意。
description.en: Those glowing eyes promise mischief, bad decisions, and absolutely no apologies.

description.zh: 紫色犄角低语着黑暗野心，随后假装自己什么都没说。
description.en: Violet horns whisper dark ambition, then pretend they said nothing.

description.zh: 纯粹的毁灭专注会烧穿防御，但持有者也要为每一次捷径付出代价。
description.en: Raw destructive focus burns through defenses, though the wielder pays for every shortcut.

description.zh: 不只用来装水；固执的矿工也需要随身携带一点希望。
description.en: Not just for water; stubborn miners require portable hope, too.

description.zh: 蓝色鳞片、小巧魅力与史前收纳空间，让负担不再那么无聊。
description.en: Blue scales, tiny charm, and prehistoric storage make burdens less boring.

description.zh: 朴素的护腕带有许多插槽，等待一名弟子亲手决定自己的道路。
description.en: Plain bracers with many slots, waiting for a disciple to define their path.

description.zh: 未经装饰的训练布料，为通过谨慎准备所选择的力量留出空间。
description.en: Unadorned training cloth leaves room for power chosen through careful preparation.

description.zh: 沉静的步伐承载着尚在决定自己将成为什么之人的自律。
description.en: Quiet steps carry the discipline of someone still deciding what they will become.

description.zh: 一张朴素的面容遮住不确定，也为未来的诸多答案留出余地。
description.en: A simple visage masks uncertainty while leaving room for many future answers.

description.zh: 层叠裹布在练习、失误与初见雏形的精通中始终稳固。
description.en: Layered wraps hold steady through practice, mistakes, and the first shape of mastery.

description.zh: 锐利棱角与学者工艺，让武艺专注始终近在手边。
description.en: Sharp angles and scholar craft keep martial focus close at hand.

description.zh: 焦黑钢铁弯成宽阔弧线，让每一次挥击都承载着阴沉重量。
description.en: Blackened steel curves wide, carrying grim weight through every swing.

description.zh: 悔恨般黯黑的金属与猩红尖刺，让背叛也显得像一场仪式。
description.en: Regret-dark metal and a crimson spike make betrayal feel ceremonial.

description.zh: 骷髅标签在任何人追问之前，就已经回答了大多数问题。
description.en: The skull label answers most questions before anyone asks twice.

description.zh: 两个带刺锤头，意味着砸碎坚硬事物时拥有双倍的热情。
description.en: Two spiked heads mean twice the enthusiasm for breaking hard things.

description.zh: 鳞甲恶狠狠地瞪向前方，让附近的礼貌交谈变得困难许多。
description.en: Scaled plates glare forward, making polite conversations much harder nearby.

description.zh: 锯齿状鳞尖将古老龙怒灌注进每一次突刺。
description.en: A jagged scale-point channels old draconic fury through each thrust.

description.zh: 这顶头盔散发着屠龙般的自信，即使那份自信需要另行配备。
description.en: This helm suggests dragon-slaying confidence, even when confidence came separately.

description.zh: 蝙蝠倒挂着打盹，贡献出不祥气息，以及偶尔的一点用处。
description.en: The bat naps upside-down, contributing ominous vibes and occasional usefulness.

description.zh: 一只困倦的鼹鼠在头顶筑巢，等着以专业手法扬起泥土。
description.en: A sleepy mole nests overhead, waiting to throw dirt professionally.

description.zh: 那只得意洋洋的小风暴猫趴在那里，完全知道自己看起来很重要。
description.en: Smug little storm cat rests there, fully aware it looks important.

description.zh: 花朵困倦地低垂着，随后想起战斗还在继续，便出手相助。
description.en: The blossom droops sleepily, then remembers battle is happening and helps.

description.zh: 这只小狗暖洋洋地打着盹，直到危险准许它放声吠叫。
description.en: This pup snoozes warmly until danger gives it barking permission.

description.zh: 两把刀并肩而行，因为一次戏剧性的登场显然还不够。
description.en: Two blades ride together, because one dramatic entrance was not enough.

description.zh: “黑暗并不怯懦。它只是知道该在什么时候咬下去。” — Suphara
description.en: “The dark is not cowardly. It just knows when to bite.” — Suphara

description.zh: 沙砾啃噬了帽檐，可这顶帽子依旧骄傲得令人恼火。
description.en: Sand chewed the brim, but the hat remains annoyingly proud.

description.zh: “要是大地非得抱怨，就让它在敌人脚下抱怨。” — Suphara
description.en: “If the ground must complain, make sure it complains under their feet.” — Suphara

description.zh: “让大地稳稳托住你；无论岩石还是山峦，它都会助你站定。” — Suphara
description.en: “Let the earth hold you firm; it will steady you through rock and stone.” — Suphara

description.zh: “在黑暗察觉你已离开之前，先把影子掷出去。” — Suphara
description.en: “Throw the shadow before the darkness knows you’re gone.” — Suphara

description.zh: 光与影交织于双刃之间，以完美的节奏切割一切。
description.en: Light and shadow braid through twin edges, cutting in perfect rhythm.

description.zh: 蜡封将药液牢牢封住，既防泄漏，也防可疑的偷尝。
description.en: Wax seals the brew tightly, preventing leaks and suspicious taste tests.

description.zh: 红色双眼从残酷的兽皮中怒视，因更加阴暗的野心而升温。
description.en: Red eyes glare from cruel hide, warmed by darker ambitions.

description.zh: 一颗燃烧的宝石在顶端闪耀，迫不及待地渴望火焰。
description.en: A burning gem shines at the top, eager for flame.

description.zh: 一枚翠绿宝石柔化了金色的威严，使其尊贵却不失温暖。
description.en: One verdant gem softens the gold, regal without losing warmth.

description.zh: 校准后的魔力沿刃缘分流，迸裂成元素力量。
description.en: Calibrated mana splits along the edge, breaking into elemental force.

description.zh: 彼此对立的力量在禁忌之刃中交汇。
description.en: Opposing forces meet inside the forbidden edge.

description.zh: 色彩沿刃缘变幻，以不同威胁回应每一片战场。
description.en: Color shifts along the edge, answering each battlefield with a different threat.

description.zh: “你若任由寒冬停留，大地便归它所有。种下霜冻，让他们付出代价。” — Suphara
description.en: “Winter owns the ground if you let it stay. Plant the frost and make them pay.” — Suphara

description.zh: “仁慈自有其位置。干净利落地结束麻烦也是如此。” — Suphara
description.en: “Mercy has its place. So does ending a problem cleanly.” — Suphara

description.zh: 一本刻有古老经文的圣化典籍。书中文字如涟漪般向外扩散，赐福盟友，并以久久不散的圣光净除邪祟。
description.en: A sanctified tome etched with ancient scripture. Its words ripple outward, blessing allies and scouring the unholy with lingering light.

description.zh: 神圣封印盘绕在法杖上，将耐心的仪式化作迅捷的驱魔术。
description.en: Holy seals coil around the staff, turning patient rites into swift exorcism.

description.zh: 铺盖卷、绑带和多得过头的口袋，专为那些可疑的捷径做好准备。
description.en: Bedroll, straps, and too many pockets prepare for questionable shortcuts.

description.zh: 这只眼睛注视着一切，包括那些你希望它没看见的选择。
description.en: The eye watches everything, including choices you hoped it missed.
