description.zh: 一只眼睛休息，另一只则负责处理附近的名声问题。
description.en: One eye rests while the other handles reputation management nearby.

description.zh: 锐利的目光寄居于此，连同一套异常强烈的鸟类意见。
description.en: Sharp sight lives here, along with very strong bird opinions.

description.zh: 羽毛塑成这顶兜帽，适合那些喜欢摆出评判神情的斥候。
description.en: Feathers shape the hood for scouts who enjoy looking judgmental.

description.zh: 一枚小小的尖牙贴身垂挂，因为含蓄的威胁也依然算数。
description.en: A small fang hangs close, because subtle threats still count.

description.zh: 月色的黑暗覆上弯刃，同时啜饮鲜血与魔力。
description.en: Lunar darkness coats the curve, drinking blood and mana together.

description.zh: 翡翠羽饰从王冠上高高扬起，闪耀着古老森林仪典的光辉。
description.en: Jade plumes rise from the crown, bright with old forest ceremony.

description.zh: 轻盈羽毛偏爱迅捷的信使，以及任何正在户外逃避后果的人。
description.en: Light feathers favor quick messengers and anyone fleeing consequences outdoors.

description.zh: 轻巧鞋底偏爱敏捷、慌乱，以及最后一刻做出的绝妙决定。
description.en: Lightweight soles favor agility, panic, and excellent last-second decisions.

description.zh: 平衡的鞋底让瞄准保持稳定，即使慌乱提出了不同意见。
description.en: Balanced soles keep aim steady, even when panic suggests otherwise.

description.zh: 轻便的鞋子能让思绪清明，但依然要求你自己走路。
description.en: Light shoes will clear the mind but still expect you to walk.

description.zh: 当这双鞋决定帮忙时，麻烦往往更容易扑空。
description.en: Trouble misses more often when these shoes decide to help.

description.zh: 为支撑纯粹肉体力量而设计的朴素鞋履。
description.en: Simple footwear designed to support raw physical strength.

description.zh: 坚实鞋底支撑漫长战斗，即使疲劳迟迟不肯结束。
description.en: Sturdy soles support long fights when strain refuses to end.

description.zh: 附魔蕨叶柔化了动作，仿佛连灌木丛都在出手相助。
description.en: Enchanted fronds soften movement until the underbrush seems to help.

description.zh: 鲜红布料带来庆典、欢笑，以及一点点来自帽子的自信。
description.en: Bright red cloth brings celebration, cheer, and mild hat confidence.

description.zh: 爆竹欢快地噼啪作响，让敌人认真反思自己刚才在附近做出的几个决定。
description.en: Firecrackers crackle happily, making enemies question several nearby decisions properly.

description.zh: 乌龟饰物与流苏许诺着好运、耐心，以及一段欢乐时光。
description.en: Turtle charm and tassels promise luck, patience, and a great time.

description.zh: 缎带看起来喜气洋洋，但盒里的叮当声依旧十分可疑。
description.en: The ribbon looks cheerful, but the jingling remains suspicious.

description.zh: “别惧怕火焰。教会它守规矩。” — Suphara
description.en: “Do not fear the flame. Teach fire to behave.” — Suphara

description.zh: 温暖的犄角不安地闪烁，像余烬正在认真排练华丽登场。
description.en: Warm horns flicker restlessly, like embers practicing dramatic entrances properly.

description.zh: 这些刀刃刻有烈焰封印，出手时会爆发火焰，在一片烈火中灼烧敌人。
description.en: Engraved with fiery seals, these blades erupt with bursts of flame, scorching enemies in a splash of fire.

description.zh: “小小的刀刃，也能点燃一场燎原大火。” — Suphara
description.en: “A small blade can still start a wild fire.” — Suphara

description.zh: 这条加垫长裤专为长途信使与敏捷盗贼裁制，无论跑得多远、多快，都不会磨伤皮肤，始终透气舒适。
description.en: Tailored for long-distance messengers and nimble thieves, these padded pants never chafe and always breathe, no matter how far or fast you run.

description.zh: 老旧金属、响亮意见与糟糕透顶的隐蔽性，共用着同一根枪管。
description.en: Old metal, loud opinions, and terrible subtlety share one barrel.

description.zh: 皮革与石块让身体沉静下来，随后专注向内收紧。
description.en: Leather and stone settle the body before attention sharpens inward.

description.zh: 树叶与根须骄傲地坐在头顶，因为大自然也喜欢配饰。
description.en: Leaves and roots sit proudly overhead, because nature enjoys accessories.

description.zh: 叶片缝制的护甲蕴含柔和的复苏之力，以森林般的耐心庇护穿戴者。
description.en: Leaf-sewn armor carries soft renewal, sheltering the wearer with forest patience.

description.zh: 轻盈的叶编鞋让施法步伐在绿荫下保持迅捷而无声。
description.en: Light leafwork shoes keep spellsteps quick and quiet beneath green boughs.

description.zh: 活体纤维随着每一步呼吸，像雨水渗入根系般返还力量。
description.en: Living fibers breathe with each stride, returning strength like rain through roots.

description.zh: “Master Neoian 教会我要不断向前冲锋。我为追随他的人，也为第42 Paladin 军团的每一面盾牌，锻造了这道壁垒。” — Suphara
description.en: “Master Neoian taught me to keep charging forward. I forged this wall for those who follow him, and for every shield of the 42nd Paladin Legion.” — Suphara

description.zh: “先用寒意标记他们一次，之后的每一步都由你掌控。” — Suphara
description.en: “Mark them once with cold, and every step after belongs to you.” — Suphara

description.zh: “寒牙留下的教训最深。” — Suphara
description.en: “Cold teeth leave deep lessons.” — Suphara

description.zh: 寒气从头盔中渗出，让拥抱和糟糕决定都知难而退。
description.en: Cold energy leaks from the helm, discouraging hugs and poor choices.

description.zh: 苍白水晶让法杖冰冷刺骨，大概也会冻着你的手指。
description.en: Pale crystal chills the staff, and probably your fingers too.

description.zh: “只要教会寒冰守纪律，它就比钢铁更加锋利。” — Suphara
description.en: “Ice is sharper than steel when you teach it discipline.” — Suphara

description.zh: 绿色果实神秘地咔啦作响，挑衅着任何敢把它称作午餐的人。
description.en: Green fruit rattles mysteriously, daring anyone to call it lunch.

description.zh: 戴上它们后，你觉得隐私多了一点。现在你还拥有一撇令人印象深刻的八字胡。
description.en: You feel a bit more private with these on. You now have an impressive mustache.

description.zh: 一顶衬有厚实毛皮的兜帽。即使在最寒冷的地区，也能让穿戴者保持温暖。
description.en: A thick fur-lined hood. Keeps the wearer warm in the coldest regions.

description.zh: 如果你看得到这条信息，说明你离 Game Master 太近了。当心 Bonk！
description.en: If you can see this message, you are standing too close to the Game Master. Beware of Bonk!

description.zh: 旋转枪管会以响亮、反复且兴致勃勃的方式说明自己。
description.en: Rotating barrels explain themselves loudly, repeatedly, and with enthusiasm.

description.zh: 利落的蓝色格调表明：麻烦或许会找上门，但至少你穿得体面。
description.en: Sharp blue style says trouble may arrive, but properly dressed.

description.zh: 一个小幽灵飘在头顶，无声地评判着你的姿势。
description.en: A tiny specter floats overhead, judging your posture in silence.

description.zh: 每当危险临近，蓝色碎片便会在扭曲的法杖上发光。
description.en: Blue shards glow in the gnarled staff whenever danger draws near.

description.zh: 灵敏的手套紧随突发动作，在犹豫彻底追上来之前先行一步。
description.en: Responsive gloves follow sudden movement before hesitation catches up fully.

description.zh: 稳固的握持与精细的平衡，引导每一击精准命中。
description.en: Steady grip and refined balance guide each strike toward accuracy.

description.zh: 织物上镌刻的奥术纹路，将思绪引导为法术技艺。
description.en: Arcane patterns etched in their fabric channel thought into spellcraft.

description.zh: 幸运聚集在这双手套周围，尤其是在计划已经失败的时候。
description.en: Luck gathers around these gloves, especially when planning has failed.

description.zh: 每次沉重拳击之前，碾压般的力量都会汇聚于双手。
description.en: Crushing might gathers in the grip before each heavy punch.

description.zh: 沉重的双手平静承受惩罚，将冲击化作顽强的决心。
description.en: Heavy hands meet punishment calmly, turning impact into stubborn resolve.

description.zh: 狮面黄金等待勇气，而非胜利，将它唤醒。
description.en: Lion-faced gold waits for courage, not victory, to wake it.

description.zh: “黄金适合做精美首饰，不过用来砸裂铠甲时更好看。” — Suphara
description.en: “Gold makes for fine jewelry, but it looks better when it cracks armor.” — Suphara

description.zh: 抛光黄金在穿戴者证明自己之前，便先宣告冠军登场。
description.en: Polished gold announces the champion's presence before the wearer proves anything.

description.zh: 戴在头上轻若无物，却沉甸甸地承载着外界所有人的期待。
description.en: Light on the head, heavy with everyone else's expectations outside.

description.zh: “黄金很软。这把锤子可不软。” — Suphara
description.en: “Gold is soft. This hammer is not.” — Suphara

description.zh: 海盗、商人和过度自信的赌徒，都尊重闪亮的圆环。
description.en: Pirates, merchants, and overconfident gamblers all respect shiny circles.

description.zh: 那只手伸了出来；对陶器而言，这实在很没礼貌。
description.en: The hand reaches out, which is rude behavior for pottery.

description.zh: 苍白牙齿无声咬合，因为头盔根本不该长着一副下颌。
description.en: Pale teeth gnash silently, because helmets should not need jaws.

description.zh: 肋骨般的甲片引导死灵力量，紫罗兰色符印则守护穿戴者。
description.en: Rib-like plating channels necrotic force while violet sigils guard the wearer.

description.zh: 染紫的骨质鞋底在每一步谨慎落下时释放毒性共鸣。
description.en: Purple-stained bone soles release toxic resonance with every careful step.

description.zh: 幽灵般的绳索束住削切骨片，下方脉动着施咒防护。
description.en: Spectral cords bind shorn bone, pulsing with hexing protection underneath.

description.zh: “诅咒喜欢藏在古老石头里。砸碎石头，它们就无处藏身。” — Suphara
description.en: “Curses love old stone. Break the stone, and they lose their hiding place.” — Suphara

description.zh: 密实的甲壳构造带着耐心而近似乌龟的自信承受打击。
description.en: Dense shellwork handles punishment with patient, turtle-adjacent confidence.

description.zh: “死神的锋刃只该收割自己带得走的东西。” — Suphara
description.en: “A reaper’s edge should take only what it can carry.” — Suphara

description.zh: 平衡良好的钢铁让城卫更勇敢，也让文书工作稍微轻松一点。
description.en: Balanced steel keeps city guards brave and paperwork slightly easier.

description.zh: 一件欢快的森林饰物，不知为何特别讨刺客喜欢。
description.en: A cheerful forest charm that somehow appeals to assassins.

description.zh: 愚者的笑容隐藏着明亮的真相，以免它们压垮更沉静的心灵。
description.en: A fool's grin hides bright truths that would burden calmer minds.

description.zh: 这柄镰刀从伤口中收割灵魂，而不是从田野里收割小麦。
description.en: This scythe gathers spirit from wounds, not wheat from fields.

description.zh: “瞄准时，就当弩矢早已命中；然后让绞盘证明你没错。” — Suphara
description.en: “Aim like the bolt is already there, then let the crank prove you right.” — Suphara

description.zh: 黑铁扣紧猩红遗物，环绕着内部微弱的搏动。
description.en: Black iron clasps the crimson relic around a faint inner beat.

description.zh: 心形镜片能挡开拒绝，至少也能让它更容易熬过去。
description.en: Heart lenses deflect rejection, or at least make it easier to endure.

description.zh: 心形坠饰轻轻摇摆，让含蓄直接收拾包袱离开。
description.en: The heart swings gently, making subtlety pack up and leave.

description.zh: 一面神圣盾牌，像天体般划过空中，连续以辉光击中敌人，随后返回主人手中。
description.en: A divine shield that arcs through the air like a celestial body, striking foes in radiant succession before returning to its master's hand.

description.zh: “有些火焰温暖炉边。有些火焰刺穿灵魂。” — Suphara
description.en: “Some flames warm the hearth. Some flames pierce the soul.” — Suphara

description.zh: 仿照凶残恶魔野兽制成，受诅咒的利齿渴望战斗。最好别在夜里戴它。
description.en: Modeled after a savage demon beast, its cursed teeth thirst for battle. Best not to wear it at night.

description.zh: 朴素的棕布帮助流浪者躲开人群、问题和邀请。
description.en: Plain brown cloth helps wanderers avoid people, questions, and invitations.

description.zh: 这顶帽子会在夜里发光，让藏身变得麻烦得多。
description.en: The hat glows at night, which makes hiding much less convenient.

description.zh: “稳稳托住光芒。它会在你的膝盖更想逃跑时替你挡开审判。” — Suphara
description.en: “Hold the light steady. It turns judgment aside when your knees would rather run.” — Suphara

description.zh: “仁慈与审判共用一根柄。谨慎选择。” — Suphara
description.en: “Mercy and judgment share a handle. Choose carefully.” — Suphara

description.zh: 地狱般的混沌盘绕于犄角之中，无视每一条安全教训。
description.en: Infernal chaos curls through the horn, ignoring every safety lesson.

description.zh: 神圣铁甲与野蛮犄角在同一面甲上争论不休。
description.en: Holy iron and savage horns argue across the same visor.

description.zh: 弯曲的犄角增添威严、威慑力，以及若干穿门难题。
description.en: Curved horns add authority, intimidation, and several doorway problems.

description.zh: 绿色布料融入灌木丛，让斥候看起来还算靠谱。
description.en: Green cloth blends with brush, helping scouts look responsible.

description.zh: 卷起的铺盖表明这趟旅程早有计划，即使其他一切都不这么认为。
description.en: Rolled bedding says the road was planned even if everything else disagrees.

description.zh: 粗制钢铁在精巧手法不知溜到哪里去时，依然能迅速解决问题。
description.en: Crude steel works quickly when finesse has wandered off somewhere.

description.zh: 长长的攻击距离能让危险保持在外，而猎人通常很欣赏这一点。
description.en: Long reach keeps danger away, which hunters generally appreciate.

description.zh: 宝石般的眼睛从不眨动，不知为何让一切显得更加糟糕。
description.en: Gemstone eyes never blink, which somehow makes everything worse.

description.zh: 沉重的铁制信仰垂在那里，让可疑的祭司也显得颇为正式。
description.en: Heavy iron faith hangs there, making questionable priests look official.

description.zh: 能挡住攻击、也记得海洋的旧船装甲板。
description.en: Old ship plating that blocks blows and remembers the ocean.

description.zh: 一面沉重的盾牌，以顽固而毫不退缩的钢铁迎接孤注一掷的猛击。
description.en: A heavy shield that meets desperate blows with stubborn, unflinching iron.

description.zh: 橙色饰边为挨打这门差事增添了几分格调。
description.en: Orange trim adds style to the business of being hit.

description.zh: 沉重的神圣尖刺跟随在后，既毁椅子，也毁邪念。
description.en: Heavy holy spikes follow behind, ruining chairs and wicked intentions.

description.zh: “简单的铁、锋利的尖刺，绝无讨价还价的余地。” — Suphara
description.en: “Simple iron, sharp points, and no room for negotiation.” — Suphara

description.zh: 废铁锻成的刀刃选择杀戮，因为优雅从未回过它们的信。
description.en: Scrap-forged blades choose carnage because elegance never returned their letters.

description.zh: 简单、常见、有效。文明与战争都建立在长矛的尖端之上。
description.en: Simple, common, effective. Civilization and war were built upon the point of the spear.

description.zh: 这座缠着锁链的尖塔，看起来像一座在护甲上遇到麻烦的礼拜堂。
description.en: This chained spire looks like a chapel had armor problems.

description.zh: 尖刺与犄角礼貌地提醒酒馆：最好加固一下家具。
description.en: Spikes and horns politely warn taverns to reinforce their furniture.

description.zh: 当胜算开始咄咄逼人时，阴沉的铁甲依然稳如磐石。
description.en: Grim iron holds steady when odds start getting pushy.

description.zh: 灵丝交织的纤维偏爱机动、耐力与自由，而不是沉重壁垒。
description.en: Spirit-threaded fibers favor movement, endurance, and freedom over heavy walls.

description.zh: 柔软鞋底牢牢抓住海岸与岩石，拒绝在任何地方久留。
description.en: Soft soles grip shore and stone, refusing to stay anywhere long.

description.zh: 灵活裹布让法术与攻击顺畅地穿过沙滩与浪潮。
description.en: Flexible wraps carry spells and strikes smoothly through sand and surf.

description.zh: “锯齿状的锋刃咬下时，夺走的可不只是鲜血。” — Suphara
description.en: “A jagged edge takes more than blood when it bites.” — Suphara

description.zh: 帽子前方那枚发光符文暗示着，笑话的对象或许另有其人。
description.en: That glowing rune at the front suggests the joke may be on someone else.

description.zh: 镶嵌的宝石将权威化作重量，再将重量化作审判。
description.en: Inset gems turn authority into weight, and weight into judgment.

description.zh: 小巧钢刃会在私人问题变成公开问题前将其解决。
description.en: Small steel solves personal problems before they become public problems.

description.zh: 一本骑士战地手册，教人将向前推进化作严谨的压制。
description.en: A knightly field manual for turning forward motion into disciplined pressure.

description.zh: 宽大的图示教授如何通过每一次沉稳挥扫掌握阵形、牵引与控制。
description.en: Wide diagrams teach formation, pull, and control through every measured sweep.

description.zh: 噼啪作响的笔记训练身体在疑虑追上之前连续出手两次。
description.en: Crackling notes train the body to strike twice before doubt catches up.

description.zh: 一本为骑士装订成册的救援教典，教他们先将危险拉近，再将其击溃。
description.en: A rescue doctrine bound for knights who bring danger closer before breaking it.

description.zh: 镶铁书页以顽固而即时的决意回应每一次格挡。
description.en: Iron-edged pages answer every blocked strike with stubborn, immediate resolve.

description.zh: 前线教典教授如何以嘲讽削弱敌人的意志，再让钢铁抵达。
description.en: Frontline doctrine teaches taunts to weaken resolve before steel arrives.

description.zh: 抛光铠甲让正义显得闪亮、沉重，又带着一点戏剧性。
description.en: Polished armor makes justice feel shiny, heavy, and slightly theatrical.

description.zh: 沉重靴声回荡着荣耀，因为安静的正义显然待在家里。
description.en: Heavy boots echo honor, because quiet justice apparently stayed home.

description.zh: 坚固胫甲守住战线，即使脚下的大地也开始顶嘴。
description.en: Solid greaves hold the line when the ground argues back.

description.zh: 纹章雕刻让荣耀沿着纪律严明的锋刃流转。
description.en: Heraldic engraving carries pride along a disciplined edge.

description.zh: 带铆钉的裹带就该留下印记，毕竟礼貌的拳头很少有人记得。
description.en: Studded wraps should leave marks, because polite punches rarely get remembered.

description.zh: 这些苦无经过锻造，能以外科手术般的精度飞行，无论近战还是远程都能找到弱点。
description.en: Forged to fly with surgical precision, these kunai find weak points at melee or range.

description.zh: 一具为纯粹冲击力打造的重型发射器，能够投掷爆炸载荷，摧毁成群敌人。
description.en: A heavy launcher built for raw impact, hurling explosive payloads that devastate clustered enemies.

description.zh: Sporeling 的魅力让这副面具有了一张只有大自然才会原谅的脸。
description.en: Sporeling charm gives the mask a face only nature excuses.

description.zh: 减少阻力后，每一步都能比沉重护甲更快作出回应。
description.en: Reduced drag lets each stride answer faster than heavy armor.

description.zh: 精准的动作始于平衡的甲片，它们会校正每一步。
description.en: Measured movement begins in balanced plates that correct every step.

description.zh: 细微的符印帮助维持专注，而双腿负责处理实际问题。
description.en: Subtle sigils support focus while your legs handle practical matters.

description.zh: 每一步都邀请幸运偶尔去绊倒别人。
description.en: Each step invites fortune to trip someone else for once.

description.zh: 坚固甲片让每一步都化作力量的威胁。
description.en: Solid plates turn every step into a threat of force.

description.zh: 厚重金属擅长承受压力，拒绝让步伐动摇。
description.en: Thick metal carries pressure well, refusing to let steps falter.

description.zh: 红色羽冠诉说勇武；那些凹痕则诉说经验。
description.en: The red plume says valor; the dents say experience.

description.zh: “Vitae 的吐息胜过任何锤击。我只是赋予它形体，让我们都能坚持下去。” — Suphara
description.en: “Vitae’s breath is stronger than any hammer blow. I only gave it form so we all may endure.” — Suphara

description.zh: 轻柔脚步在穿戴者坚持前行之处，留下细小的复苏花朵。
description.en: Soft steps leave tiny blossoms of renewal wherever the wearer endures.

description.zh: 记住你的训练。专注、拉弓、瞄准、深吸一口气，然后放箭。
description.en: Remember your training. Focus, draw, aim, take a deep breath, and loose.

description.zh: 这对翡翠小饰物轻轻叮当作响，大声宣扬着你所谓的好运。
description.en: These twin jade baubles jingle softly, loudly advertising your supposed luck.

description.zh: 精致的琴弦鼓舞盟友，除非有人又点了同一首曲子。
description.en: Fine strings inspire allies, unless someone requests the same song again.

description.zh: “要惩击不配者，就靠重量、信仰和稳固的握法。E.T.F. 三样都要。” — Suphara
description.en: “For smiting the unworthy, use weight, faith, and a firm grip. E.T.F. wanted all three.” — Suphara

description.zh: “让光明带着明确的目标随你而行，好让你的 Judgment 在落下前先喘口气。” — Suphara
description.en: “Carry light with purpose as your Judgment takes a breath before it falls.” — Suphara

description.zh: “一把好钉头锤，到了谁手里都可靠。” — Suphara
description.en: “A good mace is reliable in any hand.” — Suphara

description.zh: 一面刻有符文的小型护具，为那些宁愿让屏障隔在专注与疼痛之间的施法者打造。
description.en: A compact guard etched for spellcasters who prefer barriers between focus and pain.

description.zh: 强化长袍在压力下依然稳固，绝不让法术运转崩溃。
description.en: Reinforced robes hold steady under pressure, refusing to let spellwork break.

description.zh: 四种调谐共处一页，争论不休，直到最终汇成一曲和声。
description.en: Four attunements share one page, arguing until they become a single harmony.

description.zh: 奥术图示将朴素攻击化作远方迸发的严谨魔法火花。
description.en: Arcane diagrams turn simple attacks into distant sparks of disciplined magic.

description.zh: 折叠的书页标记着一呼一吸之间那不可思议的步法。
description.en: Folded pages mark impossible footwork between one breath and the next.

description.zh: 隐藏的地脉在封面下低鸣，借倒下的敌人补充力量。
description.en: Hidden ley-lines hum beneath the cover, refilling power through fallen foes.

description.zh: 脆弱的蓝色文字在魔法命中目标时碎裂成寒冷爆发。
description.en: Brittle blue script fractures into cold bursts whenever magic finds a mark.

description.zh: 不稳定的红色文字静候冲击，随后骤然绽放为烈焰。
description.en: Unstable red script waits for impact before blooming into sudden flame.

description.zh: 奥术丝线在长袍中柔和脉动，稳稳承载汇聚的魔力。
description.en: Arcane thread pulses softly through the robe, holding gathered magic.

description.zh: 云朵般柔软的拖鞋让脚步悄无声息，也让思绪得意得惊人。
description.en: Cloud-soft slippers keep steps quiet and thoughts impressively smug.

description.zh: 符文长裤经得住学习时光、施法马拉松，以及长时间坐椅子。
description.en: Runed leggings survive study sessions, spell marathons, and chair time.

description.zh: 装满了魔力水晶。提高使用者的魔力储量。
description.en: Filled to the brim with mana crystals. Increases the user's mana reserves.

description.zh: 由 Professor Elsi 制作。缓慢而平稳地啜饮，以恢复自身魔力。
description.en: Created by Professor Elsi. Take slow steady sips to renew one's mana.

description.zh: “平衡能让沉重一击显得轻而易举。” — Suphara
description.en: “Balance is what lets a heavy blow feel easy.” — Suphara

description.zh: “大师之作应当先修复、再教导，只有当教训足够清楚时才出手。” — Suphara
description.en: “A master text should mend, teach, and strike only after the lesson is clear.” — Suphara

description.zh: “速度当然重要，但前提是刀尖知道自己要去哪里。” — Suphara
description.en: “Speed matters, aye, but only if the point knows where it is going.” — Suphara

description.zh: “信仰与怒火，都需要一根稳固的握柄。” — Suphara
description.en: “Faith and fury both need a steady handle.” — Suphara

description.zh: “在正确的时机出手一次，就足以让整场战斗三思而行。” — Suphara
description.en: “Strike once at the right moment, and the fight thinks twice.” — Suphara

description.zh: “随身枪械开火时，应当像兑现承诺：简短、坚定、彻底。” — Suphara
description.en: “A sidearm should fire like a kept promise: short, firm, and final.” — Suphara

description.zh: “镰刀在踏上战场前，先养活了农田。这件复制品会在挥砍时收割力量，所以要敬重它。” — Suphara
description.en: “A scythe fed farms before battlefields. This replica harvests strength as it cuts, so treat it with respect.” — Suphara

description.zh: “弓会静静等待，直到距离本身变成一个错误。” — Suphara
description.en: “A bow waits until distance becomes a mistake.” — Suphara

description.zh: “这件复制品以攻击范围、平衡与顽强的脊骨，铭记着这片土地最初的 Knights。” — Suphara
description.en: “This replica remembers the first Knights of the land in its reach, its balance, and its stubborn spine.” — Suphara

description.zh: “我尽锤子所能，原样仿造了一位英雄的利刃。愿它在你需要时赐予你勇气。” — Suphara
description.en: “I copied a hero’s blade as close as my hammer allowed. May it give you courage when you need it.” — Suphara

description.zh: “精通，就是懂得何时该迅捷，何时该安静的力量。” — Suphara
description.en: “Mastery is power that knows when to be quick and quiet.” — Suphara

description.zh: 细小齿轮怀着潜力、自信，以及轻微的过热隐忧不断旋转。
description.en: Tiny gears spin with potential, confidence, and mild overheating concerns.

description.zh: “我取来一颗星辰的怒火，再替它装上握柄。注意你把它指向哪里。” — Suphara
description.en: “I took a star’s anger and gave it a handle. Mind where you point it.” — Suphara

description.zh: 层叠的专注符文澄澈思绪，同时让动作引导魔力。
description.en: Layered focus runes clear the mind while motion channels magic.

description.zh: 一件摇曳不定的斗篷，让穿戴者消失在动作、恶作剧与危险之间。
description.en: A wavering cloak that lets the wearer vanish between motion, mischief, and danger.

description.zh: 这张笑脸看似无害，而恶作剧正是这样开始的。
description.en: The smile looks harmless, which is exactly how mischief starts.

description.zh: 宝石般的光辉为帽子加冕，让祈祷看起来更加正式。
description.en: Jeweled light crowns the hat, making prayers look more official.

description.zh: 开裂的石头温暖发光，像一个假装自己是地质现象的背包。
description.en: The cracked stone glows warmly, like a backpack pretending to be geology.

description.zh: “月光与寒霜看起来都很温柔，直到有人替它们开锋。” — Suphara
description.en: “Moonlight and frost both look gentle until given an edge.” — Suphara

description.zh: 一顶由阴影碎片与月光丝线织成的帽子。戴上这件精灵魔法造物的 Wizards，更容易驾驭空气中的能量来强化法术。
description.en: A hat woven by gathering pieces of shadow and threads of moonlight. Wizards donning this piece of fae magic find it easier to wield the energy in the air to empower their spells.

description.zh: 一只光滑的苍白手镯，被打磨出淡淡光泽。据说能在月光下稳定心神。
description.en: A smooth, pale bracelet polished to a faint gleam. Said to steady the mind under moonlight.

description.zh: 经典的巫师帽造型、微弱火花，以及彻头彻尾的毫不低调。
description.en: Classic wizard shape, faint sparks, and absolutely no subtlety whatsoever.

description.zh: 游牧布料能压低声响、思绪，以及没必要的交谈。
description.en: Nomadic cloth muffles sound, thought, and unnecessary conversations.

description.zh: “我把死者的文字牢牢装订起来。可你若读得太久，它们依然会让诅咒延长。” — Suphara
description.en: “I bound the dead words tight. They still lengthen curses if you read too long.” — Suphara

description.zh: 猫科魅力提升潜行、恶作剧，以及不负责任的自信。
description.en: Feline charm boosts sneakiness, mischief, and irresponsible confidence.

description.zh: 异界纹路泛着微光，在身体与灵魂周围弯折，却绝不断裂。
description.en: Alien lines glow faintly, bending without breaking around body and spirit.

description.zh: 无形的节奏引导每一步悄然穿过前方不可思议的黑暗。
description.en: Unseen rhythm guides each quiet step through impossible darkness ahead.

description.zh: 头盔无瑕的表面，一丝一缕地揭示出 Garden 隐藏的织理。
description.en: The helm's flawless surface reveals the Garden's hidden weave one thread at a time.

description.zh: 奇异的对称结构减轻脚步，同时抵御不可思议的攻击。
description.en: Strange symmetry lightens the stride while guarding against impossible strikes.

description.zh: 一枚泛着微光的华丽罗盘。引导持有者走向好运与安全。
description.en: An ornate compass glowing with faint light. Guides the bearer toward fortune and safety.

description.zh: 黑曜石尖牙垂在耳畔，深受耐心夜行猎手的喜爱。
description.en: Obsidian fangs hang at the ear, favored by patient nightstalkers.

description.zh: 黑布吞没整张面容，只留下潜藏其后的意图。
description.en: Black cloth swallows the face, leaving only intent behind it.

description.zh: 蓝色流苏与粗糙皮革，以沙漠风格对抗晒伤。
description.en: Blue tassel and rough leather fight sunburn with desert style.

description.zh: 一件充满希望的新手上衣，为刚刚踏上旅途的人而制。
description.en: A beginner's tunic brimming with hope, made for those just starting their journey.

description.zh: 舒适的新手鞋早已准备妥当，尽管穿戴者还不明白为什么。
description.en: Comfy rookie shoes are ready before the wearer understands why.

description.zh: 朴素长裤经得住最初的冒险，也经得住无数次糟糕的寻路。
description.en: Simple pants survive first adventures and plenty of bad pathfinding.

description.zh: “上好的橡木会弯曲，却不会折断。” — Suphara
description.en: “Good oak bends, but it does not break.” — Suphara

description.zh: 象牙色犄角向那些选择坚守而非退却的战士致敬。
description.en: Ivory horns honor warriors who chose resolve over retreat.

description.zh: 一只由火山灰与矿石锻成的淬火护腕。手感沉重，却坚固得令人安心。
description.en: A tempered wristguard forged from volcanic ash and ore. Feels heavy, yet reassuringly firm.

description.zh: “火山玻璃之所以锋利，是因为它还记得自己曾是火焰。” — Suphara
description.en: “Volcanic glass cuts because it remembers being fire.” — Suphara

description.zh: 为纪念 O 大人，我们以火山玻璃制成了这枚指环。愿其力量护佑我们免受伤害。
description.en: In honor of the lord O we have made this band out of volcanic glass. May their power protect us from harm.

description.zh: 卷轴与护符沉沉压住那股本该受到监管的魔力。
description.en: Scrolls and charms weigh down magic that deserved supervision.

description.zh: 那只眼睛注视着读者，让草草翻阅也像是在接受针对个人的评判。
description.en: The eye watches readers, which makes skimming feel personally judged.

description.zh: 黑色缟玛瑙轻轻噼啪作响，在战斗间隙练习戏剧化的 Rogue 作派。
description.en: Black onyx crackles softly, practicing dramatic rogue behavior between fights.

description.zh: 缤纷护符骄傲地叮当作响，宣告着一场萨满式登场。
description.en: Colorful charms clatter proudly, announcing a shamanic entrance.

description.zh: 警告：请勿呼吸。
description.en: Caution: Please don't breathe.

description.zh: 金色饰边闪耀着庄严职责，以及绝不动摇的信念。
description.en: Gold trim shines with solemn duty and faith that refuses to shake.

description.zh: 一本庄重的架盾指南，教盾牌以受控的力量回应压力。
description.en: A solemn stance guide for shields that answer pressure with controlled force.

description.zh: 沉重教义将每一次冲锋化作对并肩前行之人的保护。
description.en: Heavy doctrine turns every charge into protection for those moving beside you.

description.zh: 温暖的屏障圣歌环绕治疗之手，让仁慈更难被击破。
description.en: Warm barrier hymns gather around healing hands, making mercy harder to break.

description.zh: 一则反击信条：被格挡的攻击唤醒的是神圣力量，而非恐惧。
description.en: A retaliatory creed where blocked blows awaken holy power instead of fear.

description.zh: 宽阔护手会在你的自信做出昂贵决定前先接住攻击。
description.en: Wide guard catches blows before your confidence does something expensive.

description.zh: “诡计只有失败时才算卑劣。而这些从不失败。” — Suphara
description.en: “A trick is only cheap if it fails. These do not fail.” — Suphara

description.zh: 这副面具曾属于剧院；如今即使没有佩戴者，它也会即兴演出。
description.en: This mask used to be in theater; now it improvises without a wearer.

description.zh: 笔直钢刃迅速找到缝隙，因为护甲不可能守住一切。
description.en: Straight steel finds gaps quickly, because armor cannot guard everything.

description.zh: 这顶三角帽隐约散发着劫掠、风暴和糟糕决定的气味。
description.en: The tricorn smells faintly of plunder, storms, and poor choices.

description.zh: 盐霜、烟尘与神气活现的派头，比原主人黏得更牢。
description.en: Salt, smoke, and swagger cling harder than the original owner.

description.zh: 沉重靴子踏过湿滑甲板，也把争执踢得服服帖帖。
description.en: Heavy boots cross slick decks and kick arguments into shape.

description.zh: 当你的替代手臂正在生气时，近身战斗便会变得格外私人。
description.en: Close combat becomes personal when your replacement hand is angry.

description.zh: 风暴、刀刃与酒馆里的决定，都没能毁掉它们。
description.en: Storms, blades, and tavern decisions all failed to ruin them.

description.zh: 一把朴素的随身枪械；在训练有素的手中，它能回答许多问题。
description.en: A simple sidearm, and with trained hands an answer to many problems.

description.zh: 红色合金逻辑反应迅速，在使用者决定移动之前便已追踪动作。
description.en: Red-alloy logic reacts quickly, tracking motion before the user decides to move.

description.zh: 发光导管稳定外壳，使所有系统同时达成协调。
description.en: Glowing conduits stabilize the shell, harmonizing every system at once.

description.zh: 不稳定的 Mana 将这柄蓝色聚能刃推过安全极限。
description.en: Unstable mana floods this blue focus blade past safe limits.

description.zh: 一柄过载的等离子刃，会直接从持有者体内撕取能量。它能大幅强化物理伤害与暴击威力，却也使身体变得脆弱而毫无遮蔽。
description.en: An overloaded plasma edge that tears energy directly from its wielder. Massively amplifies physical damage and critical force, but leaves the body fragile and exposed.

description.zh: 动能在导管中燃烧，以生命力换取炽烈速度。
description.en: Momentum burns through this conduit, trading vitality for blazing speed.

description.zh: 受控的等离子晶格强化力量、法术输出与能量回收。
description.en: Contained plasma lattice boosts force, spell output, and recycled energy.

description.zh: 微型推进器在脚下低鸣，催促穿戴者不断穿越前方的敌对火力。
description.en: Micro-thrusters hum underfoot, urging constant movement through hostile fire ahead.

description.zh: 导管铺满强化甲片，将动作顺畅地转化为战斗效率。
description.en: Conduits line reinforced plates, turning motion into combat efficiency smoothly.

description.zh: 一枚形似果实的红白护符，在旅行治疗者之间颇受欢迎。
description.en: A red and white charm resembling a fruit. Popular among traveling healers.

description.zh: 酿制工具静候其中，因为战斗有时需要一碗紧急 Mana 汤。
description.en: Brew tools wait inside, because battle sometimes needs emergency mana soup.

description.zh: 发光药液在葫芦中轻轻晃动，祈祷着没人会喝得太快。
description.en: Glowing brew sloshes quietly, praying that nobody will drink it too fast.

description.zh: 薄荷、Mana 与炼金规划，共同挤在这个带软垫的小袋里。
description.en: Mint, mana, and alchemical planning share this padded little pouch.

description.zh: 苍白书页隐藏着仪式，能将怒火化作抵挡邪恶威胁的庇护。
description.en: Pale pages hide rites that turn wrath into shelter against unholy threats.

description.zh: 一则被鲜血温暖的誓言铭记痛苦，并以更加凌厉的审判回应。
description.en: A blood-warmed vow remembers pain and answers it with sharper judgment.

description.zh: 圣化烙印灼烧于文字之间，为神圣毁灭标记腐化。
description.en: Sanctified brands burn across the text, marking corruption for holy ruin.

description.zh: 月之祷文先以阴影包裹保护，随后释放潜藏的神圣力量。
description.en: Lunar prayers wrap protection in shadow before releasing hidden sacred force.

description.zh: 仁慈教义教导每一份溢出的祝福在灵魂周围凝成坚壳。
description.en: Merciful doctrine teaches every excess blessing to harden around the soul.

description.zh: 一份封印契约，为那些从最终边缘归来的人许诺光明。
description.en: A sealed covenant promises light for those returned from the final edge.

description.zh: 每当腐化被祛除，或治疗开始生效时，洁白书页便会亮起。
description.en: Clean white pages brighten whenever corruption is lifted or healing takes hold.

description.zh: 圣化律令教导神圣之地在绝望的脚步下维持得更加长久。
description.en: Consecrated rules teach sacred ground to endure longer under desperate feet.

description.zh: 南瓜永远挂着笑容，午夜之后便不再那么令人安心。
description.en: The pumpkin smiles forever, which becomes less comforting after midnight.

description.zh: 帽顶那根轻快的羽毛，鼓励着潇洒脱身与可疑的自信。
description.en: A jaunty feather at the top encourages stylish escapes and questionable confidence.

description.zh: 一只装满附魔箭矢的箭袋，箭头缠绕着藤蔓与荆棘。深受猎人青睐。
description.en: A quiver of enchanted arrows, tipped with vines and briars. Favored by hunters.

description.zh: 箭羽齐整的箭矢耐心等候着，这一点倒比敌人强。
description.en: Fletched arrows wait patiently, which is more than enemies do.

description.zh: 镀金光辉勾勒着刀刃，以沉静而精准的锋芒斩开黑暗。
description.en: Gilded light frames the blade, cutting darkness with quiet precision.

description.zh: 紫色琴弦温暖闪烁，让暴力听起来几乎也有了几分教养。
description.en: Purple strings shimmer warmly, making violence sound almost cultured.

description.zh: “只要有一根好法杖把光引直，它想披上什么颜色都行。” — Suphara
description.en: “Light can wear any color if a good staff keeps it straight.” — Suphara

description.zh: “愤怒不过是火焰，小子。把它指向正确的方向，连石头都能熔化。” — Suphara
description.en: “Anger is just fire, lad. Point it the right way, and it can melt stone.” — Suphara

description.zh: 长角金属许诺着劫掠、淤青，以及少得可怜的歉意。
description.en: Horned metal promises raids, bruises, and very limited apologies.

description.zh: 曾由山地萨满在神圣试炼中佩戴。据说能驱退恶魔影响。
description.en: Once worn by mountain shamans in sacred trials. Said to repel demonic influences.

description.zh: 篮子里装满了饱满的番茄，既能用于战斗，也能拿来当午餐。
description.en: Plump tomatoes fill the basket, ready for combat or lunch.

description.zh: 一柄刃口薄得不可思议的拳刃。它在永不停歇的攻势中最为凶猛，能将持有者推越自然极限。
description.en: A katar honed to impossibly thin edges. They thrive in relentless motion, pushing the wielder beyond natural limits.

description.zh: 剃刀般的锋刃嘉奖不懈的技巧，以及从每个角度施加的迅猛压力。
description.en: Razor edges reward relentless technique and swift pressure from every angle.

description.zh: 苍白锋刃划破阴影，饥渴地追逐肉身消逝后留下的一切。
description.en: Pale edges cut through shadow, hungry for what bodies leave behind.

description.zh: “快射需要老实可靠的木材，也需要一只信得过它的手。” — Suphara
description.en: “Quick shots need honest wood and a hand that trusts it.” — Suphara

description.zh: “我给这把斧头装上了牙齿，而不是仁慈。它一旦尝到鲜血，伤口就会继续说个不停。” — Suphara
description.en: “I gave this axe teeth, not mercy. Once it tastes blood the wound keeps talking.” — Suphara

description.zh: 全新升级的重型甲壳，满足你的各种需求。历经超过1,250小时的严格测试，为你带来最出色的进攻性能。
description.en: New and improved heavy shell for all your needs. Over 1,250 hours of rigorous testing have brought you the best in offense.

description.zh: 海军的威严端正地坐在你头上，并理所当然地等着别人表示尊重。
description.en: Naval authority sits neatly on your head and expects respect.

description.zh: 木制鹿角宣告着帮手、恶作剧者，或危险得过分喜庆的企图。
description.en: Wooden antlers announce helpers, pranksters, or dangerously festive intentions.

description.zh: 小巧鹿角与温暖饰边带来冬日欢欣，从不先征求同意。
description.en: Small antlers and warm trim carry winter cheer without asking.

description.zh: 冬日欢欣温暖着节庆外套，使其无论寒夜还是战斗都保持暖意。
description.en: Winter cheer warms the festive coat through cold nights and combat.

description.zh: 节日鞋稳稳抓住结霜小径，同时假装积雪并不是必需品。
description.en: Holiday shoes grip frosted paths while pretending snow is optional.

description.zh: 温暖双手保持灵巧，让节庆混乱慢慢考虑下一步。
description.en: Warm hands stay nimble while festive chaos considers its options.

description.zh: 毛皮衬里的绑腿让雪地行军仿佛受到节庆欢欣的指引。
description.en: Fur-lined leggings make snowy marches feel guided by seasonal cheer.

description.zh: 饱经海风侵蚀并饰以黄金，三叉戟的三支尖锋会接连发动致命攻击。
description.en: Sea-worn and gilded, its three prongs strike in deadly sequence.

description.zh: 一把小巧的曲柄供箭弩，能够快速连续射击。弩矢的威力或许不强，却能以毫不停歇的射速压倒敌人。
description.en: A compact, crank-fed crossbow that fires in quick succession. Bolts may lack punch, but its relentless rate of fire overwhelms foes.

description.zh: 魔法节奏愈发响亮，杂念则礼貌地输掉了争论。
description.en: Magical rhythm rises louder, and distractions politely lose the argument.

description.zh: 长枪管的平衡设计能从更安全的距离提供可靠的制敌威力。
description.en: Long-barreled balance delivers dependable stopping power from a safer distance.

description.zh: 位面回声在巨刃中震颤，于现实本身撕开伤口。
description.en: Planar echoes shiver through the greatblade, opening wounds in reality itself.

description.zh: 造型简单，传导实在，魔力也足够让它保持几分趣味。
description.en: Simple shape, honest channel, and enough magic to stay interesting.

description.zh: 一本安静的盗贼手册，其中每一柄旋转刀刃都先教你保持无声。
description.en: A quiet rogue manual where every spinning blade teaches silence first.

description.zh: 墨黑路线在书页上蜿蜒，却恰好在追踪开始之处消失。
description.en: Ink-black routes trail across the pages, vanishing exactly where pursuit begins.

description.zh: 染毒图示向外绽放，教导毒素在每一次破绽出现后继续蔓延。
description.en: Poisoned diagrams blossom outward, teaching venom to spread after every opening.

description.zh: 黑暗步法让每一步不断倍增，直到距离本身也变得不再可靠。
description.en: Dark footwork lessons multiply each step until distance becomes unreliable.

description.zh: 隐藏的页边批注奖赏无形杀手，让每次消失之后都显露出无情破绽。
description.en: Concealed margins reward unseen killers with ruthless openings after every vanish.

description.zh: 一副精致考究的眼镜，保证让你看起来聪明许多。
description.en: A set of sophisticated glasses that are sure to make you look smart.

description.zh: 木板与螺栓以务实而圆满的决心牢牢结合。
description.en: Planks and bolts hold together with practical, circular determination.

description.zh: “王冠若没有高贵钢铁加固，也不过是一块金属。” — Suphara
description.en: “A crown is just metal unless it’s reinforced by noble steel.” — Suphara

description.zh: 宝石装点的优雅之下，藏着一则关于宫廷争执的尖锐提醒。
description.en: Gemmed elegance hides a pointy reminder about courtly arguments.

description.zh: 一柄曾由失落王国皇家卫兵使用的优雅长矛。王朝或许早已覆灭，其设计却依然留存。
description.en: An elegant spear once used by the royal guards of a lost kingdom. Their monarchy might've fallen but their design remains.

description.zh: 紫罗兰火焰透过 whitesteel 注视着外界，让所有与它对视的人都陷入麻烦。
description.en: Violet flame watches through whitesteel, making eye contact everyone's problem.

description.zh: 古老符文从布料中回应召唤，将隐藏力量引入每一道法术。
description.en: Ancient runes answer from the cloth, calling hidden power into every spell.

description.zh: 抛光木材与雕刻符文低鸣着受约束的奥术力量。
description.en: Polished wood and carved runes hum with restrained arcane power.

description.zh: “当你的锤子学会符文的语法，砸碎它们自然就更快了。” — Suphara
description.en: “Runes are faster to break once your hammer learns their grammar.” — Suphara

description.zh: 每当抵抗作出回应，蓝色符文便沿着刀刃苏醒。
description.en: Blue runes wake along the blade whenever resistance answers back.

description.zh: 老旧镜片依然很适合侦察——前提是眯眼也算一种技术。
description.en: Old lenses still scout well, provided squinting counts as technology.

description.zh: 强化玻璃保护着脑袋、秘密，以及那些值得怀疑的职场决定。
description.en: Reinforced glass protects the head, secrets, and questionable workplace decisions.

description.zh: 耐压甲片在附近最需要耐力时守护身体。
description.en: Pressure-rated plating guards the body when endurance matters most nearby.

description.zh: 减震靴让双脚在极其吵闹的失误中依然保持安静。
description.en: Shock-absorbing boots keep feet quiet during very noisy mistakes.

description.zh: 分散冲击力的衬垫在压力下同时保护双手与施法专注。
description.en: Force-dispersing padding protects hands and spell focus together under pressure.

description.zh: 加重胫甲稳住脚步，抵挡来自下方的碾压冲击。
description.en: Weighted greaves hold footing steady against crushing impacts from below.

description.zh: 挺括的蓝色布料让人看起来精通航海，即使脚下完全没有海。
description.en: Crisp blue cloth suggests nautical competence, even on dry land.

description.zh: 一件内衬光之符文的祝圣胸甲。由那些如同活体堡垒般坚守的人穿戴。
description.en: A blessed cuirass lined with runes of light. Worn by those who stand as living bastions.

description.zh: 每踏出一步都会泛起微光的靴子，携带着复苏的气息。
description.en: Boots that glow faintly with each step, carrying the aura of restoration.

description.zh: 光亮的胫甲刻满祷文，让每一步前行都更加有力。
description.en: Gleaming greaves inscribed with prayers, strengthening every step forward.

description.zh: 圣线温暖着纯白手套，守护谨慎施治的双手。
description.en: Holy thread warms pure white gloves for careful healing hands.

description.zh: 镌刻的圣光强化坚守者周围的神圣之地。
description.en: Engraved light strengthens sacred ground around those who hold firm.

description.zh: 节庆欢欣缝入温暖布料，让战斗中的士气始终高昂。
description.en: Holiday cheer stitched into warm cloth keeps spirits high during battle.

description.zh: 节庆鞋履让脚步依旧轻快，即使甜点吃得太多。
description.en: Festive footwear keeps steps quick, even after too many treats.

description.zh: 柔软手套招来奇迹、恶作剧，以及方便得令人起疑的好运。
description.en: Soft gloves invite miracles, mischief, and suspiciously convenient luck.

description.zh: 节庆暖意带来好运，以及顽强不屈的应季韧性。
description.en: Holiday warmth carries good fortune and stubborn seasonal resilience.

description.zh: 舒适冬布陪伴漫漫长夜走入意想不到的冒险。
description.en: Comfortable winter cloth carries long nights into unexpected adventures.

description.zh: 蓝宝石周围汇聚着冷冽的王者气息，沉静而威严。
description.en: Cool royal presence gathers around the sapphire, calm and commanding.

description.zh: 蓝色拉丝钢下藏着沉静的战纹，让老兵始终保持镇定。
description.en: Blue-brushed steel keeps veteran calm beneath quiet war markings inside.

description.zh: 炼金火石把袋子烘得暖洋洋，也可能把你的背烧着。
description.en: Alchemical firestones warm the pouch, and possibly burn your back.

description.zh: “小小一刀也能成就长久功效，前提是刀锋懂得医术。” — Suphara
description.en: “A small cut can do long work when the edge knows its medicine.” — Suphara

description.zh: 厚重镜片曾深受 Grand Archive 的图书管理员喜爱。
description.en: Thick lenses once favored by librarians of the Grand Archive.

description.zh: 蓝绿色布料配上金色徽记，让学徒看起来准备充分。
description.en: Teal cloth and a golden emblem make apprentices look prepared.

description.zh: 机械笔记教你用一发射击让麻烦乖乖等候下一发。
description.en: Mechanical notes teach one shot to leave trouble waiting for the next.

description.zh: 标记清晰的地形草图教陷阱把猎物拖入更糟的选择。
description.en: Marked terrain sketches teach traps to pull prey into worse decisions.

description.zh: 松散灵活的书页让每次闪避都化作节奏、速度与重新涌起的动势。
description.en: Loose, agile pages reward every dodge with rhythm, speed, and renewed motion.

description.zh: 战术笔记让每一发强力射击都在敌人恢复前令其踉跄。
description.en: Tactical notes make each forceful shot stagger enemies before they recover.

description.zh: 锐利图示扩展猎人的标记，直到距离也不再让人觉得安全。
description.en: Sharp diagrams widen the hunter's mark until distance feels less protective.

description.zh: 拼凑而成的节段会咬上两次，打得护甲措手不及。
description.en: Cobble-built segments bite twice, catching armor off-guard.

description.zh: 古老卷轴被妥善封存，既安全，也不太会抱怨。
description.en: Old scrolls stay sealed, safe, and less likely to complain.

description.zh: 一个神圣词语静候在护符紧密的束缚中。
description.en: One divine word waits inside the charm's tight binding.

description.zh: 钩刃从每道伤口中啜饮，并继续挥舞，渴求更多。
description.en: A hooked blade that drinks from each cut and keeps swinging for more.

description.zh: 金色嫩芽散发着泥土、生长与治愈的气息。
description.en: Golden sprouts smell like soil, growth, and healing.

description.zh: 眼睛图案许诺带来异象，不管你想不想看。
description.en: The eye motif promises visions, whether you wanted them or not.

description.zh: 金色蛇身咬住自己的尾巴，让永恒也显得时髦。
description.en: Golden coils bite their tail, making eternity look fashionable.

description.zh: 无声鞋履在暗影察觉前，将每一步化作刀锋之舞。
description.en: Silent shoes turn every step into a blade-dance just before the shadows notice.

description.zh: “并非每一道阴影都意味着伤害。有些只是在守望。” — Suphara
description.en: “Not every shadow means harm. Some are only keeping watch.” — Suphara

description.zh: 利落的墨镜让 Rogues、赌徒和可疑陌生人看起来都很忙。
description.en: Sleek shades help rogues, gamblers, and suspicious strangers look busy.

description.zh: 饥渴的利齿环绕兜帽，让人打消拥抱的念头。
description.en: Ravenous teeth frame the hood, discouraging hugs.

description.zh: 棱角分明的甲片怒视外界，因为没有更含蓄的威慑方式。
description.en: Angular plates glare outward, because subtle intimidation was unavailable.

description.zh: 黑封书页教暗影毫不拖泥带水地终结虚弱目标。
description.en: A black-bound page teaches shadows to finish weakened targets without ceremony.

description.zh: 三枚元素封印留下一道暗影标记，将命运系于目标。
description.en: Three elemental seals leave one shadowed mark, binding fate to the target.

description.zh: 精准笔划让每次消失与闪现都换来更凌厉的杀戮技法。
description.en: Precise strokes reward every vanish and blink with sharper killing discipline.

description.zh: 幽灵般的书页在隐匿即将消退之际释放完美时机。
description.en: Ghostly pages release perfect timing just as concealment slips away.

description.zh: 近距离轰击能迅速结束争论。
description.en: Close-range blasts settle arguments quickly.

description.zh: 多刃钢铁无声旋转，将精准化作战场上突如其来的毁灭。
description.en: Multi-edged steel spins silently, turning precision into sudden battlefield devastation.

description.zh: “仔细听，小子。黑夜掌握着节奏，回声尚未落尽，子弹便已命中。” — Suphara
description.en: “Listen close, lad. The night keeps the rhythm, and the shot lands before the echo finishes.” — Suphara

description.zh: 一枚阴森小徽章，以多余得过分的自信嘲笑死亡。
description.en: A grim little badge that laughs at death with unnecessary confidence.

description.zh: 长角骷髅在勇气尚未凝聚前便散发恐惧。
description.en: Horned skulls radiate dread before courage can gather.

description.zh: 这枚小骷髅护符暗示，今天没有邀请乐观。
description.en: This tiny skull charm suggests optimism was not invited today.

description.zh: 发光骷髅轻声低鸣，享受着自己恶毒的使命。
description.en: The glowing skull hums softly, enjoying its malevolent purpose.

description.zh: 有色护目镜许诺探索、速度，以及糟透了的计划。
description.en: Tinted goggles promise exploration, speed, and terrible plans.

description.zh: “敲一下，是雷鸣之声。敲两下，是狂风之力。敲三下，便是风暴。” — Suphara
description.en: One tap, the sound of thunder. Two taps, the might of the winds. Three taps, a storm. – Suphara

description.zh: 银色弧线低鸣，流露出受风祝福的优雅，并带来神圣的升力。
description.en: Silver curves hum with wind-blessed grace and divine lift overhead.

description.zh: 小小框架，却能带来出乎意料地严重的石子后果。
description.en: Tiny frame, but surprisingly serious pebble-based consequences.

description.zh: 锤子与火钳耐心等着金属不听话。
description.en: Hammers and tongs wait patiently for metal to misbehave.

description.zh: “我故意让子弹慢下来，小子。耐心的一发，应该能解决仓促三发只会惹恼的东西。” — Suphara
description.en: “I slowed the shot on purpose, lad. One patient round should end what three hurried ones only annoy.” — Suphara

description.zh: 毛茸茸的绒球温暖着双耳，而这双耳总会招来爱评头论足的雪灵。
description.en: Fluffy puffs warm ears that attract judgmental snow spirits.

description.zh: 它永不融化、从不开口，而且绝对会评判你的穿搭。
description.en: It never melts, never talks, and absolutely judges your outfit.

description.zh: 一枚形似太阳的辉耀徽记。触感温暖，充盈着神圣能量。
description.en: A radiant emblem resembling the sun. Warm to the touch and brimming with divine energy.

description.zh: 镀金尖端的阳光让每一次突刺都像获得了黎明的认可。
description.en: Gold-tipped sunlight makes each thrust feel approved by dawn.

description.zh: 一柄如碎裂玻璃般闪耀的辉光长剑。它渴望迅捷攻击，并惩罚那些试图防住其攻势的人。
description.en: A radiant sword that gleams like fractured glass. It hungers for swift strikes and punishes those who guard against them.

description.zh: 快得离谱的鞋履，专为那些把原地不动视为个人失败的冒险者而制。
description.en: Ridiculously quick footwear for adventurers who believe standing still is a personal failure.

description.zh: “倒下的躯体并未结束，只要刀刃懂得正确的诅咒。” — Suphara
description.en: “Fallen bodies are not finished if the blade knows the right curse.” — Suphara

description.zh: 骨质搭扣与隐藏符印将生命拴系于另一具容器。
description.en: Bone clasps and hidden sigils tether life to another vessel.

description.zh: 灰烬般的脚印轻轻尾随；对灵体而言，这已经够正常了。
description.en: Ashy footprints follow softly, which is normal enough for spirits.

description.zh: 淡淡锁链将每一步与仆从借来的力量相连。
description.en: Faint chains bind each stride to a servant's borrowed strength.

description.zh: “粗糙的活计也能是真本事，小子。尤其是上面带刺的时候。” — Suphara
description.en: “Crude work can still be true work, lad. Especially when it has spikes.” — Suphara

description.zh: 锯齿般的肢体环绕身旁，低鸣得像一盏微型暴躁吊灯。
description.en: Jagged limbs orbit nearby, humming like a tiny angry chandelier.

description.zh: 角斗士钟爱那些能在主人之前先自我介绍的头盔。
description.en: Gladiators love helmets that introduce themselves before the wearer does.

description.zh: 那副锯齿般的笑容能吓坏敌人，也能吓坏小孩。
description.en: That jagged grin scares enemies and small children.

description.zh: 尖刺挤满遗物表面，把防护变成了一整片警告标志。
description.en: Spikes crowd the relic's face, turning protection into warning signs.

description.zh: 剑身排列的锯齿在第一刀落下前便许诺恐惧。
description.en: Jagged teeth along the sword promise fear before the first cut.

description.zh: 水晶束缚的羽翼环绕身旁，在危险落下前先行守望。
description.en: Crystal-bound wings circle close, watching for danger before it lands.

description.zh: 一道均衡的守护结界，沉静的灵体汇聚其中，稳固身体、心神与勇气。
description.en: A balanced ward where quiet spirits gather to steady body, mind, and courage.

description.zh: 一顶歪斜的帽子，缀满受诅咒的小饰物。据说能强化狂烈而不稳定的魔法。
description.en: A crooked cap adorned with cursed trinkets. Rumored to enhance volatile magics.

description.zh: 由公羊角雕成，并以花朵装饰，象征新生与坚韧。
description.en: Carved from ram ivory and adorned with blossoms, they symbolize renewal and resilience.

description.zh: 幽灵羽翼为法杖加冕，让元素快过思绪作出回应。
description.en: Spectral wings crown the staff, letting elements answer faster than thought.

description.zh: 黄金先漂亮地捕住光线，接着再捕住你的目标。
description.en: The gold catches the light beautifully, and then catches your target.

description.zh: 星光通过搭扣汇聚，为仰望星空钻研魔法的魔法师所用。
description.en: Starlight gathers through the buckle for magicians who study skyward.

description.zh: 星形镜片映照梦想、光芒，还有你那些糟糕的决定。
description.en: Star lenses reflect dreams, light, and probably your poor decisions.

description.zh: 针尖般纤细的钢刃滑过防御，直抵令人疼痛的真相。
description.en: Needle-thin steel slips past defenses and finds painful truths.

description.zh: 沉重如铁的靴子将每一步钉在岩石上，拒绝向冲击屈服。
description.en: Iron-heavy boots root each step in stone, refusing to yield to impact.

description.zh: 这件沉重胸甲锻造于古老森林下方的洞窟，据说从世界根系中借来了耐力。深受那些拒绝后退的前线战士喜爱。
description.en: Forged in the caverns beneath ancient forests, this weighty chestpiece is said to borrow its endurance from the roots of the world itself. A favorite among front-liners who refuse to budge.

description.zh: 棍棒和石头也许会打断我的骨头，但把它们合在一起，现在我们就能拿来捅东西。
description.en: Stick and stones may break my bones, but together now we can stab things.

description.zh: “一支弩矢是一句重话。一场弩矢风暴，则是一场没有盾牌愿意听的争论。” — Suphara
description.en: “One bolt is a harsh word. A storm of them is an argument no shield enjoys.” — Suphara

description.zh: “雷电喜欢路径。这些刀刃一次给它好几条。” — Suphara
description.en: “Lightning loves a path. These blades give it several.” — Suphara

description.zh: 一枚由金属与玉石束缚的螺旋护符，隐约噼啪作响。据说能引导暴风的低语。
description.en: A spiraling charm bound in metal and jade, crackling faintly with static. Said to channel the whispers of tempests.

description.zh: “羽毛落下时很轻，小子。风暴之羽可不是。” — Suphara
description.en: “Feathers fall soft, lad. Storm feathers do not.” — Suphara

description.zh: 十柄长矛奔赴战场，九柄折断。是那场战争锻造了最后一柄吗？不，战争所做的一切，只是认出了那柄不会折断的长矛。
description.en: Ten Spears go to battle and nine shatter. Did that war forge the one that remained? No, all the war did was identify the spear that would not break.

description.zh: 绝缘合金储存 Mana，同时削弱敌对魔法的侵袭。
description.en: Insulated alloys store mana while softening the bite of hostile magic.

description.zh: 抗震靴通过稳固鞋底引导 Mana，让穿戴者站稳阵脚。
description.en: Shock-resistant boots channel mana through soles built to stand firm.

description.zh: 经风暴淬炼的胫甲强化 Mana 流动，并分散来自下方的猛烈冲击。
description.en: Storm-tempered greaves bolster mana flow and diffuse harsh impacts below.

description.zh: 结实的草帽保护农民、海盗，以及任何在户外躲避晒伤的人。
description.en: Sturdy straw protects farmers, pirates, and anyone avoiding sunburn outside.

description.zh: 这副眼镜配有闪亮金框，也会让你眼前一片红。
description.en: These glasses shine with golden frames and make you see red.

description.zh: 野兽般的笔记教会召唤物在兽群合围前先暴露敌人的弱点。
description.en: Bestial notes teach summons to expose weakness before the pack closes in.

description.zh: 黑暗流动在文字间盘旋，从每一道暴烈法术中拖出诅咒。
description.en: Dark currents swirl through the text, dragging curses from every violent spell.

description.zh: 一道沉重仪式将敌人向内拖拽，随后由深井以不协和之音作出回应。
description.en: A heavy rite pulls enemies inward before the well answers with dissonance.

description.zh: 柔和的风之文字通过召唤魔法传递治疗回响，以及令敌人沉默的压迫。
description.en: Soft wind-script carries healing echoes and silencing pressure through summoned magic.

description.zh: 明亮共鸣在主人与召唤物之间低鸣，将支援化作共享力量。
description.en: Bright resonance hums between master and summon, turning support into shared might.

description.zh: 相连的诗句把灵魂与法术系在一起，让每一次灵魂打击延伸得更远。
description.en: Linked verses bind spirit to spell, stretching each soul strike farther.

description.zh: 木制阳光温暖地贴在背后，温和，却生机盎然。
description.en: Wooden sunlight rests warm against the back, gentle but alive.

description.zh: 双翼与黎明徽记标示着那些守护他人的人。
description.en: Twin wings and a dawn crest mark those who shield others.

description.zh: 古老黄铜承载神圣审判与绝不黯淡的决心。
description.en: Ancient brass carries divine judgment and resolve that refuses to dim.

description.zh: 每当勇气最需要鼓励时，金色狮面便会发光。
description.en: A golden lion face glows when bravery needs encouragement most.

description.zh: 亮黄色连指手套温暖双手，也让士气高得可疑。
description.en: Bright yellow mitts keep hands warm and morale suspiciously high.

description.zh: 一件承载太阳徽记的礼仪兵器。它以力量引导神圣之力，让每一次打击都化作辉耀审判。
description.en: A ceremonial weapon bearing the crest of the sun. It channels divine force through strength, turning every strike into radiant judgment.

description.zh: “只要锻得足够炽热，小小的刀刃也能承载整轮朝阳。” — Suphara
description.en: “A small blade can carry a whole sunrise, if you forge it hot enough.” — Suphara

description.zh: 欢快的花瓣散发着阳光气息，即使佩戴者本人完全不是这样。
description.en: Cheerful petals radiate sunshine, even when the wearer absolutely does not.

description.zh: 一副帅气的墨镜，能挡住刺眼阳光。别在室内戴。
description.en: A set of cool shades that will keep the sunlight out of your eyes. Don't wear them indoors.

description.zh: 百叶状镜片挡住阳光、羞耻，以及多得令人意外的疑虑。
description.en: Slatted lenses block sun, shame, and a surprising amount of doubt.

description.zh: 绿色触须轻轻颤动，让讲究礼数的人重新考虑是否要在户外靠近。
description.en: Green feelers twitch softly, making polite company reconsider approaching outside.

description.zh: “尖牙无需硕大。它只需要时机、毒液，以及一个靠得够近、能学到教训的蠢货。” — Suphara
description.en: “A fang does not need size. It needs timing, venom, and a fool close enough to learn.” — Suphara

description.zh: “独自上路确实危险，没错。所以我把这把剑做得简单、结实，随时可以陪你踏上第一次旅程。” — Suphara
description.en: “It is dangerous to go alone, aye. So I made this one simple, sturdy, and ready for your first journey.” — Suphara

description.zh: 一枚茶壶形护符，隐约冒着蒸汽。据说里面住着一个爱恶作剧的灵体。
description.en: A kettle-shaped charm that steams faintly. Rumored to house a mischievous spirit.

description.zh: 受风暴触碰的长袍，将火焰、寒霜、雷霆与岩石编入躁动不安的法术。
description.en: Storm-touched robes braid fire, frost, thunder, and stone into restless spellwork.

description.zh: “风与雷都是固执的客人。管教得严些，它们就会替你战斗。” — Suphara
description.en: “Wind and thunder are stubborn guests. Treat them firm, and they will fight for you.” — Suphara

description.zh: 这副面具有着淡淡的诅咒，有时会在你没注意时悄悄改变形状。
description.en: Faintly cursed, this mask sometimes shifts when you aren't looking.

description.zh: 暗如阴影的皮革，专为灵巧双手与悄然脱身而制。
description.en: Shadow-dark leather made for quick hands and quiet exits.

description.zh: 当这双鞋经过时，连地板都更懂得保守秘密。
description.en: The floor keeps secrets better when these pass over it.

description.zh: 轻盈布料偏爱迅速脱身，而不是公平交手。
description.en: Light fabric favors fast escapes over fair fights.

description.zh: “持续给战线施压，就连勇敢的敌人也会开始数出口。” — Suphara
description.en: “Keep pressure on the line, and even brave enemies start counting exits.” — Suphara

description.zh: 一顶塑成虎头模样的条纹头盔，散发着凶猛气势与掠食者般的力量。
description.en: A striped helm shaped like a tiger's head. Radiates ferocity and predatory strength.

description.zh: 厚重镜片会放大符文、设计图，以及每一个细小错误。
description.en: Bulky lenses magnify runes, schematics, and every tiny mistake.

description.zh: 这套装置能挡住强光，同时让你看起来准备得十分充分。
description.en: The contraption blocks glare while making you look prepared.

description.zh: 修理、改装和临场发挥所需的一切，都在这条腰带上叮当作响。
description.en: Fixing, tinkering, and improvising all jingle loudly from this belt.

description.zh: 一把轻巧而平衡良好的斧头，非常适合从远处投掷。先扔斧头，问题以后再问。
description.en: A light and balanced Axe. Perfect for throwing from a distance. Throw first, axe questions later.

description.zh: 老旧皮带束缚着被遗忘的法术与拒绝退场的历史。
description.en: Old straps hold forgotten spells and histories that refuse retirement.

description.zh: 海军蓝的光泽与猩红饰边，在礼貌抵达之前便先夺走聚会上的目光。
description.en: Navy-blue polish and scarlet trim demand the party's attention before manners arrive.

description.zh: 布料与护符从部族框架上传递祖先的庇护。
description.en: Cloth and charms carry ancestral protection from a tribal frame.

description.zh: 雕刻出的原始能量，唤醒佩戴者眼中潜藏的野兽。
description.en: Carved primal energy awakens the beast behind the wearer's eyes.

description.zh: 一颗灵体头骨为这顶头饰加冕，同时警告盟友与敌人。
description.en: A spirit skull crowns the headdress, warning allies and enemies alike.

description.zh: 一只为旅行捆扎妥当的沉重木箱，可携带额外补给或贸易货物。
description.en: A heavy wooden chest strapped for travel. Carries extra supplies or trade goods.

description.zh: 一只由冒险者佩戴的迷你战利品宝箱。可能有陷阱，也可能没有。
description.en: A mini loot chest worn by risk-takers. May or may not be trapped.

description.zh: 金色储物箱许诺着财富。
description.en: Golden storage promises fortune.

description.zh: 古老氏族雕纹将本能牵引得更接近表面。
description.en: Ancient clan carvings pull instincts closer to the surface.

description.zh: 小小的恶魔角在恶作剧开始前便先宣告了麻烦。
description.en: Small devil horns announce mischief before the prank even begins.

description.zh: 它如海洋般无情；幸好我们把这份慈悲留给了自己。
description.en: As ruthless as the seas, it is a mercy we grant ourselves.

description.zh: “一根枪管是在提问。三根枪管就是命令。” — Suphara
description.en: “One barrel is a question. Three is a demand.” — Suphara

description.zh: 缓慢而沉稳的甲壳工艺坚信，慌张只不过是节奏太差。拜托，别踩使用者。
description.en: Slow, steady shellwork insists panic is simply bad pacing. Don't stomp on the wielder, please.

description.zh: 双刃循着同一节奏移动，在夜色边缘起舞。
description.en: Twin edges move in one rhythm, dancing along night's edge.

description.zh: 金色饰边宣告着号令之权，不管有没有人真的要求你来领导。
description.en: Gold trim declares command, whether anyone actually requested leadership.

description.zh: 抛光曲线诉说着凭实力赢得的荣誉，而不只是空洞的傲慢。
description.en: Polished curves speak of earned honor, not empty arrogance alone.

description.zh: 过滤器能挡住毒素、烟气，以及几种令人后悔的实验室气味。
description.en: Filters stop toxins, fumes, and several regrettable laboratory smells.

description.zh: 覆着苔藓的鹿角每当林深处的风吹过，便会轻柔低鸣。
description.en: Mossy antlers hum gently whenever deep woodland wind passes through.

description.zh: 活生生的根须盘绕水晶，将自然之力注入法术。
description.en: Living roots coil around the crystal, feeding nature into spellwork.

description.zh: 由活藤与柔韧树皮编织而成的绑腿，随着森林的节奏而动。每一步都会搅动无形气流，使身体加速，仿佛荒野本身正在催促你向前。
description.en: Woven from living vines and supple bark, these leggings move with the rhythm of the forest. Each step stirs unseen currents, quickening the body as if the wild itself urges you onward.

description.zh: 紫色暖意安抚着佩戴者，就像一条小小的魔法毯。
description.en: Purple warmth reassures the wearer, like a tiny magical blanket.

description.zh: 一只刻有禁忌符文的密封容器，低语声从内部不断回荡。
description.en: A sealed vessel marked with forbidden runes. Whispers echo from within.

description.zh: 紫色尖刺比任何怒视都更擅长威吓。
description.en: Purple spikes handle intimidation better than any glare.

description.zh: 以被遗忘的丝线缝成的暗色织物，适合那些在力量、优雅与坚韧之间维持平衡的人。
description.en: Dark strands stitched from forgotten silk, adapted for those who balance power, grace, and grit.

description.zh: 一把用来狠狠劈砍目标的锋利斧头。
description.en: A sharp axe used to hack away at your target.

description.zh: 一面伤痕累累的战旗，上面留着野兽的爪痕。
description.en: A battle-worn flag bearing beast claw marks.

description.zh: 愤怒与职责沉睡在这件陨落冠军的遗物之中。
description.en: Rage and duty sleep inside this relic of fallen champions.

description.zh: 一面刻有锐利徽记的宽大铁盾，专为威慑敌人并承受惩罚而设计。
description.en: A broad iron shield engraved with a sharp emblem. Designed to intimidate and absorb punishment.

description.zh: 锈红色路线追随着陷入眩晕的猎物，引导沉重弧击落向脆弱的伤口。
description.en: Rust-red maps follow stunned prey, guiding heavy arcs toward vulnerable wounds.

description.zh: 钝重的战士教义要求每一次冲锋都震撼下颌、守势与勇气。
description.en: Blunt warrior doctrine teaches every charge to leave jaws, guards, and courage shaken.

description.zh: 一本残酷的手册，教人把敌人拖入饥渴钢铁的攻击范围。
description.en: A brutal manual for dragging foes into the hungry reach of steel.

description.zh: 染满痛苦的书页教会生存本能在生命垂危时大声讨价还价。
description.en: Pain-stained pages teach survival to bargain loudly when health runs low.

description.zh: 一张伤痕累累的路线图，将旋转的暴力化作防护与减速压制。
description.en: A scarred route map turns spinning violence into protection and slowing pressure.

description.zh: “旋转时要小心。这把砍刀会先把麻烦拉近，再把它斩倒。” — Suphara
description.en: “Spin with care. This cleaver pulls trouble close before it cuts it down.” — Suphara

description.zh: “你一慌，寒冷就咬得最狠。站稳，让它先崩溃。” — Suphara
description.en: “Cold bites hardest when you panic. Stand firm, and let it break first.” — Suphara

description.zh: 一种静谧的技艺，将力量、心智与灵魂交织在一起。
description.en: A quiet art that intertwines might, mind, and spirit.

description.zh: 交错丝线将抗性、嘲讽与耐心反击编入同一套守御纹样。
description.en: Interlaced threads teach resistance, taunts, and patient punishment in one guarded pattern.

description.zh: 柔和丝线将防护与治疗编织成守护者沉稳的纹样。
description.en: Gentle threads bind protection and healing into a guardian's steady pattern.

description.zh: 奥术丝线低声鸣响，将护盾法术与受控魔力编织在一起。
description.en: Arcane threads hum with shielding spells and controlled magical force.

description.zh: 狂烈丝线将烟雾、怒火与近身战斗打结成一套鲁莽纹样。
description.en: Fierce threads knot smoke, fury, and close combat into one reckless pattern.

description.zh: 绷紧的丝线引导陷阱与不稳定弩矢，射向远处脆弱的目标。
description.en: Taut threads guide traps and volatile bolts toward distant vulnerable targets.

description.zh: 一件内衬闪光丝线并藏有暗袋的上衣，由能够引导附魔卡牌潜在力量的工匠织成。非常适合那些喜欢收集、组合或拆解卡牌的人。
description.en: A tunic lined with shimmering threads and hidden pockets, woven by artisans who channel the latent power of enchanted cards. Perfect for those who collect, combine, or crack them open.

description.zh: 柔软鞋底刻有符文，因储存的附魔而隐隐低鸣。穿着它们走过的人不会留下任何痕迹，只有洗牌命运久久不散的回响。
description.en: Soft-soled and rune-etched, these shoes hum faintly with stored enchantments. Those who tread in them leave behind no trace, except the lingering echo of shuffled fate.

description.zh: 这些层叠裹布以符文缝线与隐蔽卡槽加固，深受行走在创造与拆解边缘的 Weavers 青睐。
description.en: These layered wraps are reinforced with rune-stitched seams and subtle card slots, favored by Weavers who walk the fine line between creation and disassembly.

description.zh: 现在你可以背上这只柔软可爱的水生背包，尽情享受一段“鲸”彩时光。仿佛整片海洋都随叫随到。
description.en: Now you can have a whale of a good time with this soft, cuddly aquatic backpack. It's like having the ocean at your beck and call.

description.zh: “荆棘并不劈砍。它只会刺入，然后让毒液开口。” — Suphara
description.en: “A thorn does not slash. It pierces, and then lets the venom speak.” — Suphara

description.zh: 宁静布料承载着礼拜堂般的安宁，献给坚定不移的治疗者。
description.en: Serene cloth carries chapel calm for healers who stand firm.

description.zh: 一套结实耐用的远足行装，铺盖卷与坚韧意志一应俱全。
description.en: A heavy-duty hiker's load, complete with bedroll and grit.

description.zh: 附魔树皮将穿戴者与古老森林灵体相连。
description.en: The enchanted bark links the wearer to ancient woodland spirits.

description.zh: 柔韧的柳木能稳定引导法术，同时保留温和的摆动。
description.en: Flexible willow channels steady spells without losing its gentle swing.

description.zh: “风确实狂野，但再狂野的东西也能被引向别处。” — Suphara
description.en: “Wind is wild, aye, but even wild things can be turned aside.” — Suphara

description.zh: 弯曲的部族金属划破空气后，总会忠实地回到手中。
description.en: Curved tribal metal returns faithfully after cutting through the air.

description.zh: 水晶中生长的枝杈搅动着肉眼无法追随、盘旋于手边的气流。
description.en: Crystal-grown branches stir currents that eyes cannot follow around the hand.

description.zh: 附魔皮革让每一个动作都显得迅捷而精准。
description.en: Enchanted leather makes every movement feel swift and precise.

description.zh: 轻若羽毛的靴子让风托着每一步无声向前。
description.en: Feather-light boots let the wind carry each quiet step forward.

description.zh: 柔韧布料从不勾挂，即使箭矢在翻滚途中飞出。
description.en: Flexible cloth never snags, even when arrows fly mid-roll.

description.zh: 铁翼为一顶伤痕累累的头盔加冕，它由胜利与征服铸成。
description.en: Iron wings crown a battered helm built from victory and dominance.

description.zh: 英雄般的微光追随着双翼，因那些值得骄傲铭记的功绩而闪耀。
description.en: Heroic shimmer follows the wings, bright with deeds remembered proudly.

description.zh: 古老稻草也能引导魔法，证明就连清洁工具也可能选择混沌。
description.en: Old straw channels magic, proving even cleaning tools can choose chaos.

description.zh: 受诅咒的鞋底在充满法术力量的脚下低鸣，一次施法接着一次。
description.en: Hexed soles hum beneath spell-charged feet, one cast after another.

description.zh: 风暴沉重地压在书页上，将连锁闪电凝聚为次数更少、威力更强的神圣雷击。
description.en: Storm-heavy pages condense chain lightning into fewer, harsher divine strikes.

description.zh: 过载笔记让闪电通过突如其来的雷击再次释放自身力量。
description.en: Overcharged notes let lightning spend itself again through sudden thunderbolts.

description.zh: 中央那幅沉静图示教会闪电在离去前先致盲目标。
description.en: A calm diagram in the center teaches lightning to blind before leaving.

description.zh: 写于岩石之上的符文让土墙屹立得足够长久，以减缓追击。
description.en: Stone-written runes keep earthen walls standing long enough to slow pursuit.

description.zh: 严苛的奥术笔记牺牲施法舒适度，换取更锐利、更沉重的法术冲击。
description.en: Strict arcane notes trade casting comfort for sharper, heavier spell impact.

description.zh: 蓝色文字回响着每一次施法，在其后留下仍在低鸣的备用魔力。
description.en: Blue script echoes every cast, leaving spare mana humming in its wake.

description.zh: 当化身之力汇聚在施法者周围时，元素符印会升起对应的屏障。
description.en: Elemental sigils raise matching barriers whenever avatar power gathers around the caster.

description.zh: 尖顶传统与一枚发光宝石，让巫术显得格外正式。
description.en: Pointed tradition and a glowing gem make wizardry look official.

description.zh: 狼之徽记守护忠诚、凶猛，以及持盾的那条手臂。
description.en: A wolf emblem guards loyalty, ferocity, and the arm behind it.

description.zh: 破碎木板依靠钉子、希望与英勇的自我否认继续撑了下来。
description.en: Broken wood survives through nails, hope, and heroic denial.

description.zh: 朴素灰布属于那些让整个世界持续运转的人。
description.en: Plain grey cloth belongs to people who keep the world moving.

description.zh: “第一道曙光应当快到没有人看见它来临。” — Suphara
description.en: “First light should be swift enough that no one sees it coming.” — Suphara

description.zh: 幽灵火焰燃烧在骷髅眼中，低语着被遗忘的名字。
description.en: Spectral fire burns in the skull's eyes, whispering forgotten names.

description.zh: 金色水晶明亮发光，大概是因为低调从来没学会魔法。
description.en: Golden crystal glows brightly, probably because subtlety never learned magic.

description_1.zh: 当恐惧高于祈祷时，维塔教导信仰无需震撼
description_1.en: When fear rose higher than prayer, Vitae taught that faith need not thunder to endure.

description_2.zh: 一盏静谧的光芒，被忠实地高举，足以安抚伤者并指引前路
description_2.en: A quiet light, carried faithfully, was enough to steady the wounded and guide the lost.

description_3.zh: 因此虔诚的人被教导要耐心地遵守誓言，使慈悲能够
description_3.en: Thus the devout were taught to keep their vows in patience, that mercy might outlast terror and hope remain when strength faltered.

description_4.zh: 因为圣洁不是通过盛大表演来证明的，而是通过留下的恩典来证明的
description_4.en: For holiness is not proven by spectacle, but by the grace that remains when all else is shaken. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 在道路被命名之前，暗影标记了力量征服的第一块土地。
description_1.en: Before the roads were named, Umbra marked the first ground taken by strength.

description_2.zh: 分开棘丛的手没有向大地乞求欢迎，而是雕刻了
description_2.en: The hand that split the briar did not ask the earth for welcome, but carved its right to remain.

description_3.zh: 因此，最初的战生者被教导去夺取那火焰、恐惧和记忆
description_3.en: Thus the first warborn were taught to seize, that fire, fear, and memory might answer to one will.

description_4.zh: 因为神圣的印记能够存活抵抗，而更强大的则是
description_4.en: For sacred is the mark that survives resistance, and stronger still the one written in blood. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 当战斗不再眷顾犹豫者时，翁布拉教导说力量必须
description_1.en: When battle favored the hesitant no longer, Umbra taught that force must move faster than fear can think.

description_2.zh: 一旦开始的连击链，不应被怜悯、反冲所打断，
description_2.en: A chain of strikes, once begun, was not to be interrupted by pity, recoil, or restraint, but carried through until resistance forgot how to stand.

description_3.zh: 于是无情之人被教导成为动能本身，使得每一击
description_3.en: Thus the relentless were taught to become momentum itself, that each blow would call the next and violence would answer before doubt returned.

description_4.zh: 因为最确定的胜利是在冲击与之间没有间隙的胜利
description_4.en: For the surest victory is the one that leaves no space between impact and the will behind it. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 当暴风雨、法术和镜像之怒摧残信徒时，Vitae塑造了
description_1.en: When storms, spells, and mirrored wrath battered the faithful, Vitae shaped within them a center that would not yield.

description_2.zh: 力量不是为了凌驾于他人之上，而是为了在他人离去时坚守阵地
description_2.en: Strength was not given to stand above others, but to remain when others had nowhere else to stand.

description_3.zh: 就这样，坚定者被教会成为任何恐惧都无法击散的墙垣，
description_3.en: Thus the steadfast were taught to become a wall no terror could scatter, that fear, force, and sorcery alike might spend themselves in vain.

description_4.zh: 因为无法被摧毁、动摇或反制的心灵是有福的
description_4.en: For blessed is the heart that cannot be thrown, shaken, or turned against itself. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 当狂战士的誓言在怒火下破裂时，暗影并未平息鲜血，
description_1.en: When the Berserker's oath broke beneath rage, Umbra did not calm the blood, but sharpened it.

description_2.zh: 每一道伤口都成为鼓声，每一次挥舞都是身体消耗自己的呼唤
description_2.en: Every wound became a drumbeat, every swing a demand that the body spend itself before doubt could speak.

description_3.zh: 如此，愤怒者被教导用斧、爪和
description_3.en: Thus the wrathful were taught to chase the fleeing life in axe, claw, and cyclone, until battle answered only hunger.

description_4.zh: 因为仁慈是愤怒夺走了它所应得的一切之后的沉寂。- Codex Umbra
description_4.en: For mercy is the silence after fury has taken all it was owed. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 在废墟之后的第一次平静中，维塔教导智者编织而非伤害。
description_1.en: In the first calm after ruin, Vitae taught the wise to weave instead of wound.

description_2.zh: 力量不是为了解开世界，而是为了束缚其破碎的秩序
description_2.en: Power was not given to unravel the world, but to bind its broken measures into harmony.

description_3.zh: 因此患者被教导塑造无形之物，使思想可以化为
description_3.en: Thus the patient were taught to shape the unseen, that thought might become shelter, light, and song.

description_4.zh: 因为魔法最纯净的时刻，就是当它让世界比它发现时更完整的时候。
description_4.en: For magic is purest when it leaves the world more whole than it found it. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 在誓言和王国之前，在毁灭和记忆之前，所有力量交融在一起
description_1.en: Before oath and kingdom, before ruin and remembrance, all forces mingled in one body.

description_2.zh: 圣洁、阴影、毒素和死亡当时并非敌对，而是等待中的真理
description_2.en: Holy, shadow, poison, and death were not enemies then, but truths awaiting a stronger hand.

description_3.zh: 因此智者们被教导要掌握矛盾，即优雅与腐败
description_3.en: Thus the knowing were taught to wield contradiction, that grace and corruption might answer the same design.

description_4.zh: 因为世界不仅由纯净所保护，更由结合之意志所保护
description_4.en: For the world is not preserved by purity alone, but by the will to bind what others fear to touch. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 当混沌逼近最后的堡垒时，维泰教导精通是
description_1.en: When chaos pressed against the last bastions, Vitae taught that mastery was mercy measured without waste.

description_2.zh: 咒语干净利落、迅速而不多余地施放，保留了两种力量
description_2.en: The spell cast cleanly, swiftly, and without excess preserved both strength and purpose, turning panic into discipline.

description_3.zh: 因此虔诚者被教导让力量无间断、无负担地流动，以便
description_3.en: Thus the devoted were taught to let power flow without pause or burden, that the wounded be sustained and the line not break.

description_4.zh: 因为控制最神圣的时刻，不是在它限制天赋时，而是在它引导天赋时
description_4.en: For control is holiest not when it restrains the gift, but when it guides it flawlessly where it is needed most. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 当愤怒从世界深处升起时，Umbra 教导了那火焰
description_1.en: When wrath rose from the deep places of the world, Umbra taught that flame was truest when married to the blade.

description_2.zh: 火焰并非为了温暖或净化而生，而是为了在灰烬中留下教训
description_2.en: Fire was not given to warm or purify, but to leave behind a lesson even ash would remember.

description_3.zh: 如此，凶猛之人被教导以炽热的意志发动攻击，使得每一道伤口
description_3.en: Thus the fierce were taught to strike with burning will, that each wound outlive the moment that made it and each enemy pass into scorched echo.

description_4.zh: 因为力量最诚实的时刻，就是它切割、吞噬之时，无人能否认谁
description_4.en: For power is most honest when it cuts, consumes, and leaves no doubt who carried the fire. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 当劣质盔甲在世界的残酷下破裂时，暗影教导了强者们
description_1.en: When lesser armor cracked beneath the world's cruelty, Umbra taught the strong to clothe themselves not in protection alone, but in permanence.

description_2.zh: 活着的钢铁不仅能承受打击；它会记住并将其返还
description_2.en: Steel that lives does not merely endure the strike; it remembers it, returns it, and grows more terrible for having borne it.

description_3.zh: 因此不动者被教导作为堡垒自身而站立，
description_3.en: Thus the immovable were taught to stand as fortresses unto themselves, that every assault would break first upon their silence and feed the will within.

description_4.zh: 因为最高的力量不是躲避打击，而是发动打击
description_4.en: For the highest strength is not to escape the blow, but to make the blow regret its making. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 在世界分裂成对立真理之前,维塔记得一个更伟大的
description_1.en: Before the world was divided into rival truths, Vitae remembered a greater wholeness in which every element and living force belonged to one weave.

description_2.zh: 治愈、迅捷、力量和祝福不是分离的恩赐，而是线
description_2.en: Healing, swiftness, strength, and blessing were not separate gifts, but threads drawn together in harmony so that none would exalt itself above the rest.

description_3.zh: 如此,智者被教导寻求充盈而非过度,权力
description_3.en: Thus the wise were taught to seek fullness instead of excess, that power in all its forms might serve life without tearing it apart.

description_4.zh: 因为永恒不是单一力量的胜利，而是万物的和谐
description_4.en: For eternity is not the triumph of one force, but the concord of all that was meant to endure together. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 当世界的道路缠绕在一起时，暗影教会隐藏者通行
description_1.en: When the paths of the world grew tangled, Umbra taught the hidden to pass where no hand could close.

description_2.zh: 敏捷不是为了怜悯而赐予的，而是让看不见的东西保持无损
description_2.en: Swiftness was not given for mercy, but so the unseen might remain untouched while all others stumbled.

description_3.zh: 因此，那些难以捉摸的人被教导在视线和后果之间滑动，
description_3.en: Thus the elusive were taught to slip between sight and consequence, that danger might grasp only emptiness and pursuit grow weary.

description_4.zh: 祝福灵魂如影而动，在瞬间感受，永不
description_4.en: For blessed is the soul that moves like shadow, felt in passing and never held. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 当距离将勇气化为猜测时，Vitae稳定了枪手的武器
description_1.en: When distance turned courage into guesswork, Vitae steadied the Gunslinger's hand.

description_2.zh: 这一枪并非因骄傲而发，而是在那唯一的瞬间，判断，
description_2.en: The shot was not loosed for pride, but for the single breath where judgment, aim, and purpose became one.

description_3.zh: 患者因此被教导干净地进行打击,从火药闪光到远处
description_3.en: Thus the patient were taught to strike cleanly, from powder flash to far horizon, wasting neither fear nor force.

description_4.zh: 祝福的子弹在混乱到达无辜者之前结束危险。
description_4.en: For blessed is the bullet that ends danger before chaos reaches the innocent. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 在土地伤痕累累、灰烬铭记战争的地方，Vitae 播撒了绽放。
description_1.en: Where the ground was scarred and ash remembered war, Vitae laid down bloom.

description_2.zh: 不是否认伤口，而是用活的怜悯覆盖它，直到痛苦被遗忘
description_2.en: Not to deny the wound, but to cover it in living mercy until pain forgot its name.

description_3.zh: 因此信徒们被教导要超越自身治愈，即使废墟
description_3.en: Thus the faithful were taught to heal beyond themselves, that even ruins might flower.

description_4.zh: 因为生命在回到痛苦曾经相信自己的地方时最为神圣
description_4.en: For life is holiest when it returns where suffering once believed itself eternal. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 在废墟之后的第一阵宁静中，翁布拉教导智者用标记代替哀悼。
description_1.en: In the first calm after ruin, Umbra taught the wise to mark instead of mourn.

description_2.zh: 力量不是为了安抚伤口，而是为了确保每一道伤口都被铭记。
description_2.en: Power was not given to soothe the wound, but to ensure that every wound remembered.

description_3.zh: 因此狡猾者被教导在无形之物上打下烙印，使思想得以转化为
description_3.en: Thus the cunning were taught to brand the unseen, that thought might become poison, fear, and fate.

description_4.zh: 因为魔法最真实的时刻，是当它教会世界没有任何被击中的东西永远
description_4.en: For magic is truest when it teaches the world that nothing struck is ever unchanged again. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 当困惑笼罩战场时，Vitae教导信徒放任视界
description_1.en: When confusion clouded the field, Vitae taught the faithful to let sight become certainty.

description_2.zh: 准度并非因骄傲而获得，而是为了没有必要的一击被浪费，也没有
description_2.en: Aim was not given for pride, but so that no needed strike be wasted and no danger mistaken for another.

description_3.zh: 因此敏锐的人被教导在任何距离都能看清真实，使得精准度得以
description_3.en: Thus the keen were taught to see truly at any range, that precision might spare effort, preserve strength, and bring order to the chaos of battle.

description_4.zh: 祝福那不游移的眼睛，更圣洁的是那份意志，
description_4.en: For blessed is the eye that does not wander, and holier still the will that follows it without doubt. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 当伤者在暮色的重压下弯腰时，维泰没有下达命令，
description_1.en: When the wounded bent beneath the weight of dusk, Vitae gave not command, but breath.

description_2.zh: 残存的生命不应被囤积，也不应被浪费在仇恨中，而是被承载
description_2.en: What life remained was not to be hoarded, nor spent in hatred, but carried onward together.

description_3.zh: 强者被教导要坚持，使弱者能够与他们一起站起来。
description_3.en: Thus the strong were taught to endure, that the weak might rise beside them.

description_4.zh: 共享之息是神圣的，而保护它的手更加神圣
description_4.en: For sacred is the breath that is shared, and holier still the hand that preserves it. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 当毒、影和寂静学会了猎杀生者，Umbra出现了
description_1.en: When poison, shadow, and silence learned to stalk the living, Umbra answered not with cleansing, but with refusal.

description_2.zh: 被标记者不是被教导愈合伤口，而是拒绝让伤口有立足之地，
description_2.en: The marked were not taught to heal the wound, but to deny it a place to settle, until venom, darkness, and fear passed over them empty.

description_3.zh: 这样被选中的人被教导在他人踌躇的地方无碰触地行走，即
description_3.en: Thus the chosen were taught to walk untouched where others faltered, that no affliction might claim what had been sealed against loss.

description_4.zh: 因为最强的守护不是向外闪耀的光,而是虚无
description_4.en: For the strongest ward is not the light that shines outward, but the void that permits nothing in. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 让誓言在众人能听到之处被诵出，因为真理不惧见证。
description_1.en: Let the vow be spoken where all may hear, for truth does not fear witness.

description_2.zh: 钢铁的正义不在于锋利，而在于约束它的诺言
description_2.en: Steel is made righteous not by sharpness, but by the promise that governs its use.

description_3.zh: 于是坚定者被教导直言不讳地发动进攻，使技能与责任长存
description_3.en: Thus the steadfast were taught to strike openly, that skill and duty remain one.

description_4.zh: 因为太阳下守护的誓言，比没有获得的胜利更有价值
description_4.en: For an oath kept beneath the sun is worth more than victory won without a name. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 当伤患们在暮色的重压下弯腰时，暗影收集了
description_1.en: When the wounded bent beneath the weight of dusk, Umbra gathered what the living spilled.

description_2.zh: 血肉遗忘之事，血液铭记；灵魂放逐之物，意志化为有用
description_2.en: What flesh forgot, blood remembered; what the soul loosed, will made useful again.

description_3.zh: 由此无情之人被教会夺取，使得任何力量都不会丧失于尘埃或
description_3.en: Thus the ruthless were taught to take, that no strength be lost to dust or pity.

description_4.zh: 力量是真正的慈悲，不留任何东西的手是幸福的
description_4.en: For power is the truest mercy, and blessed is the hand that lets nothing die unused. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 在战争分裂记忆之前，维泰将第一门艺术赋予凡人之手
description_1.en: Before the war divided memory, Vitae set the first art into mortal hands as a gift of ordered wonder.

description_2.zh: 火焰、严寒、石头和风暴不仅被当作武器来传授，更被当作一种语言
description_2.en: Flame, frost, stone, and storm were not taught as weapons alone, but as languages through which the world might be understood without being broken.

description_3.zh: 因此最初的守护者被教导要虔诚地施法，力量与智慧
description_3.en: Thus the first keepers were taught to cast in reverence, that power and wisdom would rise together instead of parting ways.

description_4.zh: 因为最古老的魔法从未打算统治创造，而是为了与之交谈
description_4.en: For the oldest magic was never meant to dominate creation, but to speak with it. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 在开放的圣所和诵唱的祈祷出现之前，暗影将智慧保存在不
description_1.en: Long before open sanctums and sung prayers, Umbra kept wisdom in wells no eye could sound.

description_2.zh: 最深奥的艺术并未传于众人，而是被守护在沉寂之中，直到
description_2.en: The deepest arts were not given to the many, but guarded in silence until a will strong enough could draw from them without trembling.

description_3.zh: 守护者们被教导要隐藏最重要的东西，使得力量能够
description_3.en: Thus the keepers were taught to hide what mattered most, that power might remain pure from the ruin of careless hands.

description_4.zh: 保存在黑暗中的秘密比喊出的真理持续的时间更长
description_4.en: For a secret preserved in darkness endures longer than a truth shouted into the wind. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 当低等的心灵害怕天空时,Umbra教会了学者去倾听
description_1.en: When lesser minds feared the heavens, Umbra taught the learned to listen when the cosmos spoke in fire.

description_2.zh: 智慧不是为了庇护胆小之人，而是为了凭借意志召唤愤怒
description_2.en: Wisdom was not given to shield the timid, but to call down wrath with a will refined enough to survive its answer.

description_3.zh: 魔法师们被教导用血肉换取光彩，那魔法、守护、
description_3.en: Thus the magi were taught to trade flesh for brilliance, that mana, warding, and ruin might gather in one disciplined hand.

description_4.zh: 因为最高的艺术不是安全地借用力量，而是说出燃烧的
description_4.en: For the highest art is not to borrow power safely, but to speak the burning language of the stars and remain standing when they reply. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 当敌对的魔法使空气黯淡时，维泰对此未曾自夸，
