description_1.en: When hostile sorcery darkened the air, Vitae raised no boast against it, but a veil through which malice could not easily pass.

description_2.zh: 真正的守护不是复仇，而是保护，维护心灵、身体，
description_2.en: True warding was not vengeance, but guardianship, preserving mind, body, and spirit from the reach of powers that sought to bend them from afar.

description_3.zh: 因此守卫者被教导转开无形之物，使得法术本身
description_3.en: Thus the watchful were taught to turn aside the unseen, that spellcraft itself might be answered without surrendering to it.

description_4.zh: 因为慈悲并非总是治愈之手；有时它是保护的盾牌，
description_4.en: For mercy is not always the healing hand; sometimes it is the shield that ensures the wound is never made. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 当战争的碰撞破碎了较弱的灵魂时，维泰锤炼了信徒如同
description_1.en: When the clash of war broke lesser spirits, Vitae tempered the faithful as iron in a living flame.

description_2.zh: 耐力不是为了压倒他人，而是为了克制自己
description_2.en: Endurance was not given so they might crush others, but so they would not yield when others depended on them.

description_3.zh: 就这样，坚定不移的人被教导在战斗中毫不屈服地承受重压，
description_3.en: Thus the steadfast were taught to bear the weight of battle without surrender, that courage might hold where fear sought entry.

description_4.zh: 因为最真实的心不是永不出血的心，而是坚决拒绝的心
description_4.en: For the truest heart is not the one that never bleeds, but the one that refuses to break. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 当世界的道路缠绕在一起时，维塔埃在呼吸中送去了指引
description_1.en: When the paths of the world grew tangled, Vitae sent guidance on the breath between leaves.

description_2.zh: 迅捷不仅被赋予逃脱之用，更是为了让生命能自由地流动到
description_2.en: Swiftness was not given for escape alone, but so life might move freely where darkness sought to close its hand.

description_3.zh: 因此舰队被教导轻装旅行，警告、援助和希望
description_3.en: Thus the fleet were taught to travel lightly, that warning, aid, and hope could arrive before harm.

description_4.zh: 幸哉乎灵魂如风而动，触及众多生命而无
description_4.en: For blessed is the soul that moves like wind, touching many lives without claiming any for its own. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 在咒语的名字被记录之前，Vitae 在世界中以
description_1.en: Before the names of spells were written, Vitae moved through the world as a current unseen yet generous.

description_2.zh: 智者被告知的不是拥有它，而是将自己作为通道打开，
description_2.en: The wise were not told to possess it, but to open themselves as conduits, that wonder might pass through mortal hands without being diminished.

description_3.zh: 因此天赋异禀者被教导以等量的方式接受和释放，而
description_3.en: Thus the gifted were taught to receive and release in equal measure, that power remain living instead of still.

description_4.zh: 因为最纯净的容器不是囤积光芒的，而是能够
description_4.en: For the purest vessel is not the one that hoards the light, but the one through which it continues. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 当坟墓拒绝保守秘密时，暗影教导了死灵法师
description_1.en: When the grave refused to keep its counsel, Umbra taught the Necromancer to listen.

description_2.zh: 骨骼、呼吸和腐烂记录了生者所恐惧的，每个碎片都是一段记忆
description_2.en: Bone, breath, and rot held records the living feared, each fragment a memory waiting to be commanded.

description_3.zh: 因此死亡之人被教导将终结向外转向，直到新星、螺旋、
description_3.en: Thus the deathbound were taught to turn endings outward, until nova, spiral, and corpse spoke in one cold choir.

description_4.zh: 对于能听到它回答的人来说，埋藏的东西永远不会真正丢失。- Codex
description_4.en: For nothing buried is truly lost to the one who can hear it answer. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 在道路有名字之前，维泰祝福了踏入未成形之地的第一步
description_1.en: Before the roads were named, Vitae blessed the first step into the unmade world.

description_2.zh: 清除荆棘的手没有征服大地，反而邀请了生命
description_2.en: The hand that cleared the briar did not conquer the earth, but invited life to follow.

description_3.zh: 因此，最初的行者被教导建造庇护所、火焰和记忆
description_3.en: Thus the first walkers were taught to build, that shelter, fire, and memory might endure together.

description_4.zh: 因为神圣的道路为他人而开启，而更加灿烂
description_4.en: For sacred is the path that is opened for others, and brighter still the one who leaves it behind. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 当凡人的力量对于凡人的需求而言太过短暂时，翁布拉教导说
description_1.en: When mortal strength proved too brief for mortal need, Umbra taught that vows should not end where the body does.

description_2.zh: 羁绊与负担都注定超越最初的一息而存在，被守护着
description_2.en: Bond and burden alike were made to endure beyond their first breath, held fast by will so that no promise would fade simply because time demanded it.

description_3.zh: 因此宣誓者被教会将他们的天赋绑定得比自然所允许的更长时间，
description_3.en: Thus the sworn were taught to bind their gifts longer than nature allowed, that devotion might outlast flesh and obligation remain unbroken.

description_4.zh: 因为真正的誓言不是只说一次的誓言,而是拒绝背弃的誓言
description_4.en: For the truest oath is not the one spoken once, but the one that refuses to die. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 当黑暗压向大门时，Vitae 在圣骑士中放置了一面盾牌
description_1.en: When darkness pressed against the gate, Vitae placed a shield in the Paladin's hand and a dawn behind it.

description_2.zh: 审判不是愤怒，剑的抬起不是为了征服，而是为了
description_2.en: Judgment was not anger, nor was the blade raised for conquest, but to make a road where fear had gathered.

description_3.zh: 由此，宣誓者被教导通过钢铁、十字和神圣之物来释放光芒
description_3.en: Thus the sworn were taught to cast light through steel, cross, and consecrated ground, that the helpless might stand within its reach.

description_4.zh: 因为最圣洁的防御是即使在攻击时也能保护的光辉。
description_4.en: For the holiest defense is the radiance that protects even while it strikes. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 当死者嘲讽而行，悲伤缠绕于生者之时，维泰做出了回应
description_1.en: When the dead walked in mockery and sorrow clung to the living, Vitae answered through the Priest's raised hand.

description_2.zh: 恩典不是脆弱的善良，而是一种命名腐败、放逐腐败的力量
description_2.en: Grace was not fragile kindness, but a force that named corruption, banished it, and carried mercy with a blade of light.

description_3.zh: 这样被圣化的人被教导要打击、驱魔，并仅在以下情况下召唤愤怒
description_3.en: Thus the sanctified were taught to smite, exorcise, and call wrath only where healing alone could not restore the way.

description_4.zh: 因为当审判为生命开辟道路时，怜悯不会因审判而削弱。
description_4.en: For mercy is not weakened by judgment when judgment clears the path for life. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 在誓言和王国之前，在废墟和回忆之前，最初的元素
description_1.en: Before oath and kingdom, before ruin and remembrance, the first elements were set in balance.

description_2.zh: 火焰温暖，水退缩，风承载，土地坚守，各自给予
description_2.en: Fire warmed, water yielded, wind carried, and earth endured, each giving shape without dominion.

description_3.zh: 于是守护者被教导掌控原初之力不是通过征服，而是通过
description_3.en: Thus the keepers were taught to master the primal not by conquest, but by accord.

description_4.zh: 世界最初因和谐而变得完整，后来才被意志所破坏。
description_4.en: For the world was first made whole by harmony, and only later broken by will. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 当敌人以为距离意味着安全时，翁布拉教会了风暴
description_1.en: When the enemy believed distance meant safety, Umbra taught the storm to answer from beyond sight.

description_2.zh: 速度不是为了优雅而给予的，而是为了确保打击一定到达
description_2.en: Speed was not given for elegance, but for certainty, that the strike arrive before warning and force be felt before fear found its name.

description_3.zh: 由此，敏捷者被教会在风中释放死亡，指向看不见的地平线
description_3.en: Thus the swift were taught to loose death on the wind, that the unseen horizon itself would become an instrument of judgment.

description_4.zh: 因为最强的射击并非所见的那一枪，而是
description_4.en: For the strongest shot is not the one that is witnessed, but the one that is only understood after it lands. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 让工作在无人听闻之处完成，因为必需之事无需见证。
description_1.en: Let the work be done where none may hear, for necessity does not beg witness.

description_2.zh: 刀刃不是因为承诺而变得正义，而是因为它无情地带来的终局
description_2.en: The blade is made righteous not by promise, but by the end it delivers without delay.

description_3.zh: 故隐者被教导无声而击，使技艺与目的永存
description_3.en: Thus the hidden were taught to strike unseen, that skill and purpose remain unbroken by mercy.

description_4.zh: 无声而终的敌人，比先发警告的荣耀更值得尊敬。
description_4.en: For a foe ended in silence is worth more than glory that warns him first. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 当危险仍隐没于认知边界之外时，维泰教导了这种视觉
description_1.en: When danger still hid beyond the edge of knowing, Vitae taught that vision must travel where the body could not.

description_2.zh: 距离不是为了恐惧而生,而是为了判断,使智者能够
description_2.en: Distance was not made for fear, but for judgment, so that the wise might end ruin before it crossed the threshold.

description_3.zh: 因此警惕者被教会在一击前看到胜利的形态
description_3.en: Thus the watchful were taught to see the shape of victory before the strike was loosed, that action would serve purpose instead of impulse.

description_4.zh: 因为最稳健的手首先源于最远的视野。- Codex Vitae
description_4.en: For the surest hand is born first from the farthest sight. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 当道路在火焰、寒霜、风暴和暗影之间消失时，翁布拉教导了
description_1.en: When the path vanished between flame, frost, storm, and shadow, Umbra taught the Shinobi to become the bridge.

description_2.zh: 隐藏的刀刃没有向世界要求许可，只要求一个时刻
description_2.en: The hidden blade did not ask the world for permission, only for a moment no eye could keep.

description_3.zh: 就这样，被遮蔽者被教导在元素符号之间释放黑暗，
description_3.en: Thus the veiled were taught to release darkness between elemental signs, striking where pursuit had already lost its name.

description_4.zh: 最可靠的艺术是那些只在消失后才被铭记的艺术。-
description_4.en: For the surest art is the one remembered only after it has disappeared. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 当恐惧高于祈祷时，翁布拉教导权力无需乞求
description_1.en: When fear rose higher than prayer, Umbra taught that power need not be begged if it can be bound.

description_2.zh: 一言既出，灵魂应答，生者所缺由此供给
description_2.en: A word given, a spirit answered, and what the living lacked was supplied by covenant.

description_3.zh: 所以宣誓者被教导在仪式中封印他们的意志，使得没有任何弱点
description_3.en: Thus the sworn were taught to seal their will in ritual, that no weakness go unanswered and no plea remain empty.

description_4.zh: 因为真理不仅存在于恩典中，更存在于那给予什么的契约中
description_4.en: For truth is not found in grace alone, but in the pact that delivers what faith only promises. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 在大地伤痕累累、灰烬还记着战争的地方，暗影饮尽了残留的一切
description_1.en: Where the ground was scarred and ash remembered war, Umbra drank what lingered there.

description_2.zh: 不是否认伤口，而是保持其力量不在沉默中消逝
description_2.en: Not to deny the wound, but to keep its strength from fading into silence and dirt.

description_3.zh: 饥饿者被教导从废墟中汲取养分，使任何陨落的气息都不被浪费。
description_3.en: Thus the hungry were taught to feed from ruin, that no fallen breath be squandered.

description_4.zh: 因为力量在被夺回死亡之前是最纯净的，在坟墓能够
description_4.en: For power is purest when it is taken back from death before the grave can close. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 当温柔的双手在世界的残酷面前失败时，Umbra教导力量
description_1.en: When softer hands failed against the world's cruelty, Umbra taught that strength is not born once, but hammered into being again and again.

description_2.zh: 冲击不是应该害怕的代价，而是驱赶弱点的法则
description_2.en: Impact was not a cost to be feared, but the law by which weakness was driven out and resolve made real.

description_3.zh: 就这样，那些已锻炼的战士被教导要攻击、坚持并再次攻击，直到
description_3.en: Thus the hardened were taught to strike, endure, and strike again, until force itself became memory written into flesh and iron.

description_4.zh: 因为力量不属于未受伤者，而属于能在打击中生存的人
description_4.en: For power belongs not to the untouched, but to the one who survives the blow and returns it greater. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 当散落的火焰、冰霜、雷电和石头的丝线被拉紧时
description_1.en: When scattered threads of fire, frost, thunder, and stone pulled against the loom, Vitae taught the Weaver to answer gently.

description_2.zh: 命运不是枷锁，而是图案，每一道闪电都是归来的纺线
description_2.en: Fate was not a chain, but a pattern, and every bolt was a strand returned to its proper crossing.

description_3.zh: 这样，谨慎的人被教导用有序的元素修补战斗，塑造
description_3.en: Thus the careful were taught to mend battle with ordered elements, shaping many paths without breaking the hand that walked them.

description_4.zh: 因为当力量在不撕裂世界的情况下编织时,命运最闪耀
description_4.en: For destiny is brightest when power is woven without tearing the world that bears it. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 当天空成为尖叫风的机器时，暗影教导了巫师
description_1.en: When the sky became a machine of screaming wind, Umbra taught the Wizard to place a hand upon its turning heart.

description_2.zh: 闪电不是警告，而是命令，雷鸣是衡量的标准
description_2.en: Lightning was not a warning, but a command, and thunder the measure by which hesitation was shattered.

description_3.zh: 暴风束缚者因此被教会一次又一次地通过狂风驱动咒语，
description_3.en: Thus the stormbound were taught to drive spell after spell through the gale, until the air itself became an engine of ruin.

description_4.zh: 因为风在被赋予一场风暴来铭记时，最忠实地服从。
description_4.en: For the wind obeys most faithfully when it is given a storm to remember. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 当生命之河因失去而逃逸得太快时，暗影教导了巫师
description_1.en: When the river of life fled too quickly from loss, Umbra taught the Wizard to still its passing.

description_2.zh: 冰非缺失，乃统治，一种足以禁止动作的沉寂，
description_2.en: Ice was not absence, but dominion, a silence strong enough to keep motion, breath, and terror exactly where they stood.

description_3.zh: 因此被冰冻束缚的人被教导在冬天用碎片来统治战场
description_3.en: Thus the frostbound were taught to crown the field in winter, where shard and ground answered the same unmoving will.

description_4.zh: 被冰冻的东西并未消失,而是被冻结,直到力量决定其解冻。 -
description_4.en: For what is frozen is not gone, but held until power decides its thaw. - Codex Umbra

description_1.zh: 当天空在一个害怕改变的世界上燃烧时，维泰传授了
description_1.en: When the heavens burned above a world afraid to change, Vitae taught the Wizard that fire could be renewal.

description_2.zh: 坠落的星辰并非被召唤来沉溺于毁灭，而是为了摧毁腐烂之物
description_2.en: The falling star was not summoned to revel in ruin, but to break what rot had claimed beyond healing.

description_3.zh: 因此火焰束缚者被教导召唤柱、流星和炽热爆发
description_3.en: Thus the flamebound were taught to call pillar, meteor, and burst of heat where corrupted stillness needed an ending.

description_4.zh: 因为生命有时只有在古老的黑暗转变为之后才会回归
description_4.en: For life sometimes returns only after the old darkness has been turned to ash. - Codex Vitae

description_1.zh: 当世界回忆起每个咒语下的第一个平衡时，维泰教导了
description_1.en: When the world remembered the first balance beneath every spell, Vitae taught the Wizard to stand at the center of the elements.

description_2.zh: 火焰、霜冻、风暴和石头聚集在一起，不是作为对手，而是作为守护者
description_2.en: Flame, frost, storm, and stone were gathered not as rivals, but as guardians circling one patient will.

description_3.zh: 因此元素法师被教导在不失去专注的情况下施法，提升
description_3.en: Thus the elementalist was taught to cast without breaking focus, raising barriers and currents that turned force into harmony.

description_4.zh: 因为世界在每个元素都保持其位置并保护的地方最强大
description_4.en: For the world is strongest where every element keeps its place and protects the whole. - Codex Vitae
