description.zh: 缝合的血肉与陈旧骨骸构成一具沉重的不死躯体，庞大的身躯足以堵住洞穴通道。
description.en: Stitched flesh and old bone form a heavy undead body that blocks cave tunnels with its bulk.

description.zh: 在没有月光的怪异夜晚，这个漂浮生物会出现在天空下。圣光在它体表汇聚，随后释放出强力攻击。
description.en: This floating being appears beneath moonless skies on strange nights. Holy light gathers around its body before it releases a powerful attack.

description.zh: 黑暗土壤遮住了这株啮咬植物的大半身躯，直到它带毒的根须猛然向上弹起。
description.en: Dark soil hides most of this biting plant until its venomous roots snap upward.

description.zh: 它的独眼紧盯着一切动静，随后以身体或苍白光芒发动攻击。
description.en: Its single eye follows movement closely before it attacks with its body or pale light.

description.zh: 奇异光芒在它体表游移，而它则徘徊于古城之中。
description.en: Strange lights drift across its body as it wanders through the old city.

description.zh: 星光倒映在它的独眼深处，伴随它漂浮于昏暗空气中。
description.en: Starlight reflects inside its single eye while it drifts through dark air.

description.zh: 这种古城中的小型生物会迅速连射数次，然后飘离攻击范围。
description.en: This small city creature fires quick bursts before drifting out of reach.

description.zh: 厚重花瓣在这株诡异植物体内积蓄毒素，而它则生长于月光照耀的土壤中。
description.en: Heavy petals collect poison inside this strange plant as it grows in moonlit soil.

description.zh: 柔和光芒掠过它的身体，宛如一片微缩的天空正在流动。
description.en: Soft light moves across its body like a small sky in motion.

description.zh: 这种长满尖刺的生物冲过焦黑林地，体内同时不断积蓄热量。
description.en: This spiked creature rushes through blackened woods while heat gathers around its body.

description.zh: 每当周围空气产生变化，这株小型有毒菌体便会释放孢子。
description.en: This small poisonous growth releases spores whenever the air around it shifts.

description.zh: 这个星形小生物悬浮在冰封地面上方，在雪地中散发微弱光芒。
description.en: This tiny star-shaped creature hovers above frozen ground and glows faintly in the snow.

description.zh: 它带着星辉穿行于古老遗迹，移动时光芒会变得更加明亮。
description.en: It drifts through old ruins with a starry glow that brightens when it moves.

description.zh: 旅人往往先注意到苔原上移动的柔光，随后才看见它的身体。
description.en: Travelers often notice its soft glow moving across the tundra before they see its body.

description.zh: 它圆滚滚的身体在地面上飞速旋转，沿途留下焦黑痕迹。
description.en: Its round body spins across the ground and leaves scorched marks behind it.

description.zh: 破碎残片拖曳在它身后，伴随它冲过覆满灰烬的地面。
description.en: Broken fragments trail behind it as it rushes across ash-covered ground.

description.zh: 这名高阶天界施法者以严谨的圣光阻挡敌人。它动作沉稳，让人难以判断下一道法术何时到来。
description.en: This high-ranking celestial caster uses disciplined light to keep enemies away. Its calm movements make it difficult to tell when the next spell will begin.

description.zh: 柔光在这个小型天界生物周围汇聚，随后它会从远处施法。
description.en: Soft light gathers around this small celestial being before it casts from a distance.

description.zh: 宽阔羽翼与稳定辉光表明，这名天界守护者是一位更强大的神圣施法者。
description.en: Broad wings and steady radiance mark this celestial guardian as a stronger holy caster.

description.zh: 蓝色巡逻单位沿着古城街道快速直线滚动。
description.en: Blue patrol units roll through old city streets in quick, straight paths.

description.zh: 红色巡逻单位会绕着障碍弹跳，转向比蓝色型号更加急促。
description.en: Red patrol units bounce around obstacles with sharper turns than the blue models.

description.zh: 这只毒蝠以破烂双翼统治着洞穴深处的穹顶。小型蝙蝠聚集在它周围，并在它俯冲时四散逃开。
description.en: This venomous bat rules the deeper cave ceilings with tattered wings. Smaller bats gather near it and scatter when it descends.

description.zh: 轻薄双翼托着这只带毒的洞穴生物穿过狭窄通道。
description.en: Thin wings carry this venomous cave-dweller through cramped passages.

description.zh: 小型条纹昆虫乘着草原微风在花朵之间穿梭。
description.en: Small striped insects ride meadow gusts from flower to flower.

description.zh: 鲜艳羽毛让这只森林鸟在起飞前便很容易被发现。
description.en: Bright feathers make this forest bird easy to spot before it takes off.

description.zh: 它会在古城巷道中保持距离，趁敌人尚未接近便从装载式发射器开火。
description.en: It keeps its distance in old city lanes and fires from mounted emitters before enemies can get close.

description.zh: 它的红色装甲会先闪烁，随后从身体前方释放一道集中的射击。
description.en: Its red plating flashes before it releases a focused shot from the front of its body.

description.zh: 毒素魔法从这株栖居遗迹的植物中渗出，使周围地面变得危险。
description.en: Poison magic leaks from this ruin-dwelling plant and makes the ground around it unsafe.

description.zh: 枯萎花瓣附着在这株洞窟植物上，毒素则在凋零表面下不断积聚。
description.en: Dead petals cling to this cavern growth while poison collects beneath its wilted surface.

description.zh: 这朵更大的死亡花会释放毒素，使其贴近洞窟地面久久不散。
description.en: This larger dead blossom releases poison that hangs close to the cavern floor.

description.zh: 它滚向任何动静时，圆形身体内部的压力会持续升高。
description.en: Pressure builds inside its round body as it rolls toward movement.

description.zh: 这台古城小型机械按照过时指令，在各条巡逻路线间匆忙穿行。
description.en: This small city machine scurries between patrol routes on outdated commands.

description.zh: 它方正的金属框架能够吸收冲击，推动自身穿过铸造厂。
description.en: Its square metal frame absorbs impacts while it pushes forward through the foundry.

description.zh: 这株漂浮植物在洞窟空气中移动时，会抖落带毒粉尘。
description.en: This floating plant growth shakes loose poisonous dust as it moves through cavern air.

description.zh: 沉重振翅声会先搅动草叶与花瓣，随后这只毛茸茸的昆虫才会现身。
description.en: Heavy wingbeats stir grass and petals before this fuzzy insect arrives.

description.zh: 它凭借迅捷跳跃与轻柔落脚，转眼便消失在茂密灌木中。
description.en: It uses quick hops and soft footing to disappear into thick underbrush.

description.zh: 它会钻过松软土壤，并用紧凑的身体将闯入者推开。
description.en: It digs through loose soil and shoves intruders aside with its compact body.

description.zh: 当神圣魔法在它周围汇聚时，闪亮粉尘便会从双翼落下。
description.en: Glittering dust falls from its wings when holy magic gathers around it.

description.zh: 彩色双翼在树林与花丛之间闪现，伴随它穿过林间谷地。
description.en: Colored wings flash between trees and flowers as it moves through the glen.

description.zh: 这个小型有翼生物会让光芒沿双翼汇聚，随后释放神圣魔法。
description.en: This small winged creature gathers light along its wings before releasing holy magic.

description.zh: 这些成簇生长的沙漠植物静立于烈日下，以锋利尖刺保护自己。
description.en: These clustered desert plants stand still beneath the sun and protect themselves with sharp spines.

description.zh: 这株古老仙人掌已经长出一圈沉重尖刺，足以抵挡大多数攻击。它扎根原地，等待敌人进入攻击范围。
description.en: This ancient cactus has grown a crown of heavy spines that protects its body from most attacks. It stays rooted in place and waits for enemies to come within reach.

description.zh: 它粗厚的身体能在干旱之地储存水分，尖刺则用来惩罚粗心的攻击者。
description.en: Its thick body stores moisture in dry places, and its spines protect it from careless attackers.

description.zh: 这只带电的猫科生物凭借速度与风系魔法统治沙漠小径。电火花在皮毛间汇聚，随后它便猛冲向前。
description.en: This charged feline rules the desert path with speed and wind magic. Sparks gather around its fur before it rushes forward.

description.zh: 当它飞奔过开阔沙地时，爪后会拖出道道火花。
description.en: Sparks trail from its paws when it darts across open desert ground.

description.zh: 风钻入它的皮毛，伴随它从树木与根须之间悄然穿行。
description.en: Wind catches in its fur as it slips between trees and roots.

description.zh: 这些草原小鸟会啄食闪亮物件，并在大型生物接近时四散逃走。
description.en: Tiny meadow birds peck at shiny objects and scatter when larger creatures approach.

description.zh: 这条栖居遗迹的毒蛇会在温热石面上静候，随后以毒牙发动突袭。
description.en: This ruin-dwelling serpent waits on warm stone before striking with venom.

description.zh: 修长肢体让它得以攀附昏暗石壁，随后猛扑向附近生物。
description.en: Long limbs let it cling to dim stone before lunging at creatures nearby.

description.zh: 紫色水晶护甲中封存着暗影能量，并会在攻击前不断汇聚。
description.en: Purple crystal armor holds shadow energy that gathers before it attacks.

description.zh: 蓝色水晶护甲储存着水压，随后释放沉重一击。
description.en: Blue crystal armor stores water pressure before it releases a heavy strike.

description.zh: 绿色水晶护甲覆盖全身，使它能稳立于破碎遗迹中发动攻击。
description.en: Green crystal armor covers its body and lets it strike while standing firm among broken ruins.

description.zh: 这名有翼的不死施法者悬浮在古老书架旁，通过独眼引导墓穴魔法。
description.en: This winged undead caster hovers near old shelves and channels grave magic through its eye.

description.zh: 符文在它的独眼周围亮起，随后不死魔法便会在上方汇聚。
description.en: Runes brighten around its eye before undead magic gathers overhead.

description.zh: 这只不死蝙蝠滑翔于残破城堡大厅，独眼始终锁定任何动静。
description.en: This undead bat glides through ruined castle halls with its single eye fixed on movement.

description.zh: 体型更大的个体凭借臂展与重量，占据最宽阔的通道。
description.en: Larger specimens use their reach and weight to claim the widest tunnels.

description.zh: 这些较小的独眼蛮兽会跟随在强大同类附近，攻击任何过于靠近的生物。
description.en: Smaller one-eyed brutes stay near stronger kin and strike at anything that comes too close.

description.zh: 它的独眼监视着狭窄洞穴通道，小巧身躯则在冰面间穿行。
description.en: Its single eye watches narrow cave paths while its small body slips between the ice.

description.zh: 它只需做出几个微小手势，便能施放在遗迹中极难察觉的暗影魔法。
description.en: It casts shadow magic with small gestures that are easy to miss in the ruins.

description.zh: 紫色能量在石块附近汇聚，随后这名施法者便会释放暗影法术。
description.en: Purple energy gathers near the stones before this caster releases a shadow spell.

description.zh: 这名带有红色饰边的施法者以迅捷暗影弹守护古老遗迹。
description.en: This red-trimmed caster uses quick shadow bolts to protect the old ruins.

description.zh: 这名年长的暗影施法者会先让图书馆中的空气变得昏暗，再释放魔法。若能在远处不受干扰，它将最为危险。
description.en: This elder shadow caster darkens the library air before releasing its magic. It is most dangerous when left alone at range.

description.zh: 这名兜帽身影漂浮于城堡走廊，并从远处施放暗影魔法。
description.en: This hooded figure drifts through castle corridors and casts shadow magic from a distance.

description.zh: 货运装甲覆盖着它的身体，即使路线遭到阻挡，也能继续向前移动。
description.en: Cargo plating covers its body and lets it keep moving even when something blocks its route.

description.zh: 余烬从它的双翼后方飘落，伴随它在目标上空盘旋。
description.en: Embers trail from its wings as it circles above its target.

description.zh: 这个体型更大的火翼恶魔会先升入空中，随后以惊人力量俯冲而下。
description.en: This larger fire-winged demon climbs into the air before diving with sudden force.

description.zh: 它会在反复飞掠中灼烧目标，并始终停留在不易触及的位置。
description.en: It scorches targets during repeated flybys and stays just outside easy reach.

description.zh: 腐败附着在这头不死野兽身上，但它的狩猎本能依然敏锐。
description.en: Rot clings to this undead beast, but its hunting instincts remain sharp.

description.zh: 热量在它的口中汇聚，随后它会吠叫着冲过根须与灌木。
description.en: Heat gathers in its jaws before it barks and charges through roots and brush.

description.zh: 滚滚热浪随着吠声涌出，随后它便携着烈焰猛冲向前。
description.en: Heat rolls from its bark before it rushes forward with a burst of flame.

description.zh: 这些受到火焰侵染的幼兽会扑向突然出现的动静，尚未来得及理解其中危险。
description.en: Young fire-touched beasts rush toward sudden movement before they understand the danger.

description.zh: 霜冻沿着它的双翼与颚部汇聚，伴随它潜行于水晶小径。
description.en: Frost gathers along its wings and jaws as it stalks the crystal paths.

description.zh: 这台紧凑机械以金属四肢与储存能量模仿巨龙。
description.en: This compact machine imitates a dragon with metal limbs and stored energy.

description.zh: 暗影盘踞在它的鳞片之间，即使穿行于神圣大厅也不曾散去。
description.en: Shadow clings between its scales even as it moves through sacred halls.

description.zh: 昏暗光芒环绕着这条较小的巨龙，伴随它快速穿过神圣大厅。
description.en: Dim light gathers around this smaller dragon as it moves quickly through sacred halls.

description.zh: 烈焰在它的牙缝间发光，随后它会以利爪与火焰魔法逼近敌人。
description.en: Flame glows between its teeth before it closes in with claws and fire magic.

description.zh: 冰晶沿着鳞片形成，伴随它在洞穴中移动。
description.en: Ice crystals form along its scales while it moves through the cave.

description.zh: 这条体型更大的火龙让强烈热量遍布鳞片与颚部。
description.en: This larger fire dragon carries intense heat across its scales and jaws.

description.zh: 当它压低身体冲过遗迹时，冰冷雾气便会从鳞片间翻涌而出。
description.en: Cold mist rolls from its scales when it lowers its body to charge through the ruins.

description.zh: 当它将利爪扣入残破石面时，鳞片下方的余烬便会发亮。
description.en: Embers glow beneath its scales when it digs its claws into ruined stone.

description.zh: 它以沉重脚步走过古老石径，刮擦石面并震落尘土。
description.en: It moves across old stone paths with heavy steps that scrape stone and shake loose dust.

description.zh: 强劲振翅先在遗迹中掀起尘埃，随后它沉重的身躯才逼近发动攻击。
description.en: Strong wingbeats stir dust through the ruins before its heavy body moves in to attack.

description.zh: 漆黑双翼紧贴身体折拢，随后它会从阴影中发动袭击。
description.en: Dark wings fold close to its body before it strikes from the shadows.

description.zh: 这条机械巨龙被打造出来，在古城中追猎目标。装甲、利爪与能量系统会在攻击时协同运作。
description.en: This mechanical dragon was built to hunt targets through the old city. Armor, claws, and energy systems all move together when it attacks.

description.zh: 这条金属幼龙移动起来，像一台试图模仿活体巨龙的古老机械。
description.en: This metal drake moves like an old machine trying to copy a living dragon.

description.zh: 它准备猛然前冲时，电火花会在鳞片表面跳动。
description.en: Sparks skip across its scales when it prepares to dart forward.

description.zh: 清凉薄雾拖曳在这条小龙身后，伴随它潜行于水晶小径。
description.en: Cool mist trails behind this small dragon as it prowls through crystal paths.

description.zh: 修长双翼贴着浑浊水面与芦苇低空掠过，划出锐利直线。
description.en: Long wings skim low over murky water and reeds in sharp lines.

description.zh: 这只宽翼沼泽昆虫会先悬停原地，随后骤然加速。
description.en: This broad-winged marsh insect hovers in place before snapping into motion.

description.zh: 体型更大的沼泽飞虫会以突然爆发的速度消失在芦苇间。
description.en: Larger marsh fliers vanish into the reeds with sudden bursts of speed.

description.zh: 这条不死蠕虫在腐烂土壤中钻行，即使躯体开始腐坏，也依旧不断前进。
description.en: This undead worm tunnels through rotten soil and keeps moving after its body has begun to decay.

description.zh: 这枚草原上的蛋受到惊扰时会轻轻摇晃，但其中究竟等待着什么仍无人知晓。
description.en: This meadow egg rocks gently when disturbed, though what waits inside is still unknown.

description.zh: 这个活泼的带壳生物以迅捷而不规则的动作翻滚穿过灌木丛。
description.en: This lively shell-creature tumbles through underbrush with quick, uneven movement.

description.zh: 冰冷蓝光在这个年长灵体内部脉动，伴随它从洞穴空气中抽取水分。
description.en: Cold blue light pulses through this older spirit as it draws moisture from the cave air.

description.zh: 每当这个年长灵体汇聚风系魔法时，紫色气流便会绕着它旋转。
description.en: Purple currents spiral around this older spirit whenever it gathers wind magic.

description.zh: 黄色火焰燃烧在这个年长灵体内部，施法前光芒会逐渐增强。
description.en: Yellow flame burns inside this older spirit, and its glow grows brighter before it casts.

description.zh: 当它在枯枝之间滑翔时，独眼中会闪烁蓝色光芒。
description.en: Blue light gleams from its eye as it glides between dead branches.

description.zh: 绿色辉光从它的独眼渗出，染绿双翼周围的黑暗。
description.en: Green glow seeps from its eye and stains the dark around its wings.

description.zh: 这些红眼不死飞行生物会在猎物经过下方时，从树间迅速俯冲。
description.en: Red-eyed undead flyers drop quickly from the trees when prey passes below.

description.zh: 蓝色光芒从它的独眼中照出，伴随身体拖行于地下墓穴。
description.en: Blue light shines from its eye as its body drags itself through the crypt.

description.zh: 绿色辉光从它的独眼中渗出，而不死能量则在体内汇聚。
description.en: Green glow seeps from its eye while undead energy gathers in its body.

description.zh: 红光从它的独眼中迸发，随后它便穿过墓穴尘埃猛扑而来。
description.en: Red light flares from its eye before it lunges through crypt dust.

description.zh: 当墓穴魔法开始汇聚时，蓝色纹路便会在这只漂浮的独眼表面发光。
description.en: Blue markings glow across this floating eye when grave magic begins to gather.

description.zh: 绿色光芒从它的独眼中渗出，随后不死能量便向外扩散。
description.en: Green light seeps from its eye before undead energy spreads outward.

description.zh: 当这只漂浮独眼的不死魔法转为进攻时，红光便会骤然亮起。
description.en: Red light flares from this floating eye when its undead magic turns aggressive.

description.zh: 一只漂浮的独眼在破碎石块间监视动静，同时汇聚暗影魔法。
description.en: One floating eye gathers shadow magic while watching movement across the broken stones.

description.zh: 这种深水生物以一只巨大的独眼监视猎物。触手随水流摆动，随后将目标拖近。
description.en: This deep-water creature watches prey with a single enormous eye. Its tentacles move with the current before dragging targets closer.

description.zh: 这名体型更大的火焰施法者会以受控的热力爆发阻止敌人靠近。
description.en: This larger fire caster keeps enemies away with controlled bursts of heat.

description.zh: 每当这个小型恶魔为法术积蓄力量时，周围便会泛起热浪。
description.en: Heat ripples around this small demon whenever it gathers power for a spell.

description.zh: 蓝色鳞片帮助这条小鱼融入更深的水域。
description.en: Blue scales help this small fish blend into deeper water.

description.zh: 蓝鳞游泳者以迅捷划水穿过深层水流。
description.en: Blue-scaled swimmers cut through deep currents with quick strokes.

description.zh: 即使身处深处较暗的水域，暖色鳞片也让这名迅捷游泳者格外醒目。
description.en: Warm-colored scales mark this fast swimmer even in the darker parts of the depths.

description.zh: 黄色鱼鳍会先轻轻抽动，随后这名迅捷游泳者便会穿过水流疾冲而去。
description.en: Yellow fins twitch before this fast swimmer darts through the current.

description.zh: 蓝鳞战士巡逻于深层水流，一旦猎物进入领地便会迅速逼近。
description.en: Blue-scaled warriors patrol deep currents and close in quickly when prey enters their territory.

description.zh: 暖色鳞片让这名海中战士即使身处深水也泛着火焰般的光泽。
description.en: Warm-colored scales give this sea warrior a fiery glow even in deep water.

description.zh: 黄色鱼鳍会先轻轻抽动，随后这名海中战士便会穿过水流疾冲而去。
description.en: Yellow fins twitch before this sea warrior darts through the current.

description.zh: 这条小鱼在深水中游动时，会散发出不同寻常的暖意。
description.en: This small fish gives off unusual warmth as it swims through the deeper water.

description.zh: 水流发生变化时，黄色鱼鳍便会轻轻抽动，让它能突然加速移动。
description.en: Yellow fins twitch when the current changes, letting it move in quick bursts.

description.zh: 火焰覆盖着它的身体，掩盖了下一道法术最初的征兆。
description.en: Flame covers its body and hides the first signs of its next spell.

description.zh: 幼鸟以短促跳跃与突然振翅练习飞行。
description.en: Young birds test their wings with short hops and sudden flutters.

description.zh: 花瓣般的鳍片环绕身体飘动，伴随它漂浮在宁静的湖边小径附近。
description.en: Petal-like fins drift around its body as it floats near quiet lake paths.

description.zh: 它会躲在普通植物之间，直到沉重花盆突然移动，并猛扑向附近的一切。
description.en: It hides among ordinary plants until its heavy pot shifts and it lunges at anything nearby.

description.zh: 潮湿菌盖与粗壮菌柄让它牢牢扎根在湖边小径附近。
description.en: Damp caps and thick stalks help it stay rooted near lake paths.

description.zh: 星形纹路在金属外壳表面游移，而古老系统仍在继续运转。
description.en: Star-like patterns drift across its metal shell while old systems continue to run.

description.zh: 这个小型漂浮灵体以暗影般的身躯穿梭于神圣石柱之间。
description.en: This small drifting spirit slips around sacred pillars with a shadowy body.

description.zh: 黑暗斑块像松散的墓布般爬满这只小型墓穴生物的周围。
description.en: Dark patches crawl around this small crypt creature like loose grave cloth.

description.zh: 当这个小型灵体汇聚水系魔法时，蓝色光芒会沿湖边小径飘动。
description.en: Blue light drifts over the lake path as this small spirit gathers water magic.

description.zh: 紫色光芒先在沙漠风中闪烁，随后这个小型灵体便会施法。
description.en: Purple light flickers in the desert wind before this small spirit casts.

description.zh: 当火焰魔法开始汇聚时，黄色火花会在这个小型灵体内部闪烁。
description.en: Yellow sparks flicker inside this small spirit when fire magic begins to gather.

description.zh: 即使在其他巨型哥布林之中，它的犄角与粗壮双臂也让它格外危险。
description.en: Its horns and heavy arms make it dangerous even among other oversized goblins.

description.zh: 这头体型巨大的哥布林凭借力量与体型统治村庄。较弱的哥布林会聚集在它附近，仿佛等待命令。
description.en: This oversized goblin rules the village through strength and size. Lesser goblins gather near it as if expecting orders.

description.zh: 它通过沉重双手引导大地魔法，并震落村庄地面上的松散石块。
description.en: It draws earth magic through its heavy hands and shakes loose stone from the village ground.

description.zh: 它利用庞大身躯堵住道路，并将较小的敌人推到一旁。
description.en: It uses its large body to block paths and push smaller enemies out of its way.

description.zh: 小型哥布林聚集在更强的战士附近，当敌人靠近时便以简陋武器发动攻击。
description.en: Small goblins gather near stronger fighters and attack with simple weapons when enemies come close.

description.zh: 这名哥布林战士比其他野外士兵移动更快，并会从战线薄弱处发动攻击。
description.en: This goblin fighter moves faster than other field soldiers and strikes from weak points in the line.

description.zh: 它躲在更强壮的哥布林后方塑造大地魔法，由前线吸引敌人注意。
description.en: It stays behind stronger goblins and shapes earth magic while the front line holds attention.

description.zh: 更好的护甲让这名哥布林士兵能比普通部队更久地坚守阵地。
description.en: Better armor lets this goblin soldier hold its position longer than common troops.

description.zh: 它与其他野外士兵一同行进，依靠结实装备支撑下的简单攻击作战。
description.en: It marches with other field soldiers and relies on simple attacks backed by sturdy gear.

description.zh: 这名战营战士以迅捷而凶猛的动作挥舞一柄炽热刀刃。
description.en: This warcamp fighter swings a heated blade with quick, aggressive movements.

description.zh: 这名战营首领以凌厉动作与阵阵狂风指挥附近的哥布林。冲锋开始前，它的武器便会先划破空气。
description.en: This warcamp leader commands nearby goblins with sharp movements and bursts of wind. Its weapon cuts through the air before the charge begins.

description.zh: 它携带着足以砸穿前方任何障碍的重量与力量。
description.en: It carries enough weight and force to smash through anything left standing in its path.

description.zh: 它在战营中汇聚暗影魔法，先削弱敌人，再让其他哥布林逼近。
description.en: It gathers shadow magic in the warcamp and weakens enemies before other goblins close in.

description.zh: 尘土与岩石覆盖全身，使它能在沙漠峡谷中稳稳抵挡攻击。
description.en: Dust and stone cover its body, allowing it to stand firm against attacks in the desert canyon.

description.zh: 熔融裂隙在岩石躯体中发光，伴随它守护周围炽热的地面。
description.en: Molten seams glow through its rocky body as it guards the heated ground around it.

description.zh: 霜冻在石质四肢上硬化，帮助它承受正面攻击。
description.en: Frost hardens over its stone limbs and helps it withstand direct attacks.

description.zh: 网格状甲片保护着这台紧凑机器人，伴随它撞向附近目标。
description.en: Grid-patterned plating protects this compact robot as it rams into nearby targets.

description.zh: 它手持镰刀穿行于墓穴，而不死能量则在身体周围汇聚。
description.en: It carries a scythe through the crypt while undead energy gathers around its body.

description.zh: 它的机械爪原本用来抓牢金属，但夹住闯入者同样毫无问题。
description.en: Its mechanical claws were built to hold metal, but they can clamp onto intruders just as well.

description.zh: 这只体型巨大的森林跳跃者凭借速度与强壮后腿统治着灌木丛。它在树木间跳跃的速度快到大多数猎人都无法追上。
description.en: This oversized forest leaper rules the underbrush with speed and powerful legs. It bounds between trees faster than most hunters can follow.

description.zh: 这个空洞灵体在神圣大厅中漂浮，体内承载着圣光。
description.en: This hollow spirit carries holy light inside its body as it drifts through sacred halls.

description.zh: 这只巨型带壳生物凭借专为防御而生的躯体统治湖床。受到威胁时，它会缩回壳后，变得极难推动。
description.en: This massive shelled creature rules the lakebed with a body built for defense. When threatened, it withdraws behind its shell and becomes difficult to move.

description.zh: 这个蓝色服务外壳会遵循古城的旧有日常，直到某物挡住它的路线。
description.en: This blue service shell follows old city routines until something blocks its path.

description.zh: 红色服务外壳反应迅速，改变方向时会发出响亮的咔嗒声。
description.en: Red service shells react quickly and rattle loudly when they change direction.

description.zh: 这个体型更大的暗影恶魔会在狭窄的地下通道中迅速发动攻击。
description.en: This larger shadow demon attacks quickly in cramped underground tunnels.

description.zh: 肮脏双翼载着这只沼泽昆虫飞过死水与腐烂植物。
description.en: Filthy wings carry this marsh insect over stagnant water and rotting plants.

description.zh: 体型更大的沼泽苍蝇在飞行途中，让污垢不断积聚于双腿与双翼。
description.en: Larger marsh flies collect grime across their legs and wings as they travel.

description.zh: 这只吵闹的沼泽害虫会冲向任何闻起来像食物或伤者的东西。
description.en: This noisy marsh pest darts toward anything that smells edible or wounded.

description.zh: 霜冻附着在它的皮毛上，并在它穿过雪地时于爪部硬化。
description.en: Frost clings to its fur and hardens around its paws as it crosses the snow.

description.zh: 明亮纹路覆盖着这头苔原野兽，但它沉重的爪子显然为力量而生，而非炫耀。
description.en: Bright markings cover this tundra beast, but its heavy paws are built for force rather than display.

description.zh: 冰冻方块汇聚成结实形体，受到惊扰时便会向前滑动。
description.en: Frozen blocks gather into a sturdy shape and slide forward when disturbed.

description.zh: 黑暗霜冻聚集在裂缝中，使这具方正躯体周围的光线变得昏暗。
description.en: Dark frost gathers in its cracks and dulls the light around its blocky body.

description.zh: 这名高阶冰系施法者会将寒冷空气塑造成强力水系魔法。法术释放前，洞穴地面往往已经冻结。
description.en: This high-ranking ice caster shapes cold air into powerful water magic. The cave floor often freezes before its spell is released.

description.zh: 清冽光芒从这只星形生物身上闪耀，伴随它漂浮于雪地上方。
description.en: Crisp light shines from this star-shaped creature as it drifts above the snow.

description.zh: 每当这具柔软的星形躯体漂过寒冷空气，霜冻便会在身后拖出痕迹。
description.en: Frost trails behind its soft, starry body whenever it floats through cold air.

description.zh: 黑暗霜冻环绕着这个漂浮形体，伴随它滑过苔原。
description.en: Dark frost gathers around this floating shape as it glides over the tundra.

description.zh: 霜冻在这名小型施法者周围汇聚，直到附近空气开始闪耀。
description.en: Frost collects around this small caster until the nearby air begins to glitter.

description.zh: 它从洞穴墙壁中汇聚魔力时，锋利冰晶便会在身体周围成形。
description.en: Sharp ice forms around its body as it gathers magic from the cave walls.

description.zh: 这个恶魔会冲过烟雾与热浪，随后以燃烧的力量发动攻击。
description.en: This demon sprints through smoke and heat before attacking with burning force.

description.zh: 这个强大的恶魔会在战斗中同时使用物理攻击与火焰魔法。准备向前猛冲时，热量便会在身体周围汇聚。
description.en: This powerful demon uses both physical attacks and fire magic in battle. Heat gathers around its body when it prepares to rush forward.

description.zh: 较小的恶魔会在燃烧石块间迅速穿梭，发动攻击后立即撤离。
description.en: Smaller imps dart between burning stones and strike before quickly moving away.

description.zh: 这台漂浮机械会在圆形外壳下方储存风能。
description.en: This floating machine stores wind energy beneath its rounded shell.

description.zh: 这个小型心形灵体带着柔和圣光漂浮于遗迹之中。
description.en: This small heart-shaped spirit floats through the ruins with a gentle holy glow.

description.zh: 它会潜伏在转角与高台附近，借助阴影隐藏身体。
description.en: It waits near corners and ledges where shadows hide its body.

description.zh: 这尊高耸的冰封守卫稳立于苔原最深处的积雪中。冰冷躯体能吸收沉重打击，寒气则在脚边汇聚。
description.en: This towering frozen guardian stands firm in the deepest tundra snow. Its icy body absorbs heavy blows while cold gathers around its feet.

description.zh: 粗厚金属四肢让这台城市机械行动缓慢、结构坚固，并且极难被撞开。
description.en: Thick metal limbs make this city machine slow, sturdy, and difficult to knock aside.

description.zh: 它会伪装成一只被丢弃的木桶，待任何目标靠得太近时便滚撞过去。
description.en: It disguises itself as a discarded barrel before rolling at anything that comes too close.

description.zh: 这本伪装书籍受到惊扰时会猛然张开，并迅速爬走。
description.en: This false book snaps open and skitters away when disturbed.

description.zh: 这个蜡烛拟态怪会先引诱生物进入攻击范围，随后在地牢大厅中跳动追赶。
description.en: This candle mimic bobs through dungeon halls after luring creatures within reach.

description.zh: 这个活体陷阱不会等待他人踩上去，而会主动追赶移动的目标。
description.en: This living trap skitters after movement instead of waiting to be stepped on.

description.zh: 它会伪装成一柄静置的刀剑，随后猛扑向粗心伸来的双手。
description.en: It disguises itself as a resting blade before springing toward careless hands.

description.zh: 它会伪装成宝箱，并在有人靠近时猛然扑出。
description.en: It disguises itself as treasure and lunges when the chest is approached.

description.zh: 小型苔原野兽以覆霜的爪子在冰封地面上滑行跳跃。
description.en: Small tundra beasts slide and bound across frozen ground with frosted paws.

description.zh: 明亮纹路覆盖着这头小型苔原野兽，伴随它在雪地中疾奔。
description.en: Bright markings cover this small tundra beast as it dashes across the snow.

description.zh: 这块小型冰块藏在遗迹碎屑之间，直到突然开始滑动。
description.en: This small ice block sits among ruin debris until it begins to slide.

description.zh: 这块小型冰冻立方体的裂缝中藏着暗影，并会使附近空气变冷。
description.en: This small frozen cube carries shadow in its cracks and chills the air nearby.

description.zh: 它更大的利爪挖出隧道，供较小的掘穴生物跟随并守卫。
description.en: Its larger claws carve out tunnels that smaller burrowers follow and defend.

description.zh: 它会在沙地与断裂根须下方挖掘，待上方地面受到惊扰时猛然冲出。
description.en: It digs beneath sand and broken roots, then bursts forward when the ground above is disturbed.

description.zh: 体型更大的不死蝙蝠将洞穴最深处的穹顶据为猎场。
description.en: Larger undead bats claim the deepest cave ceilings as their hunting ground.

description.zh: 这些不死洞穴飞行生物会攀附在高处岩石上，等待动静从下方经过。
description.en: Undead cave flyers cling to high stone until movement passes beneath them.

description.zh: 这只薄翼昆虫乘着潮湿阵风，贴着湿草上方飞行。
description.en: This thin-winged insect rides humid gusts just above wet grass.

description.zh: 这些顽固的沼泽害虫会比同体型的大多数昆虫更长时间追随动静。
description.en: These persistent marsh pests follow movement longer than most insects their size.

description.zh: 体型更大的带刺昆虫会利用速度与距离不断骚扰闯入者。
description.en: Larger stinging insects use speed and distance to harass intruders.

description.zh: 苍白双翼反射着圣光，伴随这只蛾形生物从花朵上方升起。
description.en: Pale wings reflect holy light as this moth-like creature rises above the flowers.

description.zh: 苍白双翼带着月光粉尘穿过林谷中宁静的角落。
description.en: Pale wings carry moonlit dust through the quiet parts of the glen.

description.zh: 月光粉尘附着在双翼上，并在它施法时飘散于林谷之间。
description.en: Moonlit dust clings to its wings and drifts through the glen when it casts.

description.zh: 厚实菌盖能吸收攻击，而潮湿躯体则稳稳扎在水边。
description.en: Its thick cap absorbs blows while its damp body holds steady near the water.

description.zh: 这台小型城市机械沿着遗忘路线移动，仿佛仍在接收古老指令。
description.en: This small city machine moves along forgotten routes as if still receiving old commands.

description.zh: 这个暗影般的身影徘徊于古老书架之间，若放任不管便会变得更加危险。
description.en: This shadowy figure lingers among old shelves and grows more dangerous while it is left alone.

description.zh: 这个回声重复着神圣魔法的动作，但它的光芒显得空洞而遥远。
description.en: This echo repeats the motions of holy magic, but its light feels hollow and distant.

description.zh: 这个强大回声燃烧着狂战士怒火的形态。它会连续挥击，毫不停顿，也不会防御。
description.en: This powerful echo burns with the shape of a berserker's rage. It attacks in repeated swings without pausing to defend itself.

description.zh: 这个强大回声燃烧着狂战士怒火的形态。它会连续挥击，毫不停顿，也不会防御。
description.en: This powerful echo burns with the shape of a berserker's rage. It attacks in repeated swings without pausing to defend itself.

description.zh: 这个强大回声从远处开火，每一发射击周围都会汇聚风力。即使身躯逐渐消散在污浊空气中，它的准头依然稳定。
description.en: This powerful echo fires from a distance while wind gathers around each shot. Its aim stays steady even as its body fades into the stale air.

description.zh: 这个强大回声从远处开火，每一发射击周围都会汇聚风力。即使身躯逐渐消散在污浊空气中，它的准头依然稳定。
description.en: This powerful echo fires from a distance while wind gathers around each shot. Its aim stays steady even as its body fades into the stale air.

description.zh: 这个身披护甲的回声以盾牌守住阵地，冰冷雾气则汇聚在身体周围。
description.en: This armored echo guards its position with a shield and cold mist gathered around its body.

description.zh: 这个回声重复着法师的施法动作，而暗影则填满它周围的空间。
description.en: This echo repeats a mage's spellwork while shadow fills the space around it.

description.zh: 这个强大回声以死灵法师的形态行走于腐化大厅。每当它召唤亡者，墓穴能量便会在周围汇聚。
description.en: This powerful echo carries the shape of a necromancer into corrupted halls. Grave energy gathers around it when it calls on the dead.

description.zh: 这个强大回声以死灵法师的形态行走于腐化大厅。每当它召唤亡者，墓穴能量便会在周围汇聚。
description.en: This powerful echo carries the shape of a necromancer into corrupted halls. Grave energy gathers around it when it calls on the dead.

description.zh: 神圣铠甲与冰冷魔法环绕着这个强大回声，伴随它守护前方道路。当它架盾抵挡攻击时，霜冻便会汇聚在盾牌周围。
description.en: Sacred armor and cold magic surround this powerful echo as it guards the way ahead. Frost gathers around its shield when it braces for an attack.

description.zh: 神圣铠甲与冰冷魔法环绕着这个强大回声，伴随它守护前方道路。当它架盾抵挡攻击时，霜冻便会汇聚在盾牌周围。
description.en: Sacred armor and cold magic surround this powerful echo as it guards the way ahead. Frost gathers around its shield when it braces for an attack.

description.zh: 当这个强大回声开始施法时，圣光会诡异地在它周围弯曲。身处腐化大厅时，它的祝福显得冰冷而遥远。
description.en: Sacred light bends strangely around this powerful echo when it begins to cast. Its blessings feel cold and distant inside corrupted halls.

description.zh: 当这个强大回声开始施法时，圣光会诡异地在它周围弯曲。身处腐化大厅时，它的祝福显得冰冷而遥远。
description.en: Sacred light bends strangely around this powerful echo when it begins to cast. Its blessings feel cold and distant inside corrupted halls.

description.zh: 这个回声以训练有素的盗贼般行动，并在迅捷攻击中携带毒素。
description.en: This echo moves like a trained rogue and carries poison through its quick strikes.

description.zh: 它守望于残破大厅边缘，只会在找到更好的射击角度时移动。
description.en: It watches from the edge of ruined halls and moves only when it finds a better angle to fire.

description.zh: 这道躁动的诅咒贴着地面滑行，暗影则在它身周汇聚。
description.en: This restless curse slips across the ground while shadow gathers around its body.

description.zh: 这个强大回声以训练有素的忍者习性行动。毒素会在它的攻击周围汇聚，随后它便消失在黑暗走廊中。
description.en: This powerful echo moves with the habits of a trained shinobi. Poison gathers around its strikes before it vanishes back into dark corridors.

description.zh: 这个强大回声以训练有素的忍者习性行动。毒素会在它的攻击周围汇聚，随后它便消失在黑暗走廊中。
description.en: This powerful echo moves with the habits of a trained shinobi. Poison gathers around its strikes before it vanishes back into dark corridors.

description.zh: 这个回声重复着召唤术士的动作，墓穴能量则在它周围汇聚。
description.en: This echo carries the motions of a summoner while grave energy gathers around it.

description.zh: 这个回声保留着战士的形态，并在武器周围燃起火焰后向前冲锋。
description.en: This echo keeps the shape of a warrior and rushes forward with fire gathering around its weapon.

description.zh: 这个强大回声以训练有素的巫师动作塑造暗影魔法。每道法术释放前，黑暗能量都会在它周围汇聚。
description.en: This powerful echo shapes shadow magic with the movements of a trained wizard. Dark energy gathers around it before each spell is released.

description.zh: 这个强大回声以训练有素的巫师动作塑造暗影魔法。每道法术释放前，黑暗能量都会在它周围汇聚。
description.en: This powerful echo shapes shadow magic with the movements of a trained wizard. Dark energy gathers around it before each spell is released.

description.zh: 这台铸造厂机械的前端挤满传感器，用来搜寻周围动静。
description.en: Sensors crowd the front of this foundry machine as it searches for movement.

description.zh: 狭窄喷嘴会将压力与力量集中成短促而直接的攻击。
description.en: Its narrow nozzle focuses pressure and force into short, direct attacks.

description.zh: 蓝色幼体漂浮在海床附近，并用细小触手向外探寻。
description.en: Blue younglings drift near the seafloor and reach out with small arms.

description.zh: 橙色幼体十分大胆，经常抓住附近任何会动的东西。
description.en: Orange younglings are bold and often grab at anything that moves nearby.

description.zh: 紫色幼体会躲在昏暗珊瑚与阴影笼罩的岩石之间。
description.en: Purple younglings hide among dim coral and shadowed stone.

description.zh: 它利用众多触手在深层水流中稳住身体，同时从安全距离攻击目标。
description.en: It uses its many arms to steady itself in deep currents while striking targets from a safe distance.

description.zh: 它明亮的身体在清澈水中十分醒目，但会在大多数敌人靠近前先行攻击。
description.en: Its bright body is easy to see in clear water, but it attacks before most enemies can approach.

description.zh: 它潜伏于较暗的水域，待猎物进入攻击范围后把握时机发动袭击。
description.en: It waits in darker water and strikes with careful timing when prey moves into range.

description.zh: 这只橙色海洋生物利用众多触手控制身体周围的空间。
description.en: This orange sea creature uses its many arms to hold space around its body.

description.zh: 较暗的体色帮助这只章鱼潜伏在更深的阴影附近。
description.en: Darker coloring helps this octopus linger near deeper shadows.

description.zh: 苍白皮肤帮助这只章鱼融入破碎贝壳与浅色岩石之间。
description.en: Pale skin helps this octopus blend among broken shells and light stone.

description.zh: 宽阔花瓣让它如漂浮花朵般飘过湖边小径。
description.en: Broad petals let it drift across lake paths like a floating flower.

description.zh: 这个体型更大的灵体漂浮于地面上方，受到威胁时会迅速闪向一旁。
description.en: This larger spirit drifts above the ground and slips aside when threatened.

description.zh: 成排饥饿叶片会在猎物进入攻击范围时猛然咬合。
description.en: Rows of hungry leaves snap shut when prey moves within reach.

description.zh: 沼泽湿气让这株有毒植物即使深陷泥泞也能保持活跃。
description.en: Marsh moisture keeps this poisonous plant active even in deep mud.

description.zh: 这株扎根湿地的植物会向停留在攻击范围外的生物发射毒性弹射物。
description.en: This rooted wetland plant fires poisonous shots at creatures that stay out of reach.

description.zh: 这条有毒蠕虫藏在深层泥泞中，直到头顶的动静将它引向地表。
description.en: This poisonous worm hides in deep mud until movement overhead brings it to the surface.

description.zh: 它滚过洞穴时，膨胀身体中会不断泄出有毒烟雾。
description.en: Poisonous fumes leak from its swollen body as it rolls through the cavern.

description.zh: 细小的漂浮植物碎屑会乘着暖风穿过草原。
description.en: Tiny drifting plant matter follows warm air across the meadow.

description.zh: 这些小型花朵生物聚集在潮湿地面与宁静水边。
description.en: Small floral creatures gather near damp ground and quiet water.

description.zh: 这个练习目标被设计成静止不动，供冒险者测试攻击。
description.en: This practice target is built to stand still while adventurers test their attacks.

description.zh: 这条巨型不死蠕虫统治着湿润土壤的地下。每当它接近地表，地面便会隆起并崩裂。
description.en: This massive undead worm rules wet soil from beneath. The ground rises and breaks apart when it comes near the surface.

description.zh: 体型更大的兔子在走投无路时，能踢出惊人的力量。
description.en: Larger rabbits can kick with surprising force when cornered.

description.zh: 深色毛皮的下水道老鼠沿着潮湿角落与破碎石面穿行。
description.en: Dark-furred sewer rats slip along damp corners and broken stone.

description.zh: 灰色下水道老鼠会把污秽带遍潮湿隧道，并可能留下恶臭的咬伤。
description.en: Grey sewer rats carry grime through damp tunnels and can leave a foul bite behind.

description.zh: 苍白下水道老鼠会迅速穿过黑暗地面，并消失在狭窄缝隙中。
description.en: Pale sewer rats move quickly across dark floors and vanish into narrow gaps.

description.zh: 这台铸造厂机械冲过地面时，灼热刀刃会不断旋转。
description.en: Heated blades spin along this foundry machine as it rushes across the floor.

description.zh: 王冠般的脊棱标志着这只沙漠蝎是巢穴的统治者。攻击前，热量会在尾刺中汇聚。
description.en: A crown-like ridge marks this desert scorpion as the ruler of its nest. Heat gathers in its stinger before it strikes.

description.zh: 沙漠热量汇聚在它的甲壳与尾部，使高举的尾刺变得极难接近。
description.en: Desert heat gathers in its shell and tail, making its raised stinger dangerous to approach.

description.zh: 年幼的沙漠蝎藏在温热沙土下方，受到惊扰时便会以灼热尾刺攻击。
description.en: Young desert scorpions hide beneath warm sand and strike with heated stingers when disturbed.

description.zh: 这颗小种子会在草叶与松散土壤下方，因附近的动静而轻轻颤动。
description.en: This small seed stirs beneath grass and loose dirt when something comes near.

description.zh: 暗影附着在它宽阔的身体上，使轮廓在黑暗中难以辨认。
description.en: Shadow clings to its broad body and makes its outline difficult to read in dark places.

description.zh: 更深的黑暗环绕着这个体型更大的恶魔，伴随它以沉重而直接的攻击向前推进。
description.en: Deeper darkness gathers around this larger demon as it advances with heavy, direct attacks.

description.zh: 幼鲨会追逐任何在岸边溅起水花的东西。
description.en: Young sharks chase anything that splashes near the shore.

description.zh: 这名鲨鱼般的掠夺者会使用武器，却依然凭借海洋捕食者的本能发动攻击。
description.en: This shark-like raider uses weapons, but still attacks with the instincts of a sea predator.

description.zh: 这头深水捕食者会先在目标下方盘旋，随后猛然向上冲刺撕咬。
description.en: This deep-water predator circles below its target before rushing upward to bite.

description.zh: 这台紧凑机械会先把活动部件藏在圆形外壳下，随后向前冲锋。
description.en: This compact machine hides moving parts beneath a rounded shell before charging forward.

description.zh: 水面涟漪往往会在这只带壳生物现身前暴露它的位置。
description.en: Ripples often reveal this shelled creature before its body appears.

description.zh: 巨型骨骼摩擦着城堡石面，伴随这头不死蛮兽向前推进。
description.en: Giant bones scrape against castle stone as this undead brute advances.

description.zh: 脆弱双手描绘着古老法术轨迹，墓穴魔法则在骨骼之间汇聚。
description.en: Brittle hands trace old spell patterns while grave magic gathers between its bones.

description.zh: 骨骼在林间咔啦作响，而这名不死战士的移动速度比预想中更快。
description.en: Bones rattle through the woods as this undead fighter moves faster than expected.

description.zh: 这团果冻般的黏液在湿地泥泞中弹跳，落地之处会留下毒素。
description.en: This jelly-like slime bounces through wetland mud and leaves poison where it lands.

description.zh: 这团巨型有毒黏液滚过深层泥泞，身后留下一道浓厚痕迹。
description.en: This large poisonous slime rolls through deep mud and leaves a thick trail behind it.

description.zh: 这团黏液在湿地上缓慢爬行，身后留下一层淡淡的毒性光泽。
description.en: This slime creeps across wet ground and leaves a faint poisonous sheen behind.

description.zh: 这名蛇族统治者盘踞于幽深黑暗的通道中。它的毒液强到足以让其他洞穴生物远远避开。
description.en: This serpent ruler coils in deep, dark passages. Its venom is strong enough to keep other cave creatures away.

description.zh: 这条洞穴毒蛇盘绕在松散石块之间，并以带毒獠牙发动攻击。
description.en: This cave serpent coils between loose stones and strikes with venomous fangs.

description.zh: 小蛇会穿过狭窄裂缝，并在大型生物经过时扑咬。
description.en: Small serpents slip through narrow cracks and bite when larger creatures pass by.

description.zh: 前端的长形传感器帮助它在攻击前锁定目标。
description.en: The long sensor on its front helps it track targets before it strikes.

description.zh: 这具圆形躯体滚过水晶地面时，冰冷压力会在内部不断汇聚。
description.en: Cold pressure gathers inside its round body as it rolls across crystal floors.

description.zh: 军用装甲保护着这台机器人，伴随它沿直线向目标推进。
description.en: Military plating protects this robot as it advances in direct lines toward its target.

description.zh: 这个体型更大的灵体以沉稳动作与宁静光芒塑造神圣力量。
description.en: This larger spirit shapes holy power with steady movements and a calm glow.

description.zh: 这个小型光之灵体安静地漂浮于神圣大厅中。
description.en: This small spirit of light floats quietly through sacred halls.

description.zh: 体型更大的洞穴蜘蛛占据更深的通道，并用有毒蛛网覆盖其中。
description.en: Larger cave spiders claim deeper passages and cover them with venomous webs.

description.zh: 这台多足机械会从工厂地面指挥小型蜘蛛机器人。准备攻击时，暗影会在它的框架下方汇聚。
description.en: This many-legged machine directs smaller spider robots from the factory floor. Shadow gathers beneath its frame while it prepares to attack.

description.zh: 金属长腿载着这台蜘蛛机械迅速穿过破碎的金属通道。
description.en: Metal legs carry this spider machine quickly across broken metal paths.

description.zh: 绿色毒液在獠牙上凝成液珠，随后它便会从掩体中猛冲而出。
description.en: Green venom beads along its fangs before it darts from cover.

description.zh: 细长的腿让这只洞穴蜘蛛能在咬击前迅速爬过石面。
description.en: Thin legs carry this cave spider quickly across stone before it bites.

description.zh: 小型蜘蛛机械贴近地面，爬过电缆与废料。
description.en: Small spider machines crawl through cables and scrap while staying close to the ground.

description.zh: 锋利装甲与熔炉热量让这台机械在加速时格外危险。
description.en: Sharp plating and furnace heat make this machine dangerous when it accelerates.

description.zh: 锋利脊棱保护着这只湖中生物，使好奇的捕食者难以靠近。
description.en: Sharp ridges protect this lake creature from curious predators.

description.zh: 这个躁动灵体会在视野边缘摇曳，随后出现在另一处。
description.en: This restless spirit wavers at the edge of sight before appearing somewhere else.

description.zh: 干燥风流会把它圆形身体上的孢子吹过沙漠小径。
description.en: Dry winds carry spores from its round body across the desert path.

description.zh: 它年幼的树干比外表更加坚固，足以击退靠得太近的生物。
description.en: Its young trunk is sturdier than it looks, allowing it to knock back creatures that get too close.

description.zh: 幼年鱿鱼以短促而迟疑的爆发动作漂过深海。
description.en: Young squid drift through the depths in short, uncertain bursts.

description.zh: 这只体型过大的草原昆虫统治着较小虫群上方的天空。它迅猛俯冲时极难持续锁定。
description.en: This oversized meadow insect rules the air above lesser swarms. Its rapid dives make it difficult to keep in sight.

description.zh: 带电空气会在它狭长的框架周围汇聚，随后释放一道锐利的风力冲击。
description.en: Charged air gathers around its narrow frame before it releases a sharp burst of wind.

description.zh: 当这名扎根原地的施法者吸收神圣魔法时，阳光照耀的花瓣便会绽开。
description.en: Sunlit petals open when this rooted caster draws in holy magic.

description.zh: 这个辉耀的花灵会从林谷明亮的角落汇聚圣光。释放强力法术前，它的花瓣会张得更开。
description.en: This radiant bloom-spirit gathers holy light from the bright corners of the glen. Its petals open wider before it releases a powerful spell.

description.zh: 金色花瓣与纤细双翼会先汇聚光芒，随后这个仙子般的生物才会施法。
description.en: Golden petals and delicate wings gather light before this fairy-like creature casts.

description.zh: 厚重装甲覆盖着这台城市机械，使其能像移动路障般滚滚向前。
description.en: Heavy plating covers this city machine and lets it roll forward like a moving barricade.

description.zh: 这个简单的目标标记用于检查瞄准与练习伤害。
description.en: This simple target marker is used for aim checks and damage practice.

description.zh: 裸露面板与老旧电路覆盖着这台坚固机械，但它依然会以强大力量向前推进。
description.en: Exposed panels and old circuitry cover a sturdy machine that still pushes forward with force.

description.zh: 盘绕的肢体会让风能以脉冲波动穿过它的机械躯体。
description.en: Coiled limbs channel wind energy through its mechanical body in pulsing waves.

description.zh: 每当它向前猛进时，水流便会环绕甲壳翻涌。
description.en: Water surges around its shell whenever it drives forward.

description.zh: 热量会在它的甲壳表面层层积聚，随后释放火焰魔法。
description.en: Heat builds across its shell in steady layers before it releases fire magic.

description.zh: 每当它转身或向前迈步时，风便会以沉重脉冲环绕甲壳翻滚。
description.en: Wind rolls around its shell in heavy pulses whenever it turns or steps forward.

description.zh: 浸水根须让它稳稳立住，即使菌盖被沉重攻击震得摇晃。它可从不缺练手臂。
description.en: Waterlogged roots keep it steady, even when its cap shakes from a heavy strike. Never skips arm day.

description.zh: 这个坚固的训练目标被设计成承受冒险者练习时的反复攻击。
description.en: This sturdy training target is built to endure repeated strikes from practicing adventurers.

description.zh: 当树皮下方积聚热量时，秋叶便会在枝头噼啪作响。
description.en: Autumn leaves crackle along its branches when heat builds beneath the bark.

description.zh: 常青树枝覆盖着坚固躯体，并从森林土壤中汲取力量。
description.en: Evergreen branches cover a sturdy body that draws strength from the forest soil.

description.zh: 这名幼年树人带着余烬色的叶片，移动时会洒落火花。
description.en: This young treant carries ember-colored leaves that scatter sparks when it moves.

description.zh: 这名幼年树人看起来只是一株小树苗，直到它从路边迈出脚步。
description.en: This young treant looks like a small sapling until it steps from the path.

description.zh: 每当树皮下方积聚热量时，干燥的秋叶便会在枝头噼啪作响。
description.en: Dry autumn leaves crackle along its branches whenever hidden heat builds beneath the bark.

description.zh: 它的常青枝叶移动缓慢，但每一次挥击都承载着古老森林巨木的重量。
description.en: Its evergreen branches move slowly, but each swing carries the weight of an old forest tree.

description.zh: Trooper 型机器人依靠厚重装甲与简单直接的动作，强行突破一切阻碍。
description.en: Trooper models use heavy armor and simple movement to force their way through resistance.

description.zh: 它沉重的龟壳从富含矿物的水域中积蓄矿物沉积。每当它发动冲锋，脚下的大地都会震动。
description.en: Its heavy shell stores mineral deposits from mineral-rich waters. When it charges, the ground shakes beneath its feet.

description.zh: 蓝壳海龟游动沉稳，除非受到威胁，否则几乎从不匆忙。
description.en: Blue-shelled turtles swim steadily and rarely hurry unless threatened.

description.zh: 绿色龟壳帮助这些海龟融入岸边植物与浅水之中。
description.en: Green shells help these turtles blend with shoreline plants and shallow water.

description.zh: 红壳海龟在沙滩与浪花间格外醒目，但一旦有人靠近便会迅速缩回壳中。
description.en: Red-shelled turtles stand out against sand and surf but withdraw quickly when approached.

description.zh: 幼龟依靠龟壳保护自己，并随着海浪沿岸漂行。
description.en: Young turtles rely on their shells while waves carry them along the shore.

description.zh: 这些体型更大的洞穴飞行生物偏爱受伤的猎物，并以带毒咬击发动攻击。
description.en: These larger cave flyers favor wounded prey and strike with venomous bites.

description.zh: 这头被暗影触碰的野兽以锐利爪牙与迅捷动作穿行于黑暗森林。旅人往往先听见它的嚎叫，随后才看见它的身影。
description.en: This shadow-touched beast hunts through dark woods with sharp claws and quick movement. Its howl often reaches travelers before its body appears.

description.zh: 这名小型沙漠施法者将松散气流旋成紧密的魔法漏斗。
description.en: This small desert caster spins loose air into a tight magical funnel.

description.zh: 这名体型更大的风系施法者会坚守原地，任由强劲气流环绕周身。
description.en: This larger wind caster holds position while strong currents circle around it.

description.zh: 狂风在这个漂浮恶魔周围汇聚，直到整片开阔空气都化作它的武器。
description.en: Gusts gather around this drifting demon until the open air becomes its weapon.

description.zh: 这个微小的蓝色灵体带着清凉微光穿过草原与林荫小径。
description.en: This tiny blue spirit carries a cool shimmer through meadows and shaded paths.

description.zh: 紫色光芒在草丛间上下浮动，微弱阵风则在它下方盘旋。
description.en: Purple light bobs through the grass while faint gusts swirl beneath it.

description.zh: 这个小型红色灵体在草原上方闪烁，受到惊扰时便会骤然迸发。
description.en: This small red spirit flickers above the meadow and flares up when disturbed.

description.zh: 黄色光芒在这个微小灵体周围贴近地面汇聚，随后大地便开始移动。
description.en: Yellow light gathers near the ground around this tiny spirit before the earth begins to shift.

description.zh: 年幼的暗影狼以迅捷咬击与突然冲刺练习狩猎。
description.en: Young shadow wolves practice hunting with quick bites and sudden dashes.

description.zh: 瘦削的狼群潜行于森林深处的幽暗小径，并以短促冲刺扑向猎物。
description.en: Lean wolves stalk the darker forest paths and rush at prey in short bursts.

description.zh: 这条巨型洞穴蠕虫在接近地表的石土中钻行。毒液从它体内渗出，浸染周围地面。
description.en: This great cavern worm pushes through stone and soil near the surface. Poison seeps from its body into the ground around it.

description.zh: 腐臭烟气跟随着这只掘穴生物穿过潮湿的洞穴土壤。
description.en: Rotten fumes follow this burrowing creature through damp cavern soil.

description.zh: 这条较小的蠕虫会在挖出的隧道中留下一道酸臭痕迹。
description.en: This smaller worm leaves a sour trail through the tunnels it digs.

description.zh: 陈旧血肉与墓土附着在这只掘穴生物身上，伴随它拖行于潮湿地面。
description.en: Old flesh and grave soil cling to this burrowing creature as it drags itself through wet ground.

description.zh: 这名墓穴统治者游移于尸骸与灵体之间。它穿过黑暗时，躁动不安的亡者会聚集在身旁。
description.en: This crypt ruler drifts between corpse and spirit. Restless dead gather near it as it moves through the darkness.

description.zh: 这头僵尸巨人利用沉重身躯堵住洞穴通道。
description.en: This zombie giant uses its heavy body to block cave paths.

description.zh: 这名僵尸统治者残破的躯体依然保留着号令的姿态。较弱的尸骸会在洞穴中聚集于它身旁。
description.en: This zombie ruler still carries the shape of command in its ruined body. Lesser corpses gather near it in the cave.

description.zh: 小型僵尸在洞穴中蹒跚前行，直到身体彻底破碎才会停下。
description.en: Small zombies stumble through the cave and keep moving until their bodies break.

description.zh: 锈蚀装备与残存训练，引导这名不死士兵发动简单攻击。
description.en: Rusted gear and old training guide this undead soldier through simple attacks.

description.zh: 辉耀圣光环绕使用者，短时间内将袭来的伤害偏转开。
description.en: Radiant light surrounds the user, turning incoming harm aside for a short time.

description.zh: 目标将注意力锁定在施法者身上，把所有敌意都转向对方。
description.en: The target fixates on the caster, turning all aggression their way.

description.zh: 更加敏锐的专注提高使用者的反应速度与命中能力。
description.en: Sharpened focus improves the user's reflexes and aim.

description.zh: 高涨的动势使使用者的技能恢复得更快。
description.en: The user's skills recover faster under heightened momentum.

description.zh: 神圣谴责灼烧目标，并随着层数积累变得更加强烈。
description.en: Holy condemnation burns the target and grows stronger as it builds.

description.zh: 召唤物散发天使恩典，提高附近盟友受到的治疗效果。
description.en: The summon radiates angelic grace, increasing healing received by nearby allies.

description.zh: 奥术力量强化法术并加快施法，但会消耗更多魔力。
description.en: Arcane power strengthens spells and speeds casting at a heavier mana cost.

description.zh: 受损的护甲使目标更容易受到惩罚。
description.en: Damaged armor leaves the target easier to punish.

description.zh: 召唤物散发防护装甲，强化附近盟友，同时以防护保护自身。
description.en: The summon radiates protective armor, strengthening nearby allies while shielding itself with Protection.

description.zh: 一道神圣屏障以防护之光包裹目标。
description.en: A sacred barrier wraps the target in protective light.

description.zh: 使用者进入狂暴姿态，抵抗干扰，并以大范围挥击形成残酷压制。
description.en: The user enters a violent stance, resisting disruption and turning wide swings into brutal pressure.

description.zh: 让攻击附带锯齿般的伤口，使其有概率施加流血。
description.en: Empower your attacks with jagged strikes, giving them a chance to apply Bleeding.

description.zh: 开放性伤口持续流血，阻止自然恢复，并随着层数积累进一步恶化。
description.en: Open wounds bleed steadily, halting natural recovery and worsening as they build.

description.zh: 神圣祝福提高战斗中的物理力量、魔法、幸运与命中能力。
description.en: A holy blessing improves physical strength, magic, luck, and accuracy in battle.

description.zh: 受阻的视野使目标难以瞄准、闪避与打出暴击。
description.en: Clouded vision makes the target struggle to aim, evade, and land critical blows.

description.zh: 使使用者免受致盲。
description.en: Shields the user from Blind.

description.zh: 鲜血涌回使用者体内，在一段时间内持续恢复生命。
description.en: Blood surges back into the user, restoring life over time.

description.zh: 使用者被不断驱使向前，攻击速度提高，并在身后留下伤口。
description.en: The user is driven forward, striking faster and leaving wounds in their wake.

description.zh: 使用者从自己造成的每一道伤口中汲取力量。
description.en: The user feeds on every wound they open.

description.zh: 孤注一掷的攻击会将借来的生命返还给使用者。
description.en: Desperate blows return borrowed life to the user.

description.zh: Twin Cleave 会对已经处于眩晕状态的敌人造成更深的伤害。
description.en: Twin Cleave bites deeper into enemies already Stunned.

description.zh: Vortex Slash 会从使用者的动势中汇聚更强的残暴力量。
description.en: Vortex Slash gathers more brutal force from the user's momentum.

description.zh: Bash 会以更沉重的冲击命中，并产生更广的震荡。
description.en: Bash lands with heavier impact and a wider shock.

description.zh: Smite 会以更强力量命中，并在其后召来 Holy Light。
description.en: Smite strikes with greater force and calls Holy Light in its wake.

description.zh: Earth Splitter 会造成更重的冲击，并可能使敌人踉跄。
description.en: Earth Splitter lands harder and can leave enemies reeling.

description.zh: 火焰附着在目标身上持续灼烧，并随着层数积累进一步恶化。
description.en: Flames cling to the target, burning steadily and worsening as they build.

description.zh: 使使用者免受灼烧。
description.en: Shields the user from Burning.

description.zh: 下一道法术已准备完毕，几乎可以瞬间施放。
description.en: The next spell is prepared to cast almost instantly.

description.zh: 使用者从视野中淡去，恢复速度降低，但下一次起手攻击会更加凌厉。
description.en: The user fades from sight, slowing recovery but setting up a sharper opening strike.

description.zh: 使用者以战斗速度骑乘，同时保持随时作战的状态。
description.en: The user rides at combat speed while staying ready for battle.

description.zh: 提高连击终结技造成的伤害。
description.en: Increases damage of Combo Finisher skills.

description.zh: 使用者的召唤术得到强化，提升召唤物与辅助魔法的效果。
description.en: The user's conjuring strengthens summons and supportive magic.

description.zh: 尸体魔法形成一道屏障，保护使用者，并使其更能抵抗干扰。
description.en: Corpse magic forms a barrier that shields the user and steadies them against disruption.

description.zh: 倒下的目标会在死亡时因尸体魔法而爆炸。
description.en: Fallen targets erupt with corpse magic when they die.

description.zh: 使用者架势迎接下一次物理攻击，并以 Counter Slash 进行反击。
description.en: The user braces for the next physical hit, answering it with Counter Slash.

description.zh: 黑暗诅咒会使治疗反噬目标，并削弱其魔法防御。
description.en: A dark curse turns healing against the target and weakens magical defenses.

description.zh: 使使用者免受诅咒。
description.en: Shields the user from Curse.

description.zh: 使用者通过伤口汲取生命力，并借由死亡之契共享这份恢复。
description.en: The user steals vitality through wounds and shares that recovery through a deathly bond.

description.zh: 使用者的武器获得不死力量，强化死灵攻击。
description.en: The user's weapon takes on Undead power, strengthening necrotic strikes.

description.zh: 目标面对不死敌人时力量会受到削弱。
description.en: The target's strength falters against Undead foes.

description.zh: 不死腐朽侵蚀目标，随着扩散不断削弱其恢复能力。
description.en: Undead decay eats at the target, weakening recovery as it spreads.

description.zh: 使使用者免受衰败。
description.en: Shields the user from Decay.

description.zh: 使用者强化自身，以抵御即将受到的惩罚。
description.en: The user hardens against incoming punishment.

description.zh: 神圣力量提升治疗，并使祝福持续更久，但会消耗更多魔力。
description.en: Divine power improves healing and lets blessings linger at a higher mana cost.

description.zh: 使用者汲取地元素之力，强化大地魔法与威力。
description.en: The user draws on Earth, strengthening earth magic and force.

description.zh: 大地防护强化使用者，并可能以眩晕回应来袭攻击。
description.en: Earthen protection hardens the user and can answer incoming blows with Stun.

description.zh: 元素符印会在施法者周围升起一道地属性的奥术屏障。
description.en: Elemental sigils raise an earth-aligned arcane barrier around the caster.

description.zh: 目标暴露于地元素之力，使大地力量对其更加有效。
description.en: The target is exposed to Earth, making earthen power more effective.

description.zh: 日蚀屏障保护使用者，并在破裂时释放 Sacred Blast。
description.en: An eclipsed barrier protects the user and releases Sacred Blast when it breaks.

description.zh: 使用者同时汲取火、水、风与地元素之力。
description.en: The user draws on Fire, Water, Wind, and Earth at once.

description.zh: 使用者以不可思议的时机闪过攻击与法术。
description.en: The user slips through attacks and spells with impossible timing.

description.zh: 以神圣力量包裹使用者的护甲。
description.en: Wraps the user's armor in Holy power.

description.zh: 使攻击获得地元素。
description.en: Imbue your attacks with the Earth element.

description.zh: 使攻击获得火元素。
description.en: Imbue your attacks with the Fire element.

description.zh: 使攻击获得神圣元素。
description.en: Imbue your attacks with the Holy element.

description.zh: 使攻击获得毒元素。
description.en: Imbue your attacks with the Poison element.

description.zh: 使攻击获得暗影元素。
description.en: Imbue your attacks with the Shadow element.

description.zh: 使攻击获得不死元素。
description.en: Imbue your attacks with the Undead element.

description.zh: 使攻击获得水元素。
description.en: Imbue your attacks with the Water element.

description.zh: 使攻击获得风元素。
description.en: Imbue your attacks with the Wind element.

description.zh: 使用者稳住架势，拒绝因攻击而退缩，同时强化自身防御。
description.en: The user steadies their stance, refusing to flinch as their guard hardens.

description.zh: 一道闪耀护盾会将部分袭来伤害转移至魔力。
description.en: A shimmering shield diverts part of incoming harm into mana.

description.zh: 怒气在目标体内爆发，将其推入更加暴烈的状态。
description.en: Rage surges through the target, pushing them into a more violent state.

description.zh: 神圣烙印灼烧目标，并随着审判累积变得更加严酷。
description.en: A holy brand sears the target, growing harsher as judgment builds.

description.zh: 狂热攻击可通过普通攻击触发 Smite。
description.en: Zealous attacks can call Smite through ordinary strikes.

description.zh: 召唤物散发原始凶性，提高附近盟友的攻击与魔法攻击。
description.en: The summon radiates raw ferocity, increasing nearby allies' Attack and Magic Attack.

description.zh: 使用者汲取火元素之力，强化火焰魔法与威力。
description.en: The user draws on Fire, strengthening flame magic and force.

description.zh: 火焰保护使用者，并可能以灼烧回应来袭攻击。
description.en: Flame shields the user and can answer incoming blows with Burning.

description.zh: 元素符印会在施法者周围升起一道火属性的奥术屏障。
description.en: Elemental sigils raise a fire-aligned arcane barrier around the caster.

description.zh: 目标暴露于火元素之力，使火焰对其更加有效。
description.en: The target is exposed to Fire, making flame more effective.

description.zh: 使用者的武器燃起火元素之力，攻击时有概率释放 Firebolt。
description.en: The user's weapon burns with Fire, sometimes releasing Firebolt on attack.

description.zh: 动势推动使用者前进，使移动更加轻快迅速。
description.en: Momentum carries the user forward with lighter, faster movement.

description.zh: 奥术节奏使普通攻击更频繁地回响出魔法。
description.en: Arcane rhythm lets auto attacks echo with magic more often.

description.zh: 专注施法改善法术时机，并使效果持续更久。
description.en: Focused casting improves spell timing and helps effects linger longer.

description.zh: 让攻击覆盖霜冻，使其有概率施加冻结。
description.en: Coat your attacks in frost, giving them a chance to apply Frozen.

description.zh: 使用者被驱入更加迅速且毫不间断的攻击状态。
description.en: The user is driven into faster, more relentless attacks.

description.zh: 冻结将目标锁在原地，使其无法行动或防御。
description.en: Frozen locks the target in place, leaving them unable to act or defend.

description.zh: 使使用者免受冻结。
description.en: Shields the user from Frozen.

description.zh: 使用者的怒火提高打出暴击的概率。
description.en: The user's fury raises the chance of a critical strike.

description.zh: 赋予使用者狂怒与威能。
description.en: Grants the user Fury and Might.

description.zh: 使用者在完美的 Game Master Cloaking 下彻底消失。
description.en: The user vanishes under perfect Game Master cloaking.

description.zh: Holy Light 的恩典被消耗时会返还魔力。
description.en: Holy Light returns mana when its grace is consumed.

description.zh: 神圣恩典以非凡力量恢复生命与魔力。
description.en: Divine grace restores life and mana with exceptional force.

description.zh: 冰冷而躁动的动势提高使用者的移动与攻击速度。
description.en: Cold, restless momentum quickens the user's movement and attacks.

description.zh: 墓寒会降低敌人的移动与攻击速度。
description.en: Grave chill slows the enemy's movement and attacks.

description.zh: 赋予使用者生命力与再生。
description.en: Grants the user Vitality and Regeneration.

description.zh: 守护灵保护使用者免受远程攻击。
description.en: A guardian spirit shelters the user from ranged attacks.

description.zh: 使用者的步伐与反应速度提高。
description.en: The user's steps and reflexes quicken.

description.zh: 使用者举起沉重防御，以速度换取更强保护。
description.en: The user raises a heavy guard, sacrificing speed for protection.

description.zh: 每层积累的神圣力量都会强化神圣魔法与施法专注。
description.en: Sacred power builds with each stack, strengthening Holy magic and casting focus.

description.zh: 祝圣之光使目标更易受到神圣力量影响。
description.en: Consecrated light leaves the target vulnerable to Holy power.

description.zh: 神圣盾牌提高格挡能力，并让使用者在压力下稳定施法。
description.en: A holy shield improves blocking and keeps casting steady under pressure.

description.zh: Fire Release、Ice Release 与 Lightning Release 会以磨砺后的力量命中。
description.en: Fire Release, Ice Release, and Lightning Release strike with honed force.

description.zh: 使用者的武器流动着水元素之力，攻击时有概率释放 Icebolt。
description.en: The user's weapon flows with Water, sometimes releasing Icebolt on attack.

description.zh: 召唤强化魔法、施法，以及召唤物触发的 Soul Strike 回响。
description.en: Invocation strengthens magic, casting, and Soul Strike echoes from summons.

description.zh: Impale 与 Air Cutter 会以严谨的力量命中。
description.en: Impale and Air Cutter strike with disciplined force.

description.zh: Explosive Grenade 会以更强力量发射。
description.en: Explosive Grenade launches with greater force.

description.zh: 盟友受到的伤害会被转移至建立联系的使用者身上。
description.en: An ally's pain is redirected onto the bonded user.

description.zh: 召唤物散发噼啪作响的能量，加快附近盟友的速度并强化其闪避动作。
description.en: The summon radiates crackling energy, quickening nearby allies and sharpening their evasive movement.

description.zh: 使用者的攻击与闪避动作因雷电般的反应而加快。
description.en: The user's attacks and evasive movement quicken with crackling reflexes.

description.zh: 使用者的武器缠绕风元素之力，攻击时有概率释放 Thunderbolt。
description.en: The user's weapon crackles with Wind, sometimes releasing Thunderbolt on attack.

description.zh: 使用者燃烧自身突破常规极限，获得可怕的进攻能力，但失去防御与恢复。
description.en: The user burns past normal limits, gaining terrifying offense while losing defense and recovery.

description.zh: 使用者被固定在原地，而攻击会进入毫不停歇的节奏。
description.en: The user is rooted in place while attacks drive into a relentless rhythm.

description.zh: 随着奥术暴露积累，目标受到的魔法伤害提高。
description.en: The target suffers more from magic as arcane exposure builds.

description.zh: 施放 Tetra Vortex 时会回响并返还魔力。
description.en: Tetra Vortex echoes back mana when cast.

description.zh: 被标记的目标更容易被命中，也更易受到暴击。
description.en: The marked target becomes easier to hit and more vulnerable to critical strikes.

description.zh: 随着力量积累，使用者的近战、远程与魔法攻击都会增强。
description.en: The user's melee, ranged, and magic attacks grow stronger as power builds.

description.zh: 崩溃的心智使目标的魔法防御暴露无遗。
description.en: A broken mind leaves magical defenses exposed.

description.zh: 使用者在骑乘时快速移动，但发动攻击会结束骑乘状态。
description.en: The user moves swiftly while mounted, but attacking breaks the ride.

description.zh: 普通攻击有概率额外攻击多次。
description.en: Gives auto attacks a chance to strike additional times.

description.zh: 敌人陷入狂怒的攻击状态。
description.en: The enemy flies into a furious attacking state.

description.zh: 敌人获得暴烈强化，且该效果无法被驱散。
description.en: The enemy becomes violently empowered and cannot be dispelled.

description.zh: 敌人强化自身进行最后抵抗，并通过攻击汲取生命。
description.en: The enemy hardens for a last stand and steals life through attacks.

description.zh: 敌人的攻击与闪避动作加快。
description.en: The enemy's attacks and evasive movement quicken.

description.zh: 敌人的攻击更容易打出暴击。
description.en: The enemy's strikes become more likely to land critically.

description.zh: 袭来的魔法会有一部分反射回攻击者。
description.en: Incoming magic is partly reflected back at the attacker.

description.zh: 物理伤害会反射回攻击者。
description.en: Physical punishment is reflected back at attackers.

description.zh: 敌人举起防御，使格挡更加频繁。
description.en: The enemy raises its guard, making blocks more frequent.

description.zh: 下一次攻击会被引导为一次完美暴击。
description.en: The next strike is guided toward a perfect critical hit.

description.zh: Panic Burst 与 Fan Fire 会覆盖更广、更猛烈的区域。
description.en: Panic Burst and Fan Fire cover a wider, more violent area.

description.zh: 毒在目标体内流动，干扰魔力恢复，并随着层数积累进一步恶化。
description.en: Poison courses through the target, disrupting mana recovery and worsening as it builds.

description.zh: 目标暴露于毒元素之力，使毒素对其更加有效。
description.en: The target is exposed to Poison, making toxins more effective.

description.zh: 使使用者免受毒。
description.en: Shields the user from Poison.

description.zh: 使用者举起防御，抵挡袭来的攻击。
description.en: The user raises their guard against incoming blows.

description.zh: 每次普通攻击都会使神圣力量在使用者周围积累。
description.en: Sacred power builds around auto attacks with each strike.

description.zh: 辉耀力量以神圣防护环绕使用者。
description.en: Radiant force surrounds the user with holy protection.

description.zh: 每一道伤口都会以一定代价滋养使用者的进攻怒火。
description.en: Each wound feeds the user's offensive fury at a cost.

description.zh: 使用者持续恢复，并更容易接受治疗。
description.en: The user recovers steadily and receives healing more easily.

description.zh: 阻止目标通过隐匿隐藏自己。
description.en: Prevents the target from hiding through Cloaking.

description.zh: Sniper Shot 会获得更强的制止威力。
description.en: Sniper Shot fires with greater stopping power.

description.zh: 下一次攻击造成更高伤害，随后这一破绽便会消失。
description.en: The next attack strikes harder, then the opening fades.

description.zh: 神圣魔法得到强化，Holy Light 的作用距离更远，但会消耗更多魔力。
description.en: Holy magic strengthens and Holy Light reaches farther at a greater mana cost.

description.zh: 神圣地面会减轻危险地形效果造成的伤害。
description.en: Sacred ground softens the harm from dangerous terrain effects.

description.zh: 使用者消耗生命，释放神圣伤害。
description.en: The user spends life to release Holy damage.

description.zh: Sanctify 会覆盖更大的范围。
description.en: Sanctify reaches a wider area.

description.zh: 使用者的治疗效果提高，同时受到的伤害降低。
description.en: The user heals more effectively while taking less harm.

description.zh: 标记目标，以供 Shadow Trail 使用。
description.en: Marks the target for Shadow Trail.

description.zh: 使用者在面对近战与远程压力时保持稳定，抵抗退缩与击退。
description.en: The user steadies against melee and ranged pressure, resisting flinching and knockback.

description.zh: Point Blank 会以更强的近距离威力开火。
description.en: Point Blank fires with greater close-range force.

description.zh: 阻止目标施法。
description.en: Prevents the target from casting.

description.zh: 使使用者免受沉默。
description.en: Shields the user from Silence.

description.zh: 来自暗影的暴击机会会变得更加凌厉。
description.en: Critical openings from the shadows become sharper.

description.zh: 使用者坐下休息，更快恢复生命与魔力。
description.en: The user rests, restoring life and mana more quickly.

description.zh: 目标的移动、施法与攻击速度降低。
description.en: The target's movement, casting, and attacks slow down.

description.zh: 使使用者免受减速。
description.en: Shields the user from Slow.

description.zh: 烟雾隐藏使用者，并帮助其穿过危险。
description.en: Smoke hides the user and helps them slip through danger.

description.zh: 使用者进入固定射击姿态，强化远程攻击，但限制移动能力。
description.en: The user settles into a firing position, empowering ranged attacks while limiting movement.

description.zh: 暴力与倒下的敌人会为使用者返还生命与魔力。
description.en: Violence and fallen enemies return life and mana to the user.

description.zh: 倒下的目标可能以 Skeletons 的形态重新站起。
description.en: Fallen targets can rise again as Skeletons.

description.zh: 长矛攻击速度提高，同时使用者的命中能力得到改善。
description.en: Spearwork quickens and the user's accuracy improves.

description.zh: 袭来的魔法会被反射回其来源。
description.en: Incoming magic is reflected back at its source.

description.zh: 阻止目标攻击或施法。
description.en: Prevents the target from attacking or casting.

description.zh: 使用者的魔力储备与恢复能力得到增强。
description.en: The user's mana reserves and recovery deepen.

description.zh: 阻止退缩与击退。
description.en: Prevents flinching and knockback.

description.zh: 目标的防御被击破，使其更容易受到伤害。
description.en: The target's guard breaks, leaving defenses exposed.

description.zh: 使用者能更快从闪避中恢复。
description.en: The user recovers from dodges more quickly.

description.zh: 目标被彻底控制，无法行动、逃脱或格挡。
description.en: The target is locked down, unable to act, escape, or block.

description.zh: 使使用者免受眩晕。
description.en: Shields the user from Stun.

description.zh: 被召唤的盟友以不自然的速度移动。
description.en: Summoned allies move with unnatural speed.

description.zh: 将敌人的注意力引向使用者。
description.en: Draws enemy attention toward the user.

description.zh: 每次使用 Tempest 与 Chain Lightning 都会积累风暴力量，但会消耗更多魔力。
description.en: Tempest and Chain Lightning build storm power with each use at a greater mana cost.

description.zh: 使用者会在保持灵活移动的同时自动开火。
description.en: The user fires automatically while staying light on their feet.

description.zh: 沉重挥击速度提高，并能造成更凌厉的暴击。
description.en: Heavy swings quicken and land with sharper critical force.

description.zh: 目标受到诅咒。\n死亡降临时，会召唤一个 Curse Manifestation。
description.en: The target is cursed.\nWhen death claims them, they summon a Curse Manifestation.

description.zh: 目标受到暗影标记，使袭来的攻击造成更高伤害。
description.en: The target is marked by shadow, causing incoming attacks to hit harder.

description.zh: 亵渎力量使目标更易受到不死能量影响。
description.en: Desecrated power leaves the target vulnerable to Undead energy.

description.zh: 使用者周围的不死与暗影力量得到增强。
description.en: Undead and Shadow power grow stronger around the user.

description.zh: 黑暗力量灼烧使用者，以安全换取进攻能力。
description.en: Dark power burns the user, trading safety for offense.

description.zh: 使用者坚定的意志会挡开几乎所有袭来伤害。
description.en: The user's resolve turns aside nearly all incoming harm.

description.zh: 为攻击涂覆毒液，使每次攻击都有概率施加毒。
description.en: Coat your attacks in venom, giving each strike a chance to apply Poison.

description.zh: 使用者移动时会在身后留下毒。
description.en: Poison trails behind the user as they move.

description.zh: 使用者的身体得到强化，使生命力更加深厚。
description.en: The user's body strengthens, deepening their life force.

description.zh: 使用者受到攻击时会积累不稳定能量，并在压力达到顶峰时爆发。
description.en: Unstable energy builds when the user is struck, erupting once the pressure peaks.

description.zh: 目标受到的近战与远程伤害提高。
description.en: The target takes more punishment from melee and ranged attacks.

description.zh: 使用者汲取水元素之力，强化水系魔法与威力。
description.en: The user draws on Water, strengthening water magic and force.

description.zh: 水流保护使用者，并可能以冻结回应来袭攻击。
description.en: Water shields the user and can answer incoming blows with Frozen.

description.zh: 元素符印会在施法者周围升起一道水属性的奥术屏障。
description.en: Elemental sigils raise a water-aligned arcane barrier around the caster.

description.zh: 目标暴露于水元素之力，使水系力量对其更加有效。
description.en: The target is exposed to Water, making water power more effective.

description.zh: 目标的进攻力量受到削弱。
description.en: The target's offensive strength is dulled.

description.zh: 使用者汲取风元素之力，强化风系魔法与威力。
description.en: The user draws on Wind, strengthening wind magic and force.

description.zh: 风流保护使用者，并可能以 Chain Lightning 回应来袭攻击。
description.en: Wind shields the user and can answer incoming blows with Chain Lightning.

description.zh: 元素符印会在施法者周围升起一道风属性的奥术屏障。
description.en: Elemental sigils raise a wind-aligned arcane barrier around the caster.

description.zh: 目标暴露于风元素之力，使风系力量对其更加有效。
description.en: The target is exposed to Wind, making wind power more effective.

description.zh: 使用者的身体与魔法迸发出更强力量。
description.en: The user's body and magic surge with greater force.
